File: .github/workflows/codeql-analysis.yml
================
 1: name: "CodeQL"
 2: on:
 3:   push:
 4:     branches: [ master ]
 5:   pull_request:
 6:     branches: [ master ]
 7:   schedule:
 8:     - cron: '25 0 * * 6'
 9: jobs:
10:   analyze:
11:     name: Analyze
12:     runs-on: ubuntu-latest
13:     strategy:
14:       fail-fast: false
15:       matrix:
16:         language: [ 'java' ]
17:     steps:
18:     - name: Checkout repository
19:       uses: actions/checkout@v2
20:     - name: Initialize CodeQL
21:       uses: github/codeql-action/init@v1
22:       with:
23:         languages: ${{ matrix.language }}
24:     - name: Autobuild
25:       uses: github/codeql-action/autobuild@v1
26:     - name: Perform CodeQL Analysis
27:       uses: github/codeql-action/analyze@v1

================
File: examples/docker_build.sh
================
 1: push_flag='false'
 2: registry='descartesresearch'
 3: print_usage() {
 4:   printf "Usage: docker_build.sh [-p] [-r REGISTRY_NAME]\n"
 5: }
 6: while getopts 'pr:' flag; do
 7:   case "${flag}" in
 8:     p) push_flag='true' ;;
 9:     r) registry="${OPTARG}" ;;
10:     *) print_usage
11:        exit 1 ;;
12:   esac
13: done
14: docker build --no-cache=true -t "$registry/teastore-base" ../utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.dockerbase/
15: perl -i -pe's|.*FROM descartesresearch/|FROM '"$registry"'/|g' ../services/tools.descartes.teastore.*/Dockerfile
16: docker build -t "$registry/teastore-registry" ../services/tools.descartes.teastore.registry/
17: docker build -t "$registry/teastore-persistence" ../services/tools.descartes.teastore.persistence/
18: docker build -t "$registry/teastore-image" ../services/tools.descartes.teastore.image/
19: docker build -t "$registry/teastore-webui" ../services/tools.descartes.teastore.webui/
20: docker build -t "$registry/teastore-auth" ../services/tools.descartes.teastore.auth/
21: docker build -t "$registry/teastore-recommender" ../services/tools.descartes.teastore.recommender/
22: perl -i -pe's|.*FROM '"$registry"'/|FROM descartesresearch/|g' ../services/tools.descartes.teastore.*/Dockerfile
23: if [ "$push_flag" = 'true' ]; then
24:   docker push "$registry/teastore-base"
25:   docker push "$registry/teastore-registry"
26:   docker push "$registry/teastore-persistence"
27:   docker push "$registry/teastore-image"
28:   docker push "$registry/teastore-webui"
29:   docker push "$registry/teastore-auth"
30:   docker push "$registry/teastore-recommender"
31: fi

File: examples/httploadgenerator/teastore_browse.lua
================
 1: --[[
 2: 	teastore_browse profile. Sends cyclical requests to webui instance or front-end loadbalancer.
 3: 	Browses store and updates shopping carts.
 4: 	Does not perform any actions that would change the database.
 5: --]]
 6: 
 7: --[[
 8: 	Global Variables. Initialized at load driver startup.
 9: --]]
10: prefix = "http://10.1.1.1:8080/tools.descartes.teastore.webui/"
11: productviewcount = 30
12: postIndex = {3, 11}
13: 
14: 
15: --[[
16: 	Gets called at the beginning of each "call cycle", perform as much work as possible here.
17: 	Initialize all global variables here.
18: 	Note that math.random is already initialized using a fixed seed (5) for reproducibility.
19: --]]
20: function onCycle()
21: 	userpostfix = 1 + math.random(90)
22: 	calls = {
23: 	"",
24: 	"login",
25: 	--[[[POST]--]]"loginAction?username=user"..userpostfix.."&password=password",
26: 	--[[[POST]--]]"category?page=1&category=",
27: 	"product?id=",
28: 	--[[[POST]--]]"cartAction?addToCart=&productid=",
29: 	"category?page=1&category=",
30: 	"category?page=",
31: 	--[[[POST]--]]"cartAction?addToCart=&productid=",
32: 	"profile",
33: 	--[[[POST]--]]"loginAction?logout=",
34: 	}
35: end
36: 
37: --[[
38: 	Gets called with ever increasing callnums for each http call until it returns nil.
39: 	Once it returns nil, onCycle() is called again and callnum is reset to 1 (Lua convention).
40: 	
41: 	Here, you can use our HTML helper functions for conditional calls on returned texts (usually HTML, thus the name).
42: 	We offer:
43: 	- html.getMatches( regex )
44: 		Returns all lines in the returned text stream that match a provided regex.
45: 	- html.extractMatches( prefixRegex, postfixRegex )
46: 		Returns all matches that are preceeded by a prefixRegex match and followed by a postfixRegex match.
47: 		The regexes must have one unique match for each line in which they apply.
48: 	- html.extractMatches( prefixRegex, matchingRegex, postfixRegex )
49: 		Variant of extractMatches with a matching regex defining the string that is to be extracted.
50: --]]
51: function onCall(callnum)
52: 	if callnum == 2 then
53: 		local categoryids = html.extractMatches("href=.*category.*?category=","\\d+","&page=1.")
54: 		categoryid = categoryids[math.random(#categoryids)]
55: 	elseif callnum == 5 then
56: 		local productids = html.extractMatches("href=.*product.*?id=","\\d+",". ><img")
57: 		productid = productids[math.random(#productids)]
58: 		local pagecount = #html.getMatches(".*href=.*category.*?category=\\d+&page=\\d+.>\\d+</a></li>.*")
59: 		page = math.random(pagecount)
60: 	elseif callnum == 9 then
61: 		local productids = html.extractMatches("href=.*product.*?id=","\\d+",". ><img")
62: 		productid = productids[math.random(#productids)]
63: 	end
64: 
65: 	if calls[callnum] == nil then
66: 		return nil
67: 	elseif callnum == 4 then
68: 		return "[POST]"..prefix..calls[callnum]..categoryid.."&number="..productviewcount
69: 	elseif callnum == 5 then
70: 		return prefix..calls[callnum]..productid
71: 	elseif callnum == 6 then
72: 		return "[POST]"..prefix..calls[callnum]..productid
73: 	elseif callnum == 7 then
74: 		return prefix..calls[callnum]..categoryid
75: 	elseif callnum == 8 then
76: 		return prefix..calls[callnum]..page.."&category="..categoryid
77: 	elseif callnum == 9 then
78: 		return "[POST]"..prefix..calls[callnum]..productid
79: 	elseif isPost(callnum) then
80: 		return "[POST]"..prefix..calls[callnum]
81: 	else
82: 		return prefix..calls[callnum]
83: 	end
84: end
85: 
86: function isPost(index)
87: 	for i = 1,#postIndex do
88: 		if index == postIndex[i] then
89: 			return true
90: 		end
91: 	end
92: 	return false
93: end

 2: kind: Deployment
 3: metadata:
 4:   name: teastore-kieker-rabbitmq
 5: spec:
 6:   selector:
 7:     matchLabels:
 8:       app: teastore
 9:       run: teastore-kieker-rabbitmq
10:   template:
11:     metadata:
12:       labels:
13:         app: teastore
14:         run: teastore-kieker-rabbitmq
15:     spec:
16:       containers:
17:       - name: teastore-kieker-rabbitmq
18:         image: descartesresearch/teastore-kieker-rabbitmq
19:         ports:
20:         - containerPort: 5672
21:         - containerPort: 8080
22:         - containerPort: 15672
23: ---
24: apiVersion: v1
25: kind: Service
26: metadata:
27:   name: teastore-kieker-rabbitmq
28:   labels:
29:     app: teastore
30:     run: teastore-kieker-rabbitmq
31: spec:
32:   type: NodePort
33:   ports:
34:   - port: 8080
35:     nodePort: 30081
36:     protocol: TCP
37:     name: webui-port
38:   - port: 5672
39:     protocol: TCP
40:     name: rabbitmq-port
41:   selector:
42:     run: teastore-kieker-rabbitmq

File: interfaces/tools.descartes.teastore.entities/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/entities/ImageSize.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.entities;
 2: public class ImageSize {
 3:   public static final String IMAGE_SIZE_DIVIDER = "x";
 4:   private int width;
 5:   private int height;
 6:   public ImageSize() {
 7:   }
 8:   public ImageSize(int width, int height) {
 9:     setWidth(width);
10:     setHeight(height);
11:   }
12:   public ImageSize(ImageSize size) {
13:     setWidth(size.getWidth());
14:     setHeight(size.getHeight());
15:   }
16:   public int getWidth() {
17:     return width;
18:   }
19:   public void setWidth(int width) {
20:     if (width <= 0) {
21:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("Image width cannot be zero or negative.");
22:     }
23:     this.width = width;
24:   }
25:   public int getHeight() {
26:     return height;
27:   }
28:   public void setHeight(int height) {
29:     if (height <= 0) {
30:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("Image height cannot be zero or negative.");
31:     }
32:     this.height = height;
33:   }
34:   public int getPixelCount() {
35:     return width * height;
36:   }
37:   public static ImageSize parseImageSize(String str) {
38:     if (str == null) {
39:       throw new NullPointerException("Supplied string is null.");
40:     }
41:     if (str.isEmpty()) {
42:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("Supplied string is empty.");
43:     }
44:     String[] tmp = str.trim().split(IMAGE_SIZE_DIVIDER);
45:     if (tmp.length != 2) {
46:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("Malformed string supplied. Does not contain exactly two size "
47:           + "values divided by \"" + IMAGE_SIZE_DIVIDER + "\".");
48:     }
49:     int width = 0;
50:     int height = 0;
51:     try {
52:       width = Integer.parseInt(tmp[0].trim());
53:       height = Integer.parseInt(tmp[1].trim());
54:     } catch (NumberFormatException parseException) {
55:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("Malformed string supplied. Cannot parse size values.");
56:     }
57:     return new ImageSize(width, height);
58:   }
59:   @Override
60:   public int hashCode() {
61:     final int prime = 31;
62:     int result = 1;
63:     result = prime * result + height;
64:     result = prime * result + width;
65:     return result;
66:   }
67:   @Override
68:   public boolean equals(Object obj) {
69:     if (this == obj) {
70:       return true;
71:     }
72:     if (obj == null) {
73:       return false;
74:     }
75:     if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
76:       return false;
77:     }
78:     ImageSize other = (ImageSize) obj;
79:     if (height != other.height) {
80:       return false;
81:     }
82:     if (width != other.width) {
83:       return false;
84:     }
85:     return true;
86:   }
87:   @Override
88:   public String toString() {
89:     return String.valueOf(width) + IMAGE_SIZE_DIVIDER + String.valueOf(height);
90:   }
91: }

File: interfaces/tools.descartes.teastore.entities/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/entities/User.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.entities;
 2: public class User {
 3:   private long id;
 4:   private String userName;
 5:   private String password;
 6:   private String realName;
 7:   private String email;
 8:   public User() {
 9:   }
10:   public User(User user) {
11:     setId(user.getId());
12:     setUserName(user.getUserName());
13:     setPassword(user.getPassword());
14:     setRealName(user.getRealName());
15:     setEmail(user.getEmail());
16:   }
17:   public long getId() {
18:     return id;
19:   }
20:   public void setId(long id) {
21:     this.id = id;
22:   }
23:   public String getUserName() {
24:     return userName;
25:   }
26:   public void setUserName(String userName) {
27:     this.userName = userName;
28:   }
29:   public String getPassword() {
30:     return password;
31:   }
32:   public void setPassword(String password) {
33:     this.password = password;
34:   }
35:   public String getRealName() {
36:     return realName;
37:   }
38:   public void setRealName(String realName) {
39:     this.realName = realName;
40:   }
41:   public String getEmail() {
42:     return email;
43:   }
44:   public void setEmail(String email) {
45:     this.email = email;
46:   }
47:   @Override
48:   public int hashCode() {
49:     final int prime = 31;
50:     int result = 1;
51:     result = prime * result + (int) (id ^ (id >>> 32));
52:     if (userName == null) {
53:       result = prime * result + 0;
54:     } else {
55:       result = prime * result + userName.hashCode();
56:     }
57:     return result;
58:   }
59:   @Override
60:   public boolean equals(Object obj) {
61:     if (this == obj) {
62:       return true;
63:     }
64:     if (obj == null) {
65:       return false;
66:     }
67:     if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
68:       return false;
69:     }
70:     User other = (User) obj;
71:     if (id != other.id) {
72:       return false;
73:     }
74:     if (userName == null) {
75:       if (other.userName != null) {
76:         return false;
77:       }
78:     } else {
79:       if (!userName.equals(other.userName)) {
80:         return false;
81:       }
82:     }
83:     return true;
84:   }
85: }

File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.auth/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/auth/rest/AuthCartRest.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.auth.rest;
 2: import javax.ws.rs.Consumes;
 3: import javax.ws.rs.POST;
 4: import javax.ws.rs.PUT;
 5: import javax.ws.rs.Path;
 6: import javax.ws.rs.PathParam;
 7: import javax.ws.rs.Produces;
 8: import javax.ws.rs.QueryParam;
 9: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response;
10: import tools.descartes.teastore.auth.security.ShaSecurityProvider;
11: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.OrderItem;
12: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.Product;
13: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.message.SessionBlob;
14: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.Service;
15: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.rest.LoadBalancedCRUDOperations;
16: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.NotFoundException;
17: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.TimeoutException;
18: @Path("cart")
19: @Produces({ "application/json" })
20: @Consumes({ "application/json" })
21: public class AuthCartRest {
22:   @POST
23:   @Path("add/{pid}")
24:   public Response addProductToCart(SessionBlob blob, @PathParam("pid") final Long pid) {
25:     Product product;
26:     try {
27:       product = LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntity(Service.PERSISTENCE, "products", Product.class,
28:           pid);
29:     } catch (TimeoutException e) {
30:       return Response.status(408).build();
31:     } catch (NotFoundException e) {
32:       return Response.status(404).build();
33:     }
34:     for (OrderItem orderItem : blob.getOrderItems()) {
35:       if (orderItem.getProductId() == pid) {
36:         orderItem.setQuantity(orderItem.getQuantity() + 1);
37:         blob = new ShaSecurityProvider().secure(blob);
38:         return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(blob).build();
39:       }
40:     }
41:     OrderItem item = new OrderItem();
42:     item.setProductId(pid);
43:     item.setQuantity(1);
44:     item.setUnitPriceInCents(product.getListPriceInCents());
45:     blob.getOrderItems().add(item);
46:     blob = new ShaSecurityProvider().secure(blob);
47:     return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(blob).build();
48:   }
49:   @POST
50:   @Path("remove/{pid}")
51:   public Response removeProductFromCart(SessionBlob blob, @PathParam("pid") final Long pid) {
52:     OrderItem toRemove = null;
53:     for (OrderItem item : blob.getOrderItems()) {
54:       if (item.getProductId() == pid) {
55:         toRemove = item;
56:       }
57:     }
58:     if (toRemove != null) {
59:       blob.getOrderItems().remove(toRemove);
60:       blob = new ShaSecurityProvider().secure(blob);
61:       return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(blob).build();
62:     } else {
63:       return Response.status(Response.Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
64:     }
65:   }
66:   @PUT
67:   @Path("{pid}")
68:   public Response updateQuantity(SessionBlob blob, @PathParam("pid") final Long pid,
69:       @QueryParam("quantity") int quantity) {
70:     for (OrderItem item : blob.getOrderItems()) {
71:       if (item.getProductId() == pid) {
72:         item.setQuantity(quantity);
73:         blob = new ShaSecurityProvider().secure(blob);
74:         return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(blob).build();
75:       }
76:     }
77:     return Response.status(Response.Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
78:   }
79: }

  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.auth.rest;

 12: import tools.descartes.teastore.auth.security.ShaSecurityProvider;
 13: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.Order;
 14: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.OrderItem;
 15: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.User;
 16: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.message.SessionBlob;
 17: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.Service;
 18: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers.LoadBalancerTimeoutException;
 19: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.rest.LoadBalancedCRUDOperations;
 20: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.NotFoundException;
 21: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.TimeoutException;
 22: @Path("useractions")
 23: @Produces({ "application/json" })
 24: @Consumes({ "application/json" })
 25: public class AuthUserActionsRest {
 26:   @POST
 27:   @Path("placeorder")
 28:   public Response placeOrder(SessionBlob blob,
 29:       @QueryParam("totalPriceInCents") long totalPriceInCents,
 30:       @QueryParam("addressName") String addressName, @QueryParam("address1") String address1,
 31:       @QueryParam("address2") String address2,
 32:       @QueryParam("creditCardCompany") String creditCardCompany,
 33:       @QueryParam("creditCardNumber") String creditCardNumber,
 34:       @QueryParam("creditCardExpiryDate") String creditCardExpiryDate) {
 35:     if (new ShaSecurityProvider().validate(blob) == null || blob.getOrderItems().isEmpty()) {
 36:       return Response.status(Response.Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
 37:     }
 38:     blob.getOrder().setUserId(blob.getUID());
 39:     blob.getOrder().setTotalPriceInCents(totalPriceInCents);
 40:     blob.getOrder().setAddressName(addressName);
 41:     blob.getOrder().setAddress1(address1);
 42:     blob.getOrder().setAddress2(address2);
 43:     blob.getOrder().setCreditCardCompany(creditCardCompany);
 44:     blob.getOrder().setCreditCardExpiryDate(creditCardExpiryDate);
 45:     blob.getOrder().setCreditCardNumber(creditCardNumber);
 46:     blob.getOrder().setTime(LocalDateTime.now().format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME));
 47:     long orderId;
 48:     try {
 49:       orderId = LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.sendEntityForCreation(Service.PERSISTENCE, "orders",
 50:           Order.class, blob.getOrder());
 51:     } catch (LoadBalancerTimeoutException e) {
 52:       return Response.status(408).build();
 53:     } catch (NotFoundException e) {
 54:       return Response.status(404).build();
 55:     }
 56:     for (OrderItem item : blob.getOrderItems()) {
 57:       try {
 58:         item.setOrderId(orderId);
 59:         LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.sendEntityForCreation(Service.PERSISTENCE, "orderitems",
 60:             OrderItem.class, item);
 61:       } catch (TimeoutException e) {
 62:         return Response.status(408).build();
 63:       } catch (NotFoundException e) {
 64:         return Response.status(404).build();
 65:       }
 66:     }
 67:     blob.setOrder(new Order());
 68:     blob.getOrderItems().clear();
 69:     blob = new ShaSecurityProvider().secure(blob);
 70:     return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(blob).build();
 71:   }
 72:   @POST
 73:   @Path("login")
 74:   public Response login(SessionBlob blob, @QueryParam("name") String name,
 75:       @QueryParam("password") String password) {
 76:     User user;
 77:     try {
 78:       user = LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntityWithProperties(Service.PERSISTENCE, "users",
 79:           User.class, "name", name);
 80:     } catch (TimeoutException e) {
 81:       return Response.status(408).build();
 82:     } catch (NotFoundException e) {
 83:       return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(blob).build();
 84:     }
 85:     if (user != null && BCryptProvider.checkPassword(password, user.getPassword())
 86:     ) {
 87:       blob.setUID(user.getId());
 88:       blob.setSID(new RandomSessionIdGenerator().getSessionId());
 89:       blob = new ShaSecurityProvider().secure(blob);
 90:       return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(blob).build();
 91:     }
 92:     return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(blob).build();
 93:   }
 94:   @POST
 95:   @Path("logout")
 96:   public Response logout(SessionBlob blob) {
 97:     blob.setUID(null);
 98:     blob.setSID(null);
 99:     blob.setOrder(new Order());
100:     blob.getOrderItems().clear();
101:     return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(blob).build();
102:   }
103:   @POST
104:   @Path("isloggedin")
105:   public Response isLoggedIn(SessionBlob blob) {
106:     return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(new ShaSecurityProvider().validate(blob))
107:         .build();
108:   }
109: }

File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.auth/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/auth/security/ShaSecurityProvider.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.auth.security;
 2: import com.fasterxml.jackson.core.JsonProcessingException;
 3: import com.fasterxml.jackson.databind.ObjectMapper;
 4: import java.io.UnsupportedEncodingException;
 5: import java.net.URLEncoder;
 6: import java.security.MessageDigest;
 7: import java.security.NoSuchAlgorithmException;
 8: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.message.SessionBlob;
 9: public class ShaSecurityProvider implements ISecurityProvider {
10:   @Override
11:   public IKeyProvider getKeyProvider() {
12:     return new ConstantKeyProvider();
13:   }
14:   @Override
15:   public SessionBlob secure(SessionBlob blob) {
16:     if (blob.getUID() == null || blob.getSID() == null) {
17:       return blob;
18:     }
19:     blob.setToken(null);
20:     String blobString = blobToString(blob);
21:     blob.setToken(getSha512(blobString));
22:     return blob;
23:   }
24:   private String blobToString(SessionBlob blob) {
25:     ObjectMapper o = new ObjectMapper();
26:     try {
27:       return URLEncoder.encode(o.writeValueAsString(blob), "UTF-8");
28:     } catch (JsonProcessingException | UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
29:       throw new IllegalStateException("Could not save blob!");
30:     }
31:   }
32:   @Override
33:   public SessionBlob validate(SessionBlob blob) {
34:     if (blob.getToken() == null) {
35:       return null;
36:     }
37:     String token = blob.getToken();
38:     blob.setToken(null);
39:     String blobString = blobToString(blob);
40:     String validationToken = getSha512(blobString);
41:     if (validationToken.equals(token)) {
42:       return blob;
43:     }
44:     return null;
45:   }
46:   private String getSha512(String passwordToHash) {
47:     String generatedPassword = null;
48:     try {
49:       String salt = getKeyProvider().getKey(null);
50:       MessageDigest md = MessageDigest.getInstance("SHA-512");
51:       md.update(salt.getBytes("UTF-8"));
52:       byte[] bytes = md.digest(passwordToHash.getBytes("UTF-8"));
53:       StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
54:       for (int i = 0; i < bytes.length; i++) {
55:         sb.append(Integer.toString((bytes[i] & 0xff) + 0x100, 16).substring(1));
56:       }
57:       generatedPassword = sb.toString();
58:     } catch (NoSuchAlgorithmException | UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
59:       e.printStackTrace();
60:     }
61:     return generatedPassword;
62:   }
63: }

File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.image/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/image/cache/AbstractCache.java
================
  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.image.cache;
  2: import java.util.Collection;
  3: import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReadWriteLock;
  4: import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
  5: import java.util.function.Predicate;
  6: import org.slf4j.Logger;
  7: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
  8: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.cache.entry.ICachable;
  9: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.cache.entry.ICacheEntry;
 10: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.storage.IDataStorage;
 11: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.storage.NoStorage;
 12: public abstract class AbstractCache<S extends Collection<F>, T extends ICachable<T>, F extends ICacheEntry<T>>
 13:     implements IDataCache<T> {
 14:   private IDataStorage<T> cachedStorage;
 15:   private S entries;
 16:   private long maxCacheSize;
 17:   private long currentCacheSize;
 18:   private Predicate<T> cachingRule;
 19:   private Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AbstractCache.class);
 20:   private final ReadWriteLock lock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
 21:   public AbstractCache(S entries, IDataStorage<T> cachedStorage, long maxCacheSize,
 22:       Predicate<T> cachingRule) {
 23:     if (entries == null) {
 24:       log.error("The provided internal storage object is null.");
 25:       throw new NullPointerException("The provided internal storage object is null.");
 26:     }
 27:     if (cachingRule == null) {
 28:       log.error("The provided caching rule is null.");
 29:       throw new NullPointerException("The provided caching rule is null.");
 30:     }
 31:     if (cachedStorage == null) {
 32:       log.info("No underlying disk storage supplied, assuming no data is stored on disk.");
 33:       this.cachedStorage = new NoStorage<T>();
 34:     } else {
 35:       this.cachedStorage = cachedStorage;
 36:     }
 37:     this.entries = entries;
 38:     this.cachingRule = cachingRule;
 39:     setMaxCacheSize(maxCacheSize);
 40:   }
 41:   protected IDataStorage<T> getCachedStorage() {
 42: 	  return cachedStorage;
 43:   }
 44:   protected S getEntries() {
 45: 	  return entries;
 46:   }
 47:   private F findInEntries(long id) {
 48:     return entries.stream().filter(entry -> entry.getId() == id).findFirst().orElse(null);
 49:   }
 50:   private T getData(long id, boolean markUsed) {
 51:     F data = null;
 52:     if (markUsed) {
 53:       lock.writeLock().lock();
 54:       try {
 55:         data = findInEntries(id);
 56:         if (data != null) {
 57:           reorderAndTag(data);
 58:         }
 59:       } finally {
 60:         lock.writeLock().unlock();
 61:       }
 62:     } else {
 63:       lock.readLock().lock();
 64:       try {
 65:         data = findInEntries(id);
 66:       } finally {
 67:         lock.readLock().unlock();
 68:       }
 69:     }
 70:     if (data != null) {
 71:       return data.getData();
 72:     }
 73:     return null;
 74:   }
 75:   @Override
 76:   public long getMaxCacheSize() {
 77:     return maxCacheSize;
 78:   }
 79:   @Override
 80:   public boolean setMaxCacheSize(long maxCacheSize) {
 81:     if (maxCacheSize <= 0) {
 82:       log.error("The provided cache size is negative. Must be positive.");
 83:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("The provided cache size is negative. Must be positive.");
 84:     }
 85:     lock.writeLock().lock();
 86:     try {
 87:       this.maxCacheSize = maxCacheSize;
 88:       while (getFreeSpace() < 0) {
 89:         removeEntryByCachingStrategy();
 90:       }
 91:     } finally {
 92:       lock.writeLock().unlock();
 93:     }
 94:     return true;
 95:   }
 96:   @Override
 97:   public long getCurrentCacheSize() {
 98:     long size = 0;
 99:     lock.readLock().lock();
100:     try {
101:       size = currentCacheSize;
102:     } finally {
103:       lock.readLock().unlock();
104:     }
105:     return size;
106:   }
107:   @Override
108:   public long getFreeSpace() {
109:     return maxCacheSize - getCurrentCacheSize();
110:   }
111:   @Override
112:   public boolean hasStorageFor(long size) {
113:     return size <= getFreeSpace();
114:   }
115:   @Override
116:   public void cacheData(T data) {
117:     if (!dataIsCachable(data) || dataIsInCache(data.getId())) {
118:       return;
119:     }
120:     if (data.getByteSize() > maxCacheSize) {
121:       return;
122:     }
123:     lock.writeLock().lock();
124:     try {
125:       while (!hasStorageFor(data.getByteSize())) {
126:         removeEntryByCachingStrategy();
127:       }
128:       addEntry(createEntry(data));
129:     } finally {
130:       lock.writeLock().unlock();
131:     }
132:   }
133:   @Override
134:   public void uncacheData(T data) {
135:     lock.writeLock().lock();
136:     try {
137:       if (entries.remove(createEntry(data))) {
138:         dataRemovedFromCache(data.getByteSize());
139:       }
140:     } finally {
141:       lock.writeLock().unlock();
142:     }
143:   }
144:   @Override
145:   public boolean dataIsCachable(T data) {
146:     return cachingRule.test(data);
147:   }
148:   @Override
149:   public boolean dataIsInCache(long id) {
150:     return getData(id, false) != null;
151:   }
152:   @Override
153:   public void clearCache() {
154:     lock.writeLock().lock();
155:     try {
156:       entries.clear();
157:       currentCacheSize = 0;
158:     } finally {
159:       lock.writeLock().unlock();
160:     }
161:   }
162:   @Override
163:   public boolean dataExists(long id) {
164:     boolean result = false;
165:     lock.readLock().lock();
166:     try {
167:       if (dataIsInCache(id)) {
168:         result = true;
169:       } else {
170:         result = cachedStorage.dataExists(id);
171:       }
172:     } finally {
173:       lock.readLock().unlock();
174:     }
175:     return result;
176:   }
177:   @Override
178:   public T loadData(long id) {
179:     T entry = getData(id, true);
180:     if (entry == null) {
181:       entry = cachedStorage.loadData(id);
182:       if (entry == null) {
183:         return null;
184:       }
185:       cacheData(entry);
186:     }
187:     return entry;
188:   }
189:   @Override
190:   public boolean saveData(T data) {
191:     if (data == null) {
192:       return false;
193:     }
194:     cacheData(data);
195:     return cachedStorage.saveData(data);
196:   }
197:   @Override
198:   public boolean dataIsStorable(T data) {
199:     return cachedStorage.dataIsStorable(data);
200:   }
201:   @Override
202:   public boolean deleteData(T data) {
203:     uncacheData(data);
204:     return cachedStorage.deleteData(data);
205:   }
206:   protected void dataRemovedFromCache(long size) {
207:     lock.writeLock().lock();
208:     try {
209:       if (size > currentCacheSize) {
210:         currentCacheSize = 0;
211:       } else {
212:         currentCacheSize -= size;
213:       }
214:     } finally {
215:       lock.writeLock().unlock();
216:     }
217:   }
218:   protected void dataAddedToCache(long size) {
219:     lock.writeLock().lock();
220:     try {
221:       currentCacheSize += size;
222:     } finally {
223:       lock.writeLock().unlock();
224:     }
225:   }
226:   protected abstract F createEntry(T data);
227:   protected void addEntry(F data) {
228:     if (entries.add(data)) {
229:       dataAddedToCache(data.getByteSize());
230:     }
231:   }
232:   protected abstract void removeEntryByCachingStrategy();
233:   protected void reorderAndTag(F data) {
234:     data.wasUsed();
235:   }
236: }

 5: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.cache.entry.ICachable;
 6: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.cache.entry.ICacheEntry;
 7: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.storage.IDataStorage;
 8: public abstract class AbstractTreeCache<T extends ICachable<T>, F extends ICacheEntry<T>>
 9:     extends AbstractCache<TreeSet<F>, T, F> {
10:   public AbstractTreeCache(IDataStorage<T> cachedStorage, long maxCacheSize,

22:     getEntries().remove(data);

24:     getEntries().add(data);

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.image.cache.entry;
 2: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 3: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 4: public abstract class AbstractEntry<D extends ICachable<D>> implements ICacheEntry<D> {
 5:   private D data;
 6:   private Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(AbstractEntry.class);
 7:   public AbstractEntry(D data) {
 8:     if (data == null) {
 9:       log.error("The supplied data is null.");
10:       throw new NullPointerException("Supplied data is null.");
11:     }
12:     this.data = data;
13:   }
14:   @Override
15:   public D getData() {
16:     return data;
17:   }
18:   @Override
19:   public abstract void wasUsed();
20:   @Override
21:   public long getId() {
22:     return data.getId();
23:   }
24:   @Override
25:   public long getByteSize() {
26:     return data.getByteSize();
27:   }
28:   @Override
29:   public int hashCode() {
30:     final int prime = 31;
31:     int result = 1;
32:     if (data == null) {
33:       result = prime * result + 0;
34:     } else {
35:       result = prime * result + data.hashCode();
36:     }
37:     return result;
38:   }
39:   @Override
40:   public boolean equals(Object obj) {
41:     if (this == obj) {
42:       return true;
43:     }
44:     if (obj == null) {
45:       return false;
46:     }
47:     if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
48:       return false;
49:     }
50:     AbstractEntry<?> other = (AbstractEntry<?>) obj;
51:     if (data == null) {
52:       if (other.data != null) {
53:         return false;
54:       }
55:     } else if (!data.equals(other.data)) {
56:       return false;
57:     }
58:     return true;
59:   }
60: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.image.cache;

  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.image;

 10: public class ImageDB {

 12:   private HashMap<String, Map<Long, ImageSize>> webui = new HashMap<>();
 13:   private HashMap<Long, ImageSize> sizes = new HashMap<>();
 14:   private final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ImageDB.class);

 16:   public ImageDB() {
 17:   }
 18:   public ImageDB(ImageDB copy) {
 19:     if (copy == null) {

 21:       throw new NullPointerException("The supplied image database to copy is null.");
 22:     }

 24:     this.webui = new HashMap<>(copy.webui);
 25:     this.sizes = new HashMap<>(copy.sizes);
 26:   }
 27:   public boolean hasImageID(ImageDBKey imageKey, ImageSize imageSize) {
 28:     if (imageKey == null) {
 29:       log.error("The supplied image key is null.");
 30:       throw new NullPointerException("The supplied image key is null.");
 31:     }
 32:     if (imageKey.isProductKey()) {
 33:       return hasImageID(imageKey.getProductID(), imageSize);
 34:     }
 35:     return hasImageID(imageKey.getWebUIName(), imageSize);
 36:   }
 37:   public boolean hasImageID(long productID, ImageSize imageSize) {
 38:     return findImageID(productID, imageSize, products) != 0;
 39:   }
 40:   public boolean hasImageID(String name, ImageSize imageSize) {
 41:     return findImageID(name, imageSize, webui) != 0;
 42:   }
 43:   public long getImageID(ImageDBKey imageKey, ImageSize imageSize) {
 44:     if (imageKey == null) {
 45:       log.error("The supplied image key is null.");
 46:       throw new NullPointerException("The supplied image key is null.");
 47:     }
 48:     if (imageKey.isProductKey()) {
 49:       return getImageID(imageKey.getProductID(), imageSize);
 50:     }
 51:     return getImageID(imageKey.getWebUIName(), imageSize);
 52:   }

 54:     return findImageID(productID, imageSize, products);
 55:   }

 57:     return findImageID(name, imageSize, webui);

 59:   private <K> long findImageID(K key, ImageSize imageSize, HashMap<K, Map<Long, ImageSize>> db) {
 60:     Optional<Map.Entry<Long, ImageSize>> img = null;
 61:     lock.readLock().lock();
 62:     try {
 63:       img = db.getOrDefault(key, new HashMap<>()).entrySet().stream()
 64:           .filter(t -> t.getValue().equals(imageSize)).findFirst();
 65:     } finally {
 66:       lock.readLock().unlock();
 67:     }
 68:     if (img.isPresent()) {
 69:       return img.get().getKey();
 70:     }
 71:     return 0;
 72:   }
 73:   public ImageSize getImageSize(long imageID) {
 74:     ImageSize result = null;
 75:     lock.readLock().lock();
 76:     try {
 77:       result = sizes.getOrDefault(imageID, null);
 78:     } finally {
 79:       lock.readLock().unlock();
 80:     }
 81:     return result;
 82:   }
 83:   public void setImageMapping(ImageDBKey imageKey, long imageID, ImageSize imageSize) {
 84:     if (imageKey == null) {
 85:       log.error("The supplied image key is null.");
 86:       throw new NullPointerException("The supplied image key is null.");
 87:     }
 88:     if (imageKey.isProductKey()) {
 89:       setImageMapping(imageKey.getProductID(), imageID, imageSize);
 90:     } else {
 91:       setImageMapping(imageKey.getWebUIName(), imageID, imageSize);
 92:     }
 93:   }
 94:   public void setImageMapping(long productID, long imageID, ImageSize imageSize) {
 95:     map(productID, imageID, imageSize, products);
 96:   }
 97:   public void setImageMapping(String name, long imageID, ImageSize imageSize) {
 98:     if (name == null) {
 99:       log.error("The supplied image name is null.");
100:       throw new NullPointerException("The supplied image name is null.");
101:     }
102:     map(name, imageID, imageSize, webui);
103:   }
104:   private <K> void map(K key, long imageID, ImageSize imageSize,
105:       HashMap<K, Map<Long, ImageSize>> db) {
106:     if (imageSize == null) {
107:       log.error("Supplied image size is null.");
108:       throw new NullPointerException("Supplied image size is null.");
109:     }
110:     Map<Long, ImageSize> images = new HashMap<>();
111:     lock.writeLock().lock();
112:     try {
113:       if (db.containsKey(key)) {
114:         images = db.get(key);
115:       }
116:       images.put(imageID, imageSize);
117:       db.put(key, images);
118:       sizes.put(imageID, imageSize);
119:     } finally {
120:       lock.writeLock().unlock();
121:     }
122:   }
123:   public void removeImageMapping(long imageID) {
124:     lock.writeLock().lock();
125:     try {
126:       unmap(imageID, webui);
127:       unmap(imageID, products);
128:       sizes.remove(imageID);
129:     } finally {
130:       lock.writeLock().unlock();
131:     }
132:   }
133:   private <K> void unmap(long imageID, HashMap<K, Map<Long, ImageSize>> db) {
134:     Map.Entry<String, Map<Long, ImageSize>> img = webui.entrySet().stream()
135:         .filter(entry -> entry.getValue().containsKey(imageID)).findFirst().orElse(null);
136:     if (img != null) {
137:       webui.remove(img.getKey());
138:     }
139:   }
140: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.image;
 2: import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
 3: import java.util.HashMap;
 4: import java.util.Map;

11: public enum ImageProvider {
12:   IP;
13:   public static final String IMAGE_NOT_FOUND = "notFound";
14:   private ImageDB db;
15:   private IDataStorage<StoreImage> storage;
16:   private Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ImageProvider.class);
17:   private ImageProvider() {
18:   }
19:   public void setImageDB(ImageDB imgDB) {
20: 	if (imgDB != null) {
21: 	  db = imgDB;
22: 	}
23:   }
24:   public void setStorage(IDataStorage<StoreImage> imgStorage) {
25: 	if (imgStorage != null) {
26:       storage = imgStorage;
27: 	}
28:   }
29:   public Map<Long, String> getProductImages(Map<Long, ImageSize> images) {
30:     Map<Long, String> result = new HashMap<>();
31:     for (Map.Entry<Long, ImageSize> entry : images.entrySet()) {
32:       String imgStr = getImageFor(new ImageDBKey(entry.getKey()), entry.getValue());
33:       if (imgStr == null) {
34:         continue;
35:       }
36:       result.put(entry.getKey(), imgStr);
37:     }
38:     return result;
39:   }
40:   public Map<String, String> getWebUIImages(Map<String, ImageSize> images) {
41:     Map<String, String> result = new HashMap<>();
42:     for (Map.Entry<String, ImageSize> entry : images.entrySet()) {
43:       String imgStr = getImageFor(new ImageDBKey(entry.getKey()), entry.getValue());
44:       if (imgStr == null) {
45:         continue;
46:       }
47:       result.put(entry.getKey(), imgStr);
48:     }
49:     return result;
50:   }
51:   private StoreImage scaleAndRegisterImg(BufferedImage image, ImageDBKey key, ImageSize size) {
52:     StoreImage storedImg = new StoreImage(ImageIDFactory.ID.getNextImageID(),
53:         ImageScaler.scale(image, size), size);
54:     db.setImageMapping(key, storedImg.getId(), size);
55:     storage.saveData(storedImg);
56:     return storedImg;
57:   }
58:   private String getImageFor(ImageDBKey key, ImageSize size) {
59:     if (db == null || storage == null) {
60:       log.warn("Image provider not correctly initialized. Missing image database and storage.");
61:       return null;
62:     }
63:     if (key == null || size == null) {
64:       log.info("Supplied image key or size are null.");
65:       return null;
66:     }
67:     if (!key.isProductKey() && (key.getWebUIName() == null || key.getWebUIName().isEmpty())) {
68:       log.info("Supplied image key invalid. Is neither web image nor product image.");
69:       return null;
70:     }
71:     ImageSize stdSize = ImageSizePreset.STD_IMAGE_SIZE;
72:     StoreImage storedImg = null;
73:     long imgID = db.getImageID(key, size);
74:     if (imgID != 0) {
75:       storedImg = storage.loadData(imgID);
76:     }
77:     if (storedImg == null) {
78:       storedImg = storage.loadData(db.getImageID(key, stdSize));
79:       if (storedImg != null) {
80:         storedImg = scaleAndRegisterImg(storedImg.getImage(), key, size);
81:       } else {
82:         storedImg = storage.loadData(db.getImageID(IMAGE_NOT_FOUND, size));
83:         if (storedImg == null) {
84:           storedImg = storage.loadData(db.getImageID(IMAGE_NOT_FOUND, stdSize));
85:           if (storedImg == null) {
86:             return null;
87:           }
88:           storedImg = scaleAndRegisterImg(storedImg.getImage(), new ImageDBKey(IMAGE_NOT_FOUND),
89:               size);
90:         }
91:       }
92:     }
93:     return storedImg.toString();
94:   }
95: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.image;
 2: import java.awt.Graphics2D;
 3: import java.awt.RenderingHints;
 4: import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
 5: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 6: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 7: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.ImageSize;
 8: public final class ImageScaler {
 9:   private static Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ImageScaler.class);
10:   private ImageScaler() {
11:   }
12:   public static BufferedImage scale(BufferedImage image, ImageSize size) {
13:     if (size == null) {
14:       log.error("The supplied image size is null.");
15:       throw new NullPointerException("The supplied image size is null.");
16:     }
17:     return scale(image, size.getWidth(), size.getHeight());
18:   }
19:   public static BufferedImage scale(BufferedImage image, double scalingFactor) {
20:     if (scalingFactor <= 0.0) {
21:       log.error("The supplied scaling factor is 0 or below.");
22:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("The supplied scaling factor is 0 or below.");
23:     }
24:     return scale(image, scalingFactor, scalingFactor);
25:   }
26:   public static BufferedImage scale(BufferedImage image, double widthScaling,
27:       double heightScaling) {
28:     if (widthScaling <= 0.0) {
29:       log.error("The supplied width scaling factor is 0 or below.");
30:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("The supplied width scaling factor is 0 or below.");
31:     }
32:     if (heightScaling <= 0.0) {
33:       log.error("The supplied height scaling factor is 0 or below.");
34:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("The supplied height scaling factor is 0 or below.");
35:     }
36:     int newWidth = (int) (image.getWidth() * widthScaling);
37:     if (newWidth == 0) {
38:       newWidth = 1;
39:     }
40:     int newHeight = (int) (image.getHeight() * heightScaling);
41:     if (newHeight == 0) {
42:       newHeight = 1;
43:     }
44:     return scale(image, newWidth, newHeight);
45:   }
46:   public static BufferedImage scale(BufferedImage image, int size) {
47:     if (size <= 0) {
48:       log.error("The supplied pixel size is below 1.");
49:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("The supplied pixel size is below 1.");
50:     }
51:     return scale(image, size, size);
52:   }
53:   public static BufferedImage scale(BufferedImage image, int width, int height) {
54:     if (image == null) {
55:       log.error("The supplied image is null.");
56:       throw new NullPointerException("The supplied image is null.");
57:     }
58:     if (width <= 0) {
59:       log.error("The supplied pixel width is below 1.");
60:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("The supplied pixel width is below 1.");
61:     }
62:     if (height <= 0) {
63:       log.error("The supplied pixel height is below 1.");
64:       throw new IllegalArgumentException("The supplied pixel height is below 1.");
65:     }
66:     BufferedImage scaledImg = new BufferedImage(width, height, BufferedImage.TRANSLUCENT);
67:     Graphics2D graphics = scaledImg.createGraphics();
68:     graphics.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_INTERPOLATION,
69:         RenderingHints.VALUE_INTERPOLATION_BICUBIC);
70:     graphics.drawImage(image, 0, 0, width, height, null);
71:     graphics.dispose();
72:     return scaledImg;
73:   }
74: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.image.setup;
 2: import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
 3: import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
 4: import java.io.IOException;
 5: import java.nio.channels.ClosedByInterruptException;
 6: import java.nio.file.Files;
 7: import java.nio.file.Path;
 8: import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;
 9: import java.util.Base64;
10: import java.util.Random;
11: import java.util.concurrent.atomic.AtomicLong;
12: import javax.imageio.ImageIO;
13: import org.slf4j.Logger;
14: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
15: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.ImageSize;
16: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.ImageSizePreset;
17: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.ImageDB;
18: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.StoreImage;
19: public class CreatorRunner implements Runnable {
20:   private final long productID;
21:   private final ImageDB imgDB;
22:   private final ImageSize size;
23:   private final Path workingDir;
24:   private final int shapesPerImage;
25:   private final BufferedImage categoryImage;
26:   private final AtomicLong nrOfImagesGenerated;
27:   private final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(CreatorRunner.class);
28:   public CreatorRunner(ImageDB imgDB, ImageSize size, long productID, int shapesPerImage,
29:       BufferedImage categoryImage, Path workingDir, AtomicLong nrOfImagesGenerated) {
30:     this.imgDB = imgDB;
31:     this.productID = productID;
32:     this.shapesPerImage = shapesPerImage;
33:     this.categoryImage = categoryImage;
34:     this.workingDir = workingDir;
35:     this.nrOfImagesGenerated = nrOfImagesGenerated;
36:     if (size != null) {
37:       this.size = size;
38:     } else {
39:       this.size = ImageSizePreset.STD_IMAGE_SIZE;
40:     }
41:   }
42:   @Override
43:   public void run() {
44:     long imgID = ImageIDFactory.ID.getNextImageID();
45:     Random rand = new Random(productID);
46:     imgDB.setImageMapping(productID, imgID, size);
47:     Path imgFile = workingDir.resolve(String.valueOf(imgID));
48:     BufferedImage img = ImageCreator.createImage(shapesPerImage, categoryImage, size, rand);
49:     ByteArrayOutputStream stream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
50:     try {
51:       ImageIO.write(img, StoreImage.STORE_IMAGE_FORMAT, stream);
52:       Files.write(imgFile, Base64.getEncoder().encode(stream.toByteArray()),
53:           StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.WRITE,
54:           StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING);
55:     } catch (IOException ioException) {
56:       if (!(ioException instanceof ClosedByInterruptException)) {
57:         log.warn("An IOException occured while writing image with ID " + String.valueOf(imgID)
58:             + " to file " + imgFile.toAbsolutePath() + ".", ioException);
59:       } else {
60:         log.warn("An exception was thrown during image creation with ID " + String.valueOf(imgID)
61:             + " to file " + imgFile.toAbsolutePath() + ".", ioException);
62:       }
63:     }
64:     nrOfImagesGenerated.incrementAndGet();
65:   }
66: }

  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.image.setup;
  2: import java.awt.Color;
  3: import java.awt.Font;
  4: import java.awt.Graphics2D;
  5: import java.awt.Rectangle;
  6: import java.awt.RenderingHints;
  7: import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
  8: import java.util.Random;
  9: import java.util.stream.Stream;
 10: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.ImageSize;
 11: public final class ImageCreator {
 12:   public static final long STD_SEED = 12345;
 13:   public static final int STD_NR_OF_SHAPES_PER_IMAGE = 10;
 14:   public static final int MAX_RGB = 255;
 15:   public static final int MAX_FONT_SIZE = 200;
 16:   public static final int MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 30;
 17:   public static final int MAX_CHAR_SIZE = 255;
 18:   private ImageCreator() {
 19:   }
 20:   public static BufferedImage createImage(int shapesPerImage, BufferedImage categoryImg,
 21:       ImageSize size, Random rand) {
 22:     BufferedImage img = new BufferedImage(size.getWidth(), size.getHeight(), BufferedImage.OPAQUE);
 23:     Graphics2D graphics = img.createGraphics();
 24:     graphics.setRenderingHint(RenderingHints.KEY_INTERPOLATION,
 25:         RenderingHints.VALUE_INTERPOLATION_BICUBIC);
 26:     switchColor(graphics, rand);
 27:     graphics.fillRect(0, 0, size.getWidth(), size.getHeight());
 28:     for (int i = 0; i < shapesPerImage; i++) {
 29:       switch (rand.nextInt(4)) {
 30:       case 0:
 31:         makeRectangle(graphics, size, rand);
 32:         break;
 33:       case 1:
 34:         makeLine(graphics, size, rand);
 35:         break;
 36:       case 2:
 37:         makeOval(graphics, size, rand);
 38:         break;
 39:       case 3:
 40:         makeText(graphics, size, rand);
 41:         break;
 42:       default:
 43:         makeRectangle(graphics, size, rand);
 44:         break;
 45:       }
 46:     }
 47:     if (categoryImg != null) {
 48:       drawCategoryImage(graphics, size, categoryImg, rand);
 49:     }
 50:     graphics.dispose();
 51:     return img;
 52:   }
 53:   private static void drawCategoryImage(Graphics2D graphics, ImageSize maxSize,
 54:       BufferedImage categoryImg, Random rand) {
 55:     graphics.drawImage(categoryImg, rand.nextInt(maxSize.getWidth() - categoryImg.getWidth()),
 56:         rand.nextInt(maxSize.getHeight() - categoryImg.getHeight()), categoryImg.getWidth(),
 57:         categoryImg.getHeight(), null);
 58:   }
 59:   private static void switchColor(Graphics2D graphics, Random rand) {
 60:     graphics.setColor(
 61:         new Color(rand.nextInt(MAX_RGB + 1), rand.nextInt(MAX_RGB + 1), rand.nextInt(MAX_RGB + 1)));
 62:   }
 63:   private static void makeRectangle(Graphics2D graphics, ImageSize maxSize, Random rand) {
 64:     switchColor(graphics, rand);
 65:     int x = rand.nextInt(maxSize.getWidth());
 66:     int y = rand.nextInt(maxSize.getHeight());
 67:     Rectangle r = new Rectangle(x, y, rand.nextInt(maxSize.getWidth() - x) + 1,
 68:         rand.nextInt(maxSize.getHeight() - y) + 1);
 69:     if (rand.nextBoolean()) {
 70:       graphics.fill(r);
 71:     }
 72:     graphics.draw(r);
 73:   }
 74:   private static void makeLine(Graphics2D graphics, ImageSize maxSize, Random rand) {
 75:     switchColor(graphics, rand);
 76:     graphics.drawLine(rand.nextInt(maxSize.getWidth()), rand.nextInt(maxSize.getHeight()),
 77:         rand.nextInt(maxSize.getWidth()), rand.nextInt(maxSize.getHeight()));
 78:   }
 79:   private static void makeOval(Graphics2D graphics, ImageSize maxSize, Random rand) {
 80:     switchColor(graphics, rand);
 81:     int x = rand.nextInt(maxSize.getWidth());
 82:     int y = rand.nextInt(maxSize.getHeight());
 83:     int width = rand.nextInt(maxSize.getWidth() - x) + 1;
 84:     int height = rand.nextInt(maxSize.getHeight() - y) + 1;
 85:     if (rand.nextBoolean()) {
 86:       graphics.fillOval(x, y, width, height);
 87:     }
 88:     graphics.drawOval(x, y, width, height);
 89:   }
 90:   private static void makeText(Graphics2D graphics, ImageSize maxSize, Random rand) {
 91:     switchColor(graphics, rand);
 92:     String fontName = Font.SANS_SERIF;
 93:     switch (rand.nextInt(4)) {
 94:     case 0:
 95:       fontName = Font.SANS_SERIF;
 96:       break;
 97:     case 1:
 98:       fontName = Font.MONOSPACED;
 99:       break;
100:     case 2:
101:       fontName = Font.SERIF;
102:       break;
103:     case 3:
104:       fontName = Font.DIALOG;
105:       break;
106:     default:
107:       fontName = Font.SANS_SERIF;
108:       break;
109:     }
110:     int fontStyle = Font.PLAIN;
111:     switch (rand.nextInt(3)) {
112:     case 0:
113:       fontStyle = Font.PLAIN;
114:       break;
115:     case 1:
116:       fontStyle = Font.BOLD;
117:       break;
118:     case 2:
119:       fontStyle = Font.ITALIC;
120:       break;
121:     default:
122:       fontStyle = Font.PLAIN;
123:       break;
124:     }
125:     int fontSize = rand.nextInt(MAX_FONT_SIZE + 1);
126:     graphics.setFont(new Font(fontName, fontStyle, fontSize));
127:     int textLength = rand.nextInt(MAX_TEXT_LENGTH + 1);
128:     String str = Stream.generate(() -> rand.nextInt(MAX_CHAR_SIZE)).limit(textLength)
129:         .map(i -> (char) i.intValue())
130:         .collect(StringBuilder::new, StringBuilder::append, StringBuilder::append).toString();
131:     graphics.drawString(str, rand.nextInt(maxSize.getWidth()), rand.nextInt(maxSize.getHeight()));
132:   }
133: }

100:         log.info("Persistence call timed out.", timeout);
101:       } catch (NullPointerException npe) {
102:         log.info("ServiceLoadBalancerResult was null!");
103:       }
104:       if (result != null && Boolean.parseBoolean(result.readEntity(String.class))) {
105:     		result.close();
106:     	  break;
107:       }
108:       try {
109:     	int nextWaitTime = SetupControllerConstants.PERSISTENCE_CREATION_MAX_WAIT_TIME;
110:     	if (waitTimes.hasNext()) {
111:     		nextWaitTime = waitTimes.next();
112:     	}
113:         log.info("Persistence not reachable. Waiting for {}ms.", nextWaitTime);
114:         Thread.sleep(nextWaitTime);
115:       } catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
116:         log.warn("Thread interrupted while waiting for persistence to be available.", interrupted);
117:       }
118:     }
119:   }
120:   private void fetchProductsForCategory(Category category, HashMap<Category, List<Long>> products) {
121:     waitForPersistence();
122:     Response result = null;
123:     try {
124:       result = ServiceLoadBalancer.loadBalanceRESTOperation(Service.PERSISTENCE, "products",
125:           Product.class,
126:           client -> ResponseWrapper.wrap(HttpWrapper.wrap(client.getService()
127:               .path(client.getApplicationURI()).path(client.getEndpointURI()).path("category")
128:               .path(String.valueOf(category.getId())).queryParam("start", 0).queryParam("max", -1))
129:               .get()));
130:     } catch (NotFoundException notFound) {
131:       log.error("No persistence found but should be online.", notFound);
132:       throw notFound;
133:     } catch (LoadBalancerTimeoutException timeout) {
134:       log.error("Persistence call timed out but should be reachable.", timeout);
135:       throw timeout;
136:     }
137:     if (result == null) {
138:       products.put(category, new ArrayList<>());
139:       log.info("No products for category {} ({}) found.", category.getName(), category.getId());
140:     } else {
141:       List<Long> tmp = convertToIDs(result.readEntity(new GenericType<List<Product>>() {
142:       }));
143:       products.put(category, tmp);
144:       result.close();
145:       log.info("Category {} ({}) contains {} products.", category.getName(), category.getId(),
146:           tmp.size());
147:     }
148:   }
149:   private List<Category> fetchCategories() {
150:     waitForPersistence();
151:     List<Category> categories = null;

153:     try {
154:       result = ServiceLoadBalancer.loadBalanceRESTOperation(Service.PERSISTENCE, "categories",
155:           Category.class,
156:           client -> ResponseWrapper.wrap(HttpWrapper.wrap(
157:               client.getService().path(client.getApplicationURI()).path(client.getEndpointURI()))
158:               .get()));
159:     } catch (NotFoundException notFound) {
160:       log.error("No persistence found but should be online.", notFound);
161:       throw notFound;
162:     } catch (LoadBalancerTimeoutException timeout) {
163:       log.error("Persistence call timed out but should be reachable.", timeout);
164:       throw timeout;
165:     }
166:     if (result == null) {
167:       log.warn("No categories found.");
168:     } else {
169:       categories = result.readEntity(new GenericType<List<Category>>() {
170:       });

173:     }
174:     if (categories == null) {
175:       return new ArrayList<Category>();
176:     }
177:     return categories;
178:   }
179:   private List<Long> convertToIDs(List<Product> products) {
180:     if (products == null) {

184:   }
185:   private HashMap<Category, BufferedImage> matchCategoriesToImage(List<Category> categories) {
186:     HashMap<Category, BufferedImage> result = new HashMap<>();
187:     List<String> imageNames = categoryImages.entrySet().stream().map(e -> e.getKey())
188:         .collect(Collectors.toList());

193:           log.info("Found matching category {} ({}) for image {}.", category.getName(),
194:               category.getId(), name + "." + StoreImage.STORE_IMAGE_FORMAT);
195:           result.put(category, categoryImages.get(name));
196:         }
197:       }

200:   }

211:         ImageSizePreset.STD_IMAGE_SIZE, workingDir, products, categoryImages, nrOfImagesGenerated);
212:     for (long i = 0; i < nrOfImagesToGenerate; i++) {

284:   public void detectExistingImages(ImageDB db) {
285:     if (db == null) {
286:       log.error("The supplied image database is null.");
287:       throw new NullPointerException("The supplied image database is null.");
288:     }
289:     String resPath = "existingimg" + File.separator + "front.png";
290:     Path dir = getPathToResource(resPath);
291:     if (dir != null) {
292:       log.info("Found resource directory with existing images at {}.",
293:           dir.toAbsolutePath().toString());
294:     } else {
295:       log.info("Resource path {} not found.", resPath);
296:       return;
297:     }
298:     File currentDir = dir.toFile();
299:     if (currentDir.exists() && currentDir.isDirectory()) {
300:       File[] fileList = currentDir.listFiles();
301:       if (fileList == null) {
302:     	  return;
303:       }
304:       for (File file : fileList) {
305:         if (file.isFile() && file.getName().endsWith(StoreImage.STORE_IMAGE_FORMAT)) {
306:           long imageID = ImageIDFactory.ID.getNextImageID();
307:           BufferedImage buffImg = null;
308:           try {
309:             buffImg = ImageIO.read(file);
310:           } catch (IOException ioException) {
311:             log.warn("An IOException occured while reading the file " + file.getAbsolutePath()
312:                 + " from disk.", ioException.getMessage());
313:           } finally {
314:             if (buffImg == null) {
315:               log.warn("The file \"" + file.toPath().toAbsolutePath() + "\" could not be read.");
316:               continue;
317:             }
318:           }
319:           db.setImageMapping(
320:               file.getName().substring(0,
321:                   file.getName().length() - StoreImage.STORE_IMAGE_FORMAT.length() - 1),
322:               imageID, new ImageSize(buffImg.getWidth(), buffImg.getHeight()));
323:           StoreImage img = new StoreImage(imageID, buffImg, ImageSizePreset.FULL.getSize());
324:           try {
325:             Files.write(workingDir.resolve(String.valueOf(imageID)), img.getByteArray(),
326:                 StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.WRITE,
327:                 StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING);
328:           } catch (IOException ioException) {
329:             log.warn("An IOException occured while writing the image with ID "
330:                 + String.valueOf(imageID) + " to the file "
331:                 + workingDir.resolve(String.valueOf(imageID)).toAbsolutePath() + ".",
332:                 ioException.getMessage());
333:           }
334:           nrOfImagesExisting++;
335:         }
336:       }
337:     }
338:     log.info("Scanned path {} for existing images. {} images found.",
339:         dir.toAbsolutePath().toString(), nrOfImagesExisting);
340:   }

378:     if (currentDir.exists() && currentDir.isDirectory()) {
379:       isDeleted = currentDir.delete();
380:     }
381:     if (isDeleted) {

387:   public void setupStorage() {
388:     Predicate<StoreImage> storagePredicate = new StoreAll<StoreImage>();
389:     switch (storageRule) {
390:     case ALL:
391:       break;
392:     case FULL_SIZE_IMG:
393:       storagePredicate = new StoreLargeImages();
394:       break;
395:     default:
396:       break;
397:     }
398:     storage = new DriveStorage(workingDir, imgDB, storagePredicate);
399:     Predicate<StoreImage> cachePredicate = null;
400:     switch (cachingRule) {
401:     case ALL:
402:       cachePredicate = new CacheAll<StoreImage>();
403:       break;
404:     default:
405:       cachePredicate = new CacheAll<StoreImage>();
406:       break;
407:     }
408:     cache = null;
409:     switch (cachingMode) {
410:     case FIFO:
411:       cache = new FirstInFirstOut<StoreImage>(storage, cacheSize, cachePredicate);
412:       break;
413:     case LIFO:
414:       cache = new LastInFirstOut<StoreImage>(storage, cacheSize, cachePredicate);
415:       break;
416:     case RR:
417:       cache = new RandomReplacement<StoreImage>(storage, cacheSize, cachePredicate);
418:       break;
419:     case LFU:
420:       cache = new LeastFrequentlyUsed<StoreImage>(storage, cacheSize, cachePredicate);
421:       break;
422:     case LRU:
423:       cache = new LeastRecentlyUsed<StoreImage>(storage, cacheSize, cachePredicate);
424:       break;
425:     case MRU:
426:       cache = new MostRecentlyUsed<StoreImage>(storage, cacheSize, cachePredicate);
427:       break;
428:     case NONE:
429:       break;
430:     default:
431:       break;
432:     }
433:     log.info("Storage setup done.");
434:   }
435:   public void configureImageProvider() {
436:     ImageProvider.IP.setImageDB(imgDB);
437:     if (cache == null) {
438:     	ImageProvider.IP.setStorage(storage);
439:     } else {
440:     	ImageProvider.IP.setStorage(cache);
441:     }
442:     log.info("Storage and image database handed over to image provider");
443:   }
444:   public Path getWorkingDir() {

446:   }

484:   private void waitAndStopImageCreation(boolean terminate, long waitTime) {
485:     if (terminate) {
486:       imgCreationPool.shutdownNow();
487:       log.info("Send termination signal to image creation thread pool.");
488:     } else {
489:       imgCreationPool.shutdown();
490:       log.info("Send shutdown signal to image creation thread pool.");
491:     }
492:     try {
493:       if (imgCreationPool.awaitTermination(waitTime, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS)) {
494:         log.info("Image creation stopped.");
495:       } else {
496:         log.warn("Image creation thread pool not terminating after {}ms. Stop waiting.", waitTime);
497:       }
498:     } catch (InterruptedException interruptedException) {
499:       log.warn("Waiting for image creation thread pool termination interrupted by exception.",
500:           interruptedException);
501:     }
502:     imgCreationPool = new ScheduledThreadPoolExecutor(
503:         SetupControllerConstants.CREATION_THREAD_POOL_SIZE);
504:   }
505:   private boolean isFirstImageProvider() {
506:     return RegistryClient.getClient().getServersForService(Service.IMAGE).size() == 0;
507:   }
508:   public void teardown() {
509:     deleteImages();
510:     deleteWorkingDir();
511:   }
512:   public void startup() {
513:     isFinished.set(false);
514:     deleteImages();
515:     deleteWorkingDir();
516:     createWorkingDir();
517:     detectExistingImages();
518:     detectCategoryImages();
519:     generateImages();
520:     setupStorage();
521:     configureImageProvider();
522:     if (!isFirstImageProvider()) {
523:       waitAndStopImageCreation(false,
524:           ((nrOfImagesToGenerate - nrOfImagesGenerated.get())
525:               / SetupControllerConstants.CREATION_THREAD_POOL_SIZE)
526:               * SetupControllerConstants.CREATION_THREAD_POOL_WAIT_PER_IMG_NR);
527:     }
528:     isFinished.set(true);
529:   }
530:   public void reconfiguration() {
531:     Thread x = new Thread() {
532:       @Override

534:         waitAndStopImageCreation(true, SetupControllerConstants.CREATION_THREAD_POOL_WAIT);

541:         setupStorage();

547:   }

  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.image.storage;
  2: import java.io.IOException;
  3: import java.nio.file.Files;
  4: import java.nio.file.Path;
  5: import java.nio.file.StandardOpenOption;
  6: import java.util.HashMap;
  7: import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReadWriteLock;
  8: import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
  9: import java.util.function.Predicate;
 10: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 11: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 12: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.ImageSize;
 13: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.ImageDB;
 14: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.StoreImage;
 15: public class DriveStorage implements IDataStorage<StoreImage> {
 16:   private Path workingDir;
 17:   private ImageDB imgDB;
 18:   private Predicate<StoreImage> storageRule;
 19:   private Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DriveStorage.class);
 20:   private final HashMap<Long, ReadWriteLock> lockedIDs = new HashMap<>();
 21:   private final ReadWriteLock mapLock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
 22:   public DriveStorage(Path workingDir, ImageDB imgDB, Predicate<StoreImage> storageRule) {
 23:     if (workingDir == null) {
 24:       log.error("The supplied working directory is null.");
 25:       throw new NullPointerException("The supplied working directory is null.");
 26:     }
 27:     if (imgDB == null) {
 28:       log.error("The supplied image database is null.");
 29:       throw new NullPointerException("The supplied image database is null.");
 30:     }
 31:     if (storageRule == null) {
 32:       log.error("The supplied rule to determine if an image can be stored is null.");
 33:       throw new NullPointerException(
 34:           "The supplied rule to determine if an image can be stored is null.");
 35:     }
 36:     this.workingDir = workingDir.normalize();
 37:     this.imgDB = imgDB;
 38:     this.storageRule = storageRule;
 39:   }
 40:   @Override
 41:   public boolean dataExists(long id) {
 42:     return workingDir.resolve(Long.toString(id)).toFile().exists();
 43:   }
 44:   private ReadWriteLock getIDLock(long id) {
 45:     ReadWriteLock l = null;
 46:     mapLock.writeLock().lock();
 47:     try {
 48:       if (lockedIDs.containsKey(id)) {
 49:         l = lockedIDs.get(id);
 50:       } else {
 51:         l = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
 52:         lockedIDs.put(id, l);
 53:       }
 54:     } finally {
 55:       mapLock.writeLock().unlock();
 56:     }
 57:     return l;
 58:   }
 59:   protected StoreImage loadFromDisk(Path imgFile, long id) {
 60:     byte[] imgData = null;
 61:     ReadWriteLock l = getIDLock(id);
 62:     l.readLock().lock();
 63:     try {
 64:       imgData = Files.readAllBytes(imgFile);
 65:     } catch (IOException ioException) {
 66:       log.warn("An IOException occured while trying to read the file \"" + imgFile.toAbsolutePath()
 67:           + "\" from disk. Returning null.", ioException);
 68:     } finally {
 69:       l.readLock().unlock();
 70:     }
 71:     if (imgData == null) {
 72:       return null;
 73:     }
 74:     ImageSize size = imgDB.getImageSize(id);
 75:     if (size == null) {
 76:       return null;
 77:     }
 78:     return new StoreImage(id, imgData, size);
 79:   }
 80:   @Override
 81:   public StoreImage loadData(long id) {
 82:     Path imgFile = workingDir.resolve(Long.toString(id));
 83:     if (!imgFile.toFile().exists()) {
 84:       return null;
 85:     }
 86:     return loadFromDisk(imgFile, id);
 87:   }
 88:   @Override
 89:   public boolean saveData(StoreImage data) {
 90:     if (!dataIsStorable(data)) {
 91:       return true;
 92:     }
 93:     Path imgFile = workingDir.resolve(Long.toString(data.getId()));
 94:     if (imgFile.toFile().exists()) {
 95:       return true;
 96:     }
 97:     ReadWriteLock l = getIDLock(data.getId());
 98:     l.writeLock().lock();
 99:     try {
100:       Files.write(imgFile, data.getByteArray(), StandardOpenOption.CREATE, StandardOpenOption.WRITE,
101:           StandardOpenOption.TRUNCATE_EXISTING);
102:     } catch (IOException ioException) {
103:       log.warn("An IOException occured while trying to write the file \"" + imgFile.toAbsolutePath()
104:           + "\" to disk.", ioException);
105:       return false;
106:     } finally {
107:       l.writeLock().unlock();
108:     }
109:     return true;
110:   }
111:   @Override
112:   public boolean dataIsStorable(StoreImage data) {
113:     return storageRule.test(data);
114:   }
115:   @Override
116:   public boolean deleteData(StoreImage data) {
117:     Path imgFile = workingDir.resolve(Long.toString(data.getId()));
118:     if (!imgFile.toFile().exists()) {
119:       return true;
120:     }
121:     boolean result = false;
122:     ReadWriteLock l = getIDLock(data.getId());
123:     l.writeLock().lock();
124:     try {
125:       result = imgFile.toFile().delete();
126:     } finally {
127:       l.writeLock().unlock();
128:     }
129:     return result;
130:   }
131: }

  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.image;
  2: import java.awt.image.BufferedImage;
  3: import java.io.ByteArrayInputStream;
  4: import java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream;
  5: import java.io.IOException;
  6: import java.util.Arrays;
  7: import java.util.Base64;
  8: import javax.imageio.ImageIO;
  9: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 10: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 11: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.ImageSize;
 12: import tools.descartes.teastore.image.cache.entry.ICachable;
 13: public class StoreImage implements ICachable<StoreImage> {
 14:   public static final String STORE_IMAGE_FORMAT = "png";
 15:   public static final String STORE_IMAGE_DATA_STRING = "data:image/" + STORE_IMAGE_FORMAT
 16:       + ";base64,";
 17:   private final long id;
 18:   private byte[] data;
 19:   private ImageSize size;
 20:   private Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(StoreImage.class);
 21:   public StoreImage(final long id, BufferedImage image, ImageSize size) {
 22:     if (image == null) {
 23:       log.error("Supplied image is null.");
 24:       throw new NullPointerException("Supplied image is null.");
 25:     }
 26:     this.id = id;
 27:     setImage(image);
 28:     setImageSize(size);
 29:   }
 30:   public StoreImage(final long id, byte[] base64, ImageSize size) {
 31:     if (base64 == null) {
 32:       log.error("Supplied base64 encoded byte array is null.");
 33:       throw new NullPointerException("Supplied base64 encoded byte array is null.");
 34:     }
 35:     this.id = id;
 36:     data = Arrays.copyOf(base64, base64.length);
 37:     setImageSize(size);
 38:   }
 39:   private void setImageSize(ImageSize size) {
 40:     if (size == null) {
 41:       log.error("Supplied image size is null.");
 42:       throw new NullPointerException("Supplied image size is null.");
 43:     }
 44:     this.size = size;
 45:   }
 46:   public StoreImage(StoreImage image) {
 47:     if (image == null) {
 48:       log.error("Supplied store image is null.");
 49:       throw new NullPointerException("Store image is null.");
 50:     }
 51:     this.id = image.getId();
 52:     this.data = Arrays.copyOf(image.getByteArray(), image.getByteArray().length);
 53:     this.size = image.getSize();
 54:   }
 55:   public long getId() {
 56:     return id;
 57:   }
 58:   private void setImage(BufferedImage image) {
 59:     ByteArrayOutputStream stream = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
 60:     try {
 61:       ImageIO.write(image, STORE_IMAGE_FORMAT, stream);
 62:     } catch (IOException ioException) {
 63:       log.warn("An IOException occured while trying to write image to a stream.", ioException);
 64:     }
 65:     data = Base64.getEncoder().encode(stream.toByteArray());
 66:   }
 67:   public BufferedImage getImage() {
 68:     BufferedImage image = null;
 69:     ByteArrayInputStream stream = new ByteArrayInputStream(Base64.getDecoder().decode(data));
 70:     try {
 71:       image = ImageIO.read(stream);
 72:     } catch (IOException ioException) {
 73:       log.warn("An IOException occured while trying to read image from stream.", ioException);
 74:     }
 75:     return image;
 76:   }
 77:   public ImageSize getSize() {
 78:     return size;
 79:   }
 80:   @Override
 81:   public long getByteSize() {
 82:     return data.length;
 83:   }
 84:   public String getBase64() {
 85:     return new String(data);
 86:   }
 87:   public byte[] getByteArray() {
 88:     return Arrays.copyOf(data, data.length);
 89:   }
 90:   @Override
 91:   public String toString() {
 92:     return STORE_IMAGE_DATA_STRING + getBase64();
 93:   }
 94:   @Override
 95:   public int hashCode() {
 96:     final int prime = 31;
 97:     int result = 1;
 98:     result = prime * result + (int) (id ^ (id >>> 32));
 99:     return result;
100:   }
101:   @Override
102:   public boolean equals(Object obj) {
103:     if (this == obj) {
104:       return true;
105:     }
106:     if (obj == null) {
107:       return false;
108:     }
109:     if (getClass() != obj.getClass()) {
110:       return false;
111:     }
112:     StoreImage other = (StoreImage) obj;
113:     if (id != other.getId()) {
114:       return false;
115:     }
116:     return true;
117:   }
118: }

File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.persistence/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/persistence/daemons/InitialDataGenerationDaemon.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.persistence.daemons;
 2: import javax.persistence.PersistenceException;
 3: import javax.servlet.ServletContextEvent;
 4: import javax.servlet.ServletContextListener;
 5: import javax.servlet.annotation.WebListener;
 6: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 7: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 8: import io.opentracing.util.GlobalTracer;
 9: import tools.descartes.teastore.persistence.repository.DataGenerator;
10: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.RegistryClient;
11: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.Service;
12: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.tracing.Tracing;
13: @WebListener
14: public class InitialDataGenerationDaemon implements ServletContextListener {
15:   private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(InitialDataGenerationDaemon.class);
16:   private static final long DATABASE_OFFLINE_WAIT_MS = 2000;
17:   public InitialDataGenerationDaemon() {
18:   }
19:   public void contextDestroyed(ServletContextEvent event) {
20:     RegistryClient.getClient().unregister(event.getServletContext().getContextPath());
21:   }
22:   public void contextInitialized(ServletContextEvent event) {
23:     GlobalTracer.register(Tracing.init(Service.PERSISTENCE.getServiceName()));
24:     waitForDatabase();
25:     if (DataGenerator.GENERATOR.isDatabaseEmpty()) {
26:       LOG.info("Database is empty. Generating new database content");
27:       DataGenerator.GENERATOR.generateDatabaseContent(DataGenerator.SMALL_DB_CATEGORIES,
28:           DataGenerator.SMALL_DB_PRODUCTS_PER_CATEGORY, DataGenerator.SMALL_DB_USERS,
29:           DataGenerator.SMALL_DB_MAX_ORDERS_PER_USER);
30:     } else {
31:       LOG.info("Populated database found. Skipping data generation");
32:     }
33:     LOG.info("Persistence finished initializing database");
34:     RegistryClient.getClient().register(event.getServletContext().getContextPath());
35:     LOG.info("Persistence started registration daemon");
36:   }
37:   private void waitForDatabase() {
38:     boolean databaseOffline = true;
39:     while (databaseOffline) {
40:       try {
41:         DataGenerator.GENERATOR.isDatabaseEmpty();
42:         databaseOffline = false;
43:       } catch (PersistenceException e) {
44:         LOG.warn("Exception connecting to database. Is database offline? Wating for "
45:             + DATABASE_OFFLINE_WAIT_MS + " ms.");
46:         try {
47:           Thread.sleep(DATABASE_OFFLINE_WAIT_MS);
48:         } catch (InterruptedException e1) {
49:           LOG.error("Exception waiting for database to come online: " + e1.getMessage());
50:         }
51:       }
52:     }
53:   }
54: }

11: 		PersistenceCategory category = new PersistenceCategory();

13: 		category.setDescription(entity.getDescription());
14: 		EntityManager em = getEM();
15: 	    try {
16: 	        em.getTransaction().begin();
17:         	em.persist(category);
18: 	        em.getTransaction().commit();
19: 	    } finally {
20: 	        em.close();
21: 	    }
22: 	    return category.getId();
23: 	}

31: 	        if (category != null) {
32: 	        	category.setName(entity.getName());
33: 	        	category.setDescription(entity.getDescription());
34: 	        	found = true;
35: 	        }
36: 	        em.getTransaction().commit();
37: 	    } finally {
38: 	        em.close();

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.persistence.domain.converters;
 2: import java.sql.Date;
 3: import java.time.LocalDate;
 4: import javax.persistence.AttributeConverter;
 5: import javax.persistence.Converter;
 6: @Converter(autoApply = true)
 7: public class LocalDateAttributeConverter implements AttributeConverter<LocalDate, Date> {
 8:     @Override
 9:     public Date convertToDatabaseColumn(LocalDate locDate) {
10:     	if (locDate == null) {
11:     		return null;
12:     	}
13:     	return Date.valueOf(locDate);
14:     }
15:     @Override
16:     public LocalDate convertToEntityAttribute(Date sqlDate) {
17:     	if (sqlDate == null) {
18:     		return null;
19:     	}
20:     	return sqlDate.toLocalDate();
21:     }
22: }

 17: 		EntityManager em = getEM();
 18: 	    try {
 19: 	        em.getTransaction().begin();
 20: 	        PersistenceProduct prod = em.find(PersistenceProduct.class, entity.getProductId());

 23: 	        	item.setProduct(prod);

 26: 	        } else {
 27: 	        	item.setId(-1L);
 28: 	        }

 40: 	        PersistenceProduct product = em.find(getEntityClass(), id);
 41: 	        if (product != null) {
 42: 	        	product.setName(entity.getName());
 43: 	        	product.setDescription(entity.getDescription());
 44: 	        	product.setListPriceInCents(entity.getListPriceInCents());
 45: 	        	found = true;
 46: 	        }

 48: 	    } finally {
 49: 	        em.close();
 50: 	    }

 58: 	        PersistenceCategory cat = em.find(PersistenceCategory.class, categoryId);
 59: 	        if (cat != null) {
 60: 	        	TypedQuery<PersistenceProduct> allMatchesQuery =
 61: 	        			em.createQuery("SELECT u FROM " + getEntityClass().getName()
 62: 	        					+ " u WHERE u.category = :cat", getEntityClass());
 63: 	        	allMatchesQuery.setParameter("cat", cat);

 65: 	        }
