File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.persistence/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/persistence/repository/AbstractPersistenceRepository.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.persistence.repository;
 2: import java.util.ArrayList;
 3: import java.util.List;
 4: import javax.persistence.EntityManager;
 5: import javax.persistence.EntityManagerFactory;
 6: import javax.persistence.TypedQuery;
 7: public abstract class AbstractPersistenceRepository<E, P extends E> {
 8: 	protected abstract long getId(P p);
 9: 	protected abstract Class<P> getEntityClass();
10: 	public EntityManagerFactory getEMF() {
11: 		return EMFManager.getEMF();
12: 	}
13: 	protected EntityManager getEM() {
14: 		return getEMF().createEntityManager();
15: 	}
16: 	public abstract long createEntity(E entity);
17: 	public abstract boolean updateEntity(long id, E entity);
18: 	public P getEntity(long id) {
19: 		P instance = null;
20: 		EntityManager em = getEM();
21: 	    try {
22: 	        instance = em.find(getEntityClass(), id);
23: 	    } finally {
24: 	        em.close();
25: 	    }
26: 		return instance;
27: 	}
28: 	public List<P> getAllEntities() {
29: 		return getAllEntities(-1, -1);
30: 	}
31: 	public List<P> getAllEntities(int start, int limit) {
32: 		EntityManager em = getEM();
33: 		List<P> entities = null;
34: 		try {
35: 			TypedQuery<P> allMatchesQuery =
36: 					em.createQuery("SELECT u FROM " + getEntityClass().getName() + " u", getEntityClass());
37: 			if (start >= 0) {
38: 				allMatchesQuery = allMatchesQuery.setFirstResult(start);
39: 		    }
40: 			if (limit >= 0) {
41: 				allMatchesQuery = allMatchesQuery.setMaxResults(limit);
42: 			}
43: 			entities = allMatchesQuery.getResultList();
44: 		} finally {
45: 			em.close();
46: 		}
47: 		if (entities == null) {
48: 			entities = new ArrayList<P>();
49: 		}
50: 		return entities;
51: 	}
52: 	public boolean removeEntity(long id) {
53: 		boolean found = false;
54: 		EntityManager em = getEM();
55: 	    try {
56: 	        em.getTransaction().begin();
57: 	        P entity = em.find(getEntityClass(), id);
58: 	        if (entity != null) {
59: 	        	em.remove(entity);
60: 	        	found = true;
61: 	        }
62: 	        em.getTransaction().commit();
63: 	    } finally {
64: 	        em.close();
65: 	    }
66: 	    return found;
67: 	}
68: 	protected List<P> resultsWithStartAndLimit(EntityManager em, TypedQuery<P> query, int start, int limit) {
69: 		if (start >= 0) {
70: 			query.setFirstResult(start);
71: 	    }
72: 		if (limit >= 0) {
73: 			query = query.setMaxResults(limit);
74: 		}
75: 		return query.getResultList();
76: 	}
77: }

11: 	public static final CacheManager MANAGER = new CacheManager();
12: 	private CacheManager() {
13: 	}
14: 	public void clearAllCaches() {
15: 		CategoryRepository.REPOSITORY.getEMF().getCache().evictAll();
16: 		try {
17: 			ServiceLoadBalancer.multicastRESTToOtherServiceInstances(ENDPOINTURI, String.class,
18: 					client -> clearRemoteCacheREST(client, null));
19: 		} catch (Exception e) {
20: 		}
21: 	}
22: 	public void clearCache(Class<?> entityClass) {
23: 		clearLocalCacheOnly(entityClass);
24: 		clearRemoteCache(entityClass);
25: 	}
26: 	public List<String> clearRemoteCache(Class<?> entityClass) {
27: 		List<String> responses = null;
28: 		try {
29: 			responses = ServiceLoadBalancer.multicastRESTToOtherServiceInstances(ENDPOINTURI, String.class,
30: 					client -> clearRemoteCacheREST(client, entityClass));
31: 		} catch (Exception e) {
32: 		}
33: 		return responses;
34: 	}
35: 	public void clearLocalCacheOnly(Class<?> entityClass) {
36: 		CategoryRepository.REPOSITORY.getEMF().getCache().evict(entityClass);
37: 	}
38: 	public void clearLocalCacheOnly() {
39: 		CategoryRepository.REPOSITORY.getEMF().getCache().evictAll();
40: 	}
41: 	private String clearRemoteCacheREST(RESTClient<String> client, Class<?> entityClass) {
42: 		WebTarget target = client.getService().path(client.getApplicationURI())
43: 				.path(client.getEndpointURI());
44: 		if (entityClass != null) {
45: 			target = target.path("class").path(entityClass.getName());
46: 		} else {
47: 			target = target.path("cache");
48: 		}
49: 		Response response = target.request(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN).delete();
50: 		String message = null;
51: 		if (response.getStatus() == 200) {
52: 			message = response.readEntity(String.class);
53: 		}
54: 		response.close();
55: 		return message;
56: 	}
57: 	public List<String> resetAllEMFs() {
58: 		resetLocalEMF();
59: 		return resetRemoteEMFs();
60: 	}
61: 	public List<String> resetRemoteEMFs() {
62: 		List<String> responses = null;
63: 		try {
64: 			responses = ServiceLoadBalancer.multicastRESTToOtherServiceInstances(ENDPOINTURI, String.class,
65: 					client -> resetRemoteEMF(client));
66: 		} catch (Exception e) {
67: 		}
68: 		return responses;
69: 	}
70: 	public void resetLocalEMF() {
71: 		EMFManager.clearEMF();
72: 	}
73: 	private String resetRemoteEMF(RESTClient<String> client) {
74: 		WebTarget target = client.getEndpointTarget().path("emf");
75: 		Response response = target.request(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN).delete();
76: 		String message = null;
77: 		if (response.getStatus() == 200) {
78: 			message = response.readEntity(String.class);
79: 		}
80: 		response.close();
81: 		return message;
82: 	}

131: 			} else {

201: 				Category preferred = categories.get(random.nextInt(categories.size()));

212: 	private OrderItem generateOrderItem(Order order, Category preferred, int productsPerCategory) {
213: 		OrderItem item = new OrderItem();
214: 		item.setOrderId(order.getId());
215: 		item.setQuantity(random.nextInt(7));
216: 		Category itemCategory = preferred;

218: 			List<PersistenceCategory> categories = CategoryRepository.REPOSITORY.getAllEntities();
219: 			itemCategory = categories.get(random.nextInt(categories.size()));
220: 		}
221: 		Product product = ProductRepository.REPOSITORY.getAllEntities(
222: 				itemCategory.getId(), random.nextInt(productsPerCategory), 1).get(0);
223: 		item.setProductId(product.getId());
224: 		item.setUnitPriceInCents(product.getListPriceInCents());
225: 		return item;
226: 	}

231: 		CacheManager.MANAGER.clearLocalCacheOnly();

233: 		SchemaManager schemaManager = new SchemaManager(session);
234: 		schemaManager.replaceDefaultTables(true, true);

240: 	private void setGenerationFinishedFlag(boolean flag) {
241: 		EntityManager em = CategoryRepository.REPOSITORY.getEM();
242: 		try {
243: 			em.getTransaction().begin();
244: 			List<DatabaseManagementEntity> entities =
245: 					em.createQuery("SELECT u FROM "
246: 							+ DatabaseManagementEntity.class.getName()
247: 							+ " u", DatabaseManagementEntity.class)
248: 					.getResultList();
249: 			if (entities == null || entities.isEmpty()) {
250: 				DatabaseManagementEntity entity = new DatabaseManagementEntity();
251: 				entity.setFinishedGenerating(flag);
252: 				em.persist(entity);
253: 			} else {
254: 				DatabaseManagementEntity entity = entities.get(0);
255: 				entity.setFinishedGenerating(flag);
256: 			}
257: 			em.getTransaction().commit();
258: 		} finally {
259: 			em.close();
260: 		}
261: 	}
262: 	public boolean getGenerationFinishedFlag() {
263: 		if (isMaintenanceMode()) {
264: 			return false;
265: 		}
266: 		boolean finishedGenerating = false;
267: 		EntityManager em = CategoryRepository.REPOSITORY.getEM();
268: 		try {
269: 			List<DatabaseManagementEntity> entities =
270: 					em.createQuery("SELECT u FROM "
271: 							+ DatabaseManagementEntity.class.getName()
272: 							+ " u", DatabaseManagementEntity.class)
273: 					.getResultList();
274: 			if (entities != null && !entities.isEmpty()) {
275: 				finishedGenerating = entities.get(0).isFinishedGenerating();
276: 			}
277: 		} finally {
278: 			em.close();
279: 		}
280: 		return finishedGenerating;
281: 	}
282: 	public boolean isMaintenanceMode() {
283: 		return maintenanceMode;
284: 	}
285: 	public synchronized void setMaintenanceModeInternal(boolean maintenanceMode) {
286: 		this.maintenanceMode = maintenanceMode;
287: 	}
288: 	public void setMaintenanceModeGlobal(boolean maintenanceMode) {
289: 		setMaintenanceModeInternal(maintenanceMode);
290: 		List<Response> rs = ServiceLoadBalancer.multicastRESTToOtherServiceInstances(
291: 				"generatedb", String.class, client -> setMaintenanceModeExternal(client, maintenanceMode));
292: 		rs.forEach(r -> {
293: 				if (r != null) {
294: 					r.bufferEntity();
295: 					r.close();
296: 				}
297: 			});
298: 	}
299: 	private Response setMaintenanceModeExternal(RESTClient<String> client, final Boolean maintenanceMode) {
300: 		Response r = client.getEndpointTarget().path("maintenance")
301: 		.request(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN).post(Entity.entity(String.valueOf(maintenanceMode), MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN));
302: 		return r;
303: 	}

 12: 	private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(EMFManager.class);
 13: 	private static final String DRIVER_PROPERTY = "javax.persistence.jdbc.driver";
 14: 	private static final String IN_MEMORY_DRIVER_VALUE = "org.hsqldb.jdbcDriver";
 15: 	private static final String JDBC_URL_PROPERTY = "javax.persistence.jdbc.url";
 16: 	private static final String IN_MEMORY_JDBC_URL_VALUE = "jdbc:hsqldb:mem:test";
 17: 	private static final String USER_PROPERTY = "javax.persistence.jdbc.user";
 18: 	private static final String IN_MEMORY_USER_VALUE = "sa";
 19: 	private static final String PASSWORD_PROPERTY = "javax.persistence.jdbc.password";
 20: 	private static final String IN_MEMORY_PASSWORD_VALUE = "";
 21: 	private static final String MYSQL_URL_PREFIX = "jdbc:mysql:
 22: 	private static final String MYSQL_URL_POSTFIX = "/teadb";
 23: 	private static final String MYSQL_DEFAULT_HOST = "localhost";
 24: 	private static final String MYSQL_DEFAULT_PORT = "3306";
 25: 	private EMFManager() {
 26: 	}
 27: 	static void configureEMFWithProperties(HashMap<String, String> persistenceProperties) {
 28: 		EMFManager.persistenceProperties = persistenceProperties;
 29: 		clearEMF();
 30: 	}
 31: 	static synchronized EntityManagerFactory getEMF() {
 32: 		if (emf == null) {
 33: 			HashMap<String, String> persistenceProperties = EMFManager.persistenceProperties;
 34: 			if (persistenceProperties == null) {
 35: 				persistenceProperties = createPersistencePropertiesFromJavaEnv();
 36: 			}
 37: 			emf = Persistence.createEntityManagerFactory("tools.descartes.teastore.persistence",
 38: 					persistenceProperties);
 39: 		}
 40: 		return emf;
 41: 	}
 42: 	static void clearEMF() {
 43: 		if (emf != null) {
 44: 			emf.close();
 45: 		}
 46: 		emf = null;
 47: 	}
 48: 	private static HashMap<String, String> createPersistencePropertiesFromJavaEnv() {
 49: 		HashMap<String, String> persistenceProperties = new HashMap<String, String>();
 50: 		String dbhost = null;
 51: 		String dbport = null;
 52: 		boolean useInMemoryDB = false;
 53: 		String url = MYSQL_URL_PREFIX;
 54: 		try {
 55: 			useInMemoryDB = Boolean.parseBoolean((String) new InitialContext().lookup("java:comp/env/inMemoryDB"));
 56: 			if (useInMemoryDB) {
 57: 				LOG.info("Using in-memory development database. Set Java env \"inMemoryDB\" to false to use MariaDB.");
 58: 			} else {
 59: 				LOG.info("\"inMemoryDB\" set to false. Using MariaDB/MySQL.");
 60: 			}
 61: 		} catch (NamingException e) {
 62: 			LOG.info("Using MySQL/MariaDB database.");
 63: 		}
 64: 		if (!useInMemoryDB) {
 65: 			try {
 66: 				dbhost = (String) new InitialContext().lookup("java:comp/env/databaseHost");
 67: 			} catch (NamingException e) {
 68: 				LOG.info("Database host not set. Falling back to default host at " + MYSQL_DEFAULT_HOST + ".");
 69: 			}
 70: 			try {
 71: 				dbport = (String) new InitialContext().lookup("java:comp/env/databasePort");
 72: 			} catch (NamingException e) {
 73: 				LOG.info("Database port not set. Falling back to default host at " + MYSQL_DEFAULT_PORT + ".");
 74: 			}
 75: 			if (dbhost != null || dbport != null) {
 76: 				if (dbhost != null) {
 77: 					url += dbhost;
 78: 				} else {
 79: 					url += MYSQL_DEFAULT_HOST;
 80: 				}
 81: 				url += ":";
 82: 				if (dbport != null) {
 83: 					url += dbport;
 84: 				} else {
 85: 					url += MYSQL_DEFAULT_PORT;
 86: 				}
 87: 				url += MYSQL_URL_POSTFIX;
 88: 				LOG.info("Setting jdbc url to \"" + url + "\".");
 89: 				persistenceProperties.put("javax.persistence.jdbc.url", url);
 90: 			}
 91: 		} else {
 92: 			persistenceProperties = createPersistencePropertieForInMemoryDB();
 93: 		}
 94: 		return persistenceProperties;
 95: 	}
 96: 	static HashMap<String, String> createPersistencePropertieForInMemoryDB() {
 97: 		HashMap<String, String> persistenceProperties = new HashMap<String, String>();
 98: 		persistenceProperties.put(DRIVER_PROPERTY, IN_MEMORY_DRIVER_VALUE);
 99: 		persistenceProperties.put(JDBC_URL_PROPERTY, IN_MEMORY_JDBC_URL_VALUE);
100: 		persistenceProperties.put(USER_PROPERTY, IN_MEMORY_USER_VALUE);
101: 		persistenceProperties.put(PASSWORD_PROPERTY, IN_MEMORY_PASSWORD_VALUE);
102: 		return persistenceProperties;
103: 	}
104: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.persistence.rest;
 2: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
 3: import javax.ws.rs.GET;
 4: import javax.ws.rs.POST;
 5: import javax.ws.rs.Path;
 6: import javax.ws.rs.QueryParam;
 7: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response;
 8: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response.Status;
 9: import org.slf4j.Logger;
10: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
11: import tools.descartes.teastore.persistence.repository.CacheManager;
12: import tools.descartes.teastore.persistence.repository.DataGenerator;
13: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.RegistryClient;
14: @Path("generatedb")
15: public class DatabaseGenerationEndpoint {
16: 	private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DatabaseGenerationEndpoint.class);
17: 	@GET
18: 	public Response generateDataBase(
19: 			@QueryParam("categories") final Integer categories,
20: 			@QueryParam("products") final Integer products,
21: 			@QueryParam("users") final Integer users,
22: 			@QueryParam("orders") final Integer orders) {
23: 		LOG.info("Received database generation command for Persistence at "
24: 			+ RegistryClient.getClient().getMyServiceInstanceServer() + ".");
25: 		if (DataGenerator.GENERATOR.isMaintenanceMode()) {
26: 			return Response.status(DataGenerator.MAINTENANCE_STATUS_CODE).build();
27: 		}
28: 		DataGenerator.GENERATOR.setMaintenanceModeGlobal(true);
29: 		LOG.info("Global maintenance mode enabled.");
30: 		DataGenerator.GENERATOR.dropAndCreateTables();
31: 		LOG.info("Finished dropping tables and re-initializing database schmema.");
32: 		int categoryCount = parseQuery(categories, DataGenerator.SMALL_DB_CATEGORIES);
33: 		int productCount = parseQuery(products, DataGenerator.SMALL_DB_PRODUCTS_PER_CATEGORY);
34: 		int userCount = parseQuery(users, DataGenerator.SMALL_DB_USERS);
35: 		int maxOrderCount = parseQuery(orders, DataGenerator.SMALL_DB_MAX_ORDERS_PER_USER);
36: 		LOG.info("Initializing database creation with "
37: 				+ categoryCount + " categories, "
38: 				+ productCount + " products per category, "
39: 				+ userCount + " users, "
40: 				+ maxOrderCount + " max orders per user.");
41: 		Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor().execute(() -> {
42: 			DataGenerator.GENERATOR.generateDatabaseContent(categoryCount,
43: 					productCount, userCount, maxOrderCount);
44: 			LOG.info("Finished database generation.");
45: 			CacheManager.MANAGER.resetRemoteEMFs();
46: 			LOG.info("Finished resetting all Persistence service instances.");
47: 			DataGenerator.GENERATOR.setMaintenanceModeGlobal(false);
48: 			LOG.info("Done. Maintenance mode disabled.");
49: 		});
50: 		String message = "Creating database with "
51: 				+ categoryCount + " categories, "
52: 				+ productCount + " products per category, "
53: 				+ userCount + " users, "
54: 				+ maxOrderCount + " max orders per user.";
55: 		return Response.ok(message).build();
56: 	}
57: 	private int parseQuery(Integer param, int defaultValue) {
58: 		if (param == null) {
59: 			return defaultValue;
60: 		}
61: 		return param;
62: 	}
63: 	@GET
64: 	@Path("finished")
65: 	public Response isFinshed() {
66: 		if (DataGenerator.GENERATOR.getGenerationFinishedFlag()) {
67: 			return Response.ok(true).build();
68: 		} else {
69: 			return Response.serverError().entity(false).build();
70: 		}
71: 	}
72: 	@POST
73: 	@Path("maintenance")
74: 	public Response setMaintenanceMode(final Boolean maintenanceMode) {
75: 		if (maintenanceMode == null) {
76: 			return Response.status(Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
77: 		}
78: 		DataGenerator.GENERATOR.setMaintenanceModeInternal(maintenanceMode);
79: 		return Response.ok().build();
80: 	}
81: 	@GET
82: 	@Path("maintenance")
83: 	public Response isMaintenance() {
84: 		return Response.ok(DataGenerator.GENERATOR.isMaintenanceMode()).build();
85: 	}
86: }

34: 	@Override
35: 	protected List<User> listAllEntities(final int startIndex, final int maxResultCount) {
36: 		List<User> users = new ArrayList<User>();
37: 		for (User u : UserRepository.REPOSITORY.getAllEntities(startIndex, maxResultCount)) {
38: 			users.add(new User(u));
39: 		}
40: 		return users;
41: 	}
42: 	@Override
43: 	protected boolean updateEntity(long id, User category) {
44: 		return UserRepository.REPOSITORY.updateEntity(id, category);
45: 	}
46: 	@Override
47: 	protected boolean deleteEntity(long id) {
48: 		if (DataGenerator.GENERATOR.isMaintenanceMode()) {
49: 			return false;
50: 		}
51: 		return UserRepository.REPOSITORY.removeEntity(id);
52: 	}
53: 	@GET
54: 	@Path("name/{name}")
55: 	public Response findById(@PathParam("name") final String name) {
56: 		if (name == null || name.isEmpty()) {
57: 			return Response.status(Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
58: 		}
59: 		User entity = UserRepository.REPOSITORY.getUserByName(name);
60: 		if (entity == null) {
61: 			return Response.status(Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
62: 		}
63: 		return Response.ok(new User(entity)).build();
64: 	}
65: }

 21: 	private Map<Long, Map<Long, Double>> userBuyingMatrix;
 22: 	private Map<Long, Set<OrderItemSet>> userItemSets;
 23: 	private Set<Long> totalProducts;
 24: 	@Override
 25: 	public void train(List<OrderItem> orderItems, List<Order> orders) {
 26: 		long tic = System.currentTimeMillis();
 27: 		totalProducts = new HashSet<>();
 28: 		Map<Long, OrderItemSet> unOrderizeditemSets = new HashMap<>();
 29: 		for (OrderItem orderItem : orderItems) {
 30: 			if (!unOrderizeditemSets.containsKey(orderItem.getOrderId())) {
 31: 				unOrderizeditemSets.put(orderItem.getOrderId(), new OrderItemSet());
 32: 				unOrderizeditemSets.get(orderItem.getOrderId()).setOrderId(orderItem.getOrderId());
 33: 			}
 34: 			unOrderizeditemSets.get(orderItem.getOrderId()).getOrderset().put(orderItem.getProductId(),
 35: 					orderItem.getQuantity());
 36: 			if (!totalProducts.contains(orderItem.getProductId())) {
 37: 				totalProducts.add(orderItem.getProductId());
 38: 			}
 39: 		}
 40: 		Map<Order, OrderItemSet> itemSets = new HashMap<>();
 41: 		for (Long orderid : unOrderizeditemSets.keySet()) {
 42: 			Order realOrder = findOrder(orders, orderid);
 43: 			itemSets.put(realOrder, unOrderizeditemSets.get(orderid));
 44: 		}
 45: 		userItemSets = new HashMap<>();
 46: 		for (Order order : itemSets.keySet()) {
 47: 			if (!userItemSets.containsKey(order.getUserId())) {
 48: 				userItemSets.put(order.getUserId(), new HashSet<OrderItemSet>());
 49: 			}
 50: 			itemSets.get(order).setUserId(order.getUserId());
 51: 			userItemSets.get(order.getUserId()).add(itemSets.get(order));
 52: 		}
 53: 		userBuyingMatrix = createUserBuyingMatrix(userItemSets);
 54: 		executePreprocessing();
 55: 		LOG.info("Training recommender finished. Training took: " + (System.currentTimeMillis() - tic) + "ms.");
 56: 		trainingFinished = true;
 57: 	}
 58: 	protected void executePreprocessing() {
 59: 	}
 60: 	@Override
 61: 	public List<Long> recommendProducts(Long userid, List<OrderItem> currentItems)
 62: 			throws UnsupportedOperationException {
 63: 		if (!trainingFinished) {
 64: 			throw new UnsupportedOperationException("This instance is not fully trained yet.");
 65: 		}
 66: 		if (currentItems.isEmpty()) {
 67: 			return new LinkedList<>();
 68: 		}
 69: 		List<Long> items = new ArrayList<>(currentItems.size());
 70: 		for (OrderItem item : currentItems) {
 71: 			items.add(item.getProductId());
 72: 		}
 73: 		return execute(userid, items);
 74: 	}
 75: 	protected List<Long> filterRecommendations(Map<Long, Double> priorityList, List<Long> currentItems) {
 76: 		TreeMap<Double, List<Long>> ranking = createRanking(priorityList);
 77: 		List<Long> reco = new ArrayList<>(MAX_NUMBER_OF_RECOMMENDATIONS);
 78: 		for (Double score : ranking.descendingKeySet()) {
 79: 			List<Long> productIds = ranking.get(score);
 80: 			for (long productId : productIds) {
 81: 				if (reco.size() < MAX_NUMBER_OF_RECOMMENDATIONS) {
 82: 					if (!currentItems.contains(productId)) {
 83: 						reco.add(productId);
 84: 					}
 85: 				} else {
 86: 					return reco;
 87: 				}
 88: 			}
 89: 		}
 90: 		return reco;
 91: 	}
 92: 	private TreeMap<Double, List<Long>> createRanking(Map<Long, Double> map) {
 93: 		TreeMap<Double, List<Long>> ranking = new TreeMap<Double, List<Long>>();
 94: 		for (Entry<Long, Double> entry : map.entrySet()) {
 95: 			List<Long> productIds = ranking.get(entry.getValue());
 96: 			if (productIds == null) {
 97: 				productIds = new ArrayList<>();
 98: 				ranking.put(entry.getValue(), productIds);
 99: 			}
100: 			productIds.add(entry.getKey());
101: 		}
102: 		return ranking;
103: 	}
104: 	protected abstract List<Long> execute(Long userid, List<Long> currentItems);
105: 	private Order findOrder(List<Order> orders, long orderid) {
106: 		for (Order order : orders) {
107: 			if (order.getId() == orderid) {
108: 				return order;
109: 			}
110: 		}
111: 		return null;
112: 	}
113: 	public Map<Long, Map<Long, Double>> getUserBuyingMatrix() {
114: 		return userBuyingMatrix;
115: 	}
116: 	public void setUserBuyingMatrix(Map<Long, Map<Long, Double>> userBuyingMatrix) {
117: 		this.userBuyingMatrix = userBuyingMatrix;
118: 	}
119: 	public Set<Long> getTotalProducts() {
120: 		return totalProducts;
121: 	}
122: 	public void setTotalProducts(Set<Long> totalProducts) {
123: 		this.totalProducts = totalProducts;
124: 	}
125: 	public Map<Long, Set<OrderItemSet>> getUserItemSets() {
126: 		return userItemSets;
127: 	}
128: 	public void setUserItemSets(Map<Long, Set<OrderItemSet>> userItemSets) {
129: 		this.userItemSets = userItemSets;
130: 	}
131: 	private static Map<Long, Map<Long, Double>> createUserBuyingMatrix(Map<Long, Set<OrderItemSet>> useritemsets) {
132: 		Map<Long, Map<Long, Double>> matrix = new HashMap<>();
133: 		for (Entry<Long, Set<OrderItemSet>> entry : useritemsets.entrySet()) {
134: 			Map<Long, Double> line = new HashMap<>();
135: 			for (OrderItemSet orderset : entry.getValue()) {
136: 				for (Entry<Long, Integer> product : orderset.getOrderset().entrySet()) {
137: 					if (!line.containsKey(product.getKey())) {
138: 						line.put(product.getKey(), Double.valueOf(product.getValue()));
139: 					} else {
140: 						line.put(product.getKey(), Double.valueOf(line.get(product.getKey()) + product.getValue()));
141: 					}
142: 				}
143: 			}
144: 			matrix.put(entry.getKey(), line);
145: 		}
146: 		return matrix;
147: 	}
148: }

File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.recommender/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/recommender/algorithm/impl/cf/SlopeOneRecommender.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.impl.cf;
 2: import java.util.HashMap;
 3: import java.util.List;
 4: import java.util.Map;
 5: import java.util.Map.Entry;
 6: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.AbstractRecommender;
 7: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.impl.UseFallBackException;
 8: public class SlopeOneRecommender extends AbstractRecommender {
 9: 	private Map<Long, Map<Long, Double>> differences = new HashMap<>();
10: 	private Map<Long, Map<Long, Integer>> frequencies = new HashMap<>();
11: 	public Map<Long, Map<Long, Double>> getDifferences() {
12: 		return differences;
13: 	}
14: 	public void setDifferences(Map<Long, Map<Long, Double>> differences) {
15: 		this.differences = differences;
16: 	}
17: 	public Map<Long, Map<Long, Integer>> getFrequencies() {
18: 		return frequencies;
19: 	}
20: 	public void setFrequencies(Map<Long, Map<Long, Integer>> frequencies) {
21: 		this.frequencies = frequencies;
22: 	}
23: 	@Override
24: 	protected List<Long> execute(Long userid, List<Long> currentItems) {
25: 		if (userid == null) {
26: 			throw new UseFallBackException(this.getClass().getName()
27: 					+ " does not support null userids. Use a pseudouser or switch to another approach.");
28: 		}
29: 		if (getUserBuyingMatrix().get(userid) == null) {
30: 			throw new UseFallBackException("No user information.");
31: 		}
32: 		Map<Long, Double> importances = getUserVector(userid);
33: 		return filterRecommendations(importances, currentItems);
34: 	}
35: 	protected Map<Long, Double> getUserVector(Long userid) {
36: 		HashMap<Long, Double> importances = new HashMap<>();
37: 		for (Long productid : getTotalProducts()) {
38: 			try {
39: 				importances.put(productid, calculateScoreForItem(userid, productid));
40: 			} catch (NullPointerException e) {
41: 				importances.put(productid, -1.0);
42: 			}
43: 		}
44: 		return importances;
45: 	}
46: 	private double calculateScoreForItem(long userid, long itemid) {
47: 		double score = 0;
48: 		double cumWeights = 0;
49: 		for (Entry<Long, Double> useritem : getUserBuyingMatrix().get(userid).entrySet()) {
50: 			if (useritem.getKey() == itemid) {
51: 				return useritem.getValue();
52: 			}
53: 			int frequency = frequencies.get(useritem.getKey()).get(itemid);
54: 			score += useritem.getValue() * frequency;
55: 			score += differences.get(useritem.getKey()).get(itemid) * frequency;
56: 			cumWeights += frequency;
57: 		}
58: 		return score / cumWeights;
59: 	}
60: 	@Override
61: 	protected void executePreprocessing() {
62: 		buildDifferencesMatrices(getUserBuyingMatrix());
63: 	}
64: 	private void buildDifferencesMatrices(Map<Long, Map<Long, Double>> userRatingMatrix) {
65: 		for (Map<Long, Double> uservalues : userRatingMatrix.values()) {
66: 			for (Entry<Long, Double> singleRating : uservalues.entrySet()) {
67: 				if (!frequencies.containsKey(singleRating.getKey())) {
68: 					frequencies.put(singleRating.getKey(), new HashMap<Long, Integer>());
69: 					differences.put(singleRating.getKey(), new HashMap<Long, Double>());
70: 				}
71: 				for (Entry<Long, Double> otherRating : uservalues.entrySet()) {
72: 					int currCount = 0;
73: 					Integer count = frequencies.get(singleRating.getKey()).get(otherRating.getKey());
74: 					if (count != null) {
75: 						currCount = count.intValue();
76: 					}
77: 					double currDiff = 0;
78: 					Double diff = differences.get(singleRating.getKey()).get(otherRating.getKey());
79: 					if (diff != null) {
80: 						currDiff = diff.doubleValue();
81: 					}
82: 					double userdiff = singleRating.getValue() - otherRating.getValue();
83: 					frequencies.get(singleRating.getKey()).put(otherRating.getKey(), currCount + 1);
84: 					differences.get(singleRating.getKey()).put(otherRating.getKey(), currDiff + userdiff);
85: 				}
86: 			}
87: 		}
88: 		for (Long i : differences.keySet()) {
89: 			for (Long j : differences.get(i).keySet()) {
90: 				double diffval = differences.get(i).get(j);
91: 				double freq = frequencies.get(i).get(j);
92: 				differences.get(i).put(j, diffval / freq);
93: 			}
94: 		}
95: 	}
96: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.impl.orderbased;
 2: import java.util.HashMap;
 3: import java.util.List;
 4: import java.util.Set;
 5: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.AbstractRecommender;
 6: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.OrderItemSet;
 7: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.impl.UseFallBackException;
 8: public class OrderBasedRecommender extends AbstractRecommender {
 9: 	@Override
10: 	protected List<Long> execute(Long userid, List<Long> currentItems) {
11: 		HashMap<Long, Double> counts = new HashMap<>();
12: 		for (Long product : currentItems) {
13: 			addAllCountsOfProduct(counts, product);
14: 		}
15: 		if (counts.isEmpty()) {
16: 			throw new UseFallBackException(
17: 					"No item was bought together with the current cart. Therefore, all counts are 0.");
18: 		}
19: 		return filterRecommendations(counts, currentItems);
20: 	}
21: 	private void addAllCountsOfProduct(HashMap<Long, Double> counts, Long product) {
22: 		for (Set<OrderItemSet> set : getUserItemSets().values()) {
23: 			for (OrderItemSet orderset : set) {
24: 				if (orderset.getOrderset().keySet().contains(product)) {
25: 					for (Long o : orderset.getOrderset().keySet()) {
26: 						if (counts.containsKey(o)) {
27: 							counts.put(o, counts.get(o) + 1);
28: 						} else {
29: 							counts.put(o, 1.0);
30: 						}
31: 					}
32: 				}
33: 			}
34: 		}
35: 	}
36: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm;
 2: import java.util.HashMap;
 3: import java.util.List;
 4: import java.util.Map;
 5: import javax.naming.InitialContext;
 6: import javax.naming.NamingException;
 7: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 8: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 9: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.impl.UseFallBackException;
10: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.impl.cf.PreprocessedSlopeOneRecommender;
11: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.impl.cf.SlopeOneRecommender;
12: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.impl.orderbased.OrderBasedRecommender;
13: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.impl.pop.PopularityBasedRecommender;
14: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.Order;
15: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.OrderItem;
16: public final class RecommenderSelector implements IRecommender {
17: 	private static Map<String, Class<? extends IRecommender>> recommenders = new HashMap<>();
18: 	static {
19: 		recommenders = new HashMap<String, Class<? extends IRecommender>>();
20: 		recommenders.put("Popularity", PopularityBasedRecommender.class);
21: 		recommenders.put("SlopeOne", SlopeOneRecommender.class);
22: 		recommenders.put("PreprocessedSlopeOne", PreprocessedSlopeOneRecommender.class);
23: 		recommenders.put("OrderBased", OrderBasedRecommender.class);
24: 	}
25: 	private static final Class<? extends IRecommender> DEFAULT_RECOMMENDER = SlopeOneRecommender.class;
26: 	private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RecommenderSelector.class);
27: 	private static RecommenderSelector instance;
28: 	private IRecommender fallbackrecommender;
29: 	private IRecommender recommender;
30: 	private RecommenderSelector() {
31: 		fallbackrecommender = new PopularityBasedRecommender();
32: 		try {
33: 			String recommendername = (String) new InitialContext().lookup("java:comp/env/recommenderAlgorithm");
34: 			if (recommenders.containsKey(recommendername)) {
35: 				recommender = recommenders.get(recommendername).newInstance();
36: 			} else {
37: 				LOG.warn("Recommendername: " + recommendername
38: 						+ " was not found. Using default recommender (SlopeOneRecommeder).");
39: 				recommender = DEFAULT_RECOMMENDER.newInstance();
40: 			}
41: 		} catch (InstantiationException | IllegalAccessException e) {
42: 			e.printStackTrace();
43: 			LOG.warn("Could not create an instance of the requested recommender. Using fallback.");
44: 			recommender = fallbackrecommender;
45: 		} catch (NamingException e) {
46: 			LOG.info("Recommender not set. Using default recommender (SlopeOneRecommeder).");
47: 			try {
48: 				recommender = DEFAULT_RECOMMENDER.newInstance();
49: 			} catch (InstantiationException | IllegalAccessException e1) {
50: 				e1.printStackTrace();
51: 				LOG.warn("Could not create an instance of DEFAULT_RECOMMENDER " + DEFAULT_RECOMMENDER.getName() + ".");
52: 				recommender = fallbackrecommender;
53: 			}
54: 		}
55: 	}
56: 	@Override
57: 	public List<Long> recommendProducts(Long userid, List<OrderItem> currentItems)
58: 			throws UnsupportedOperationException {
59: 		try {
60: 			return recommender.recommendProducts(userid, currentItems);
61: 		} catch (UseFallBackException e) {
62: 			LOG.trace("Executing " + recommender.getClass().getName()
63: 					+ " as recommender failed. Using fallback recommender. Reason:\n" + e.getMessage());
64: 			return fallbackrecommender.recommendProducts(userid, currentItems);
65: 		} catch (UnsupportedOperationException e) {
66: 			LOG.error("Executing " + recommender.getClass().getName()
67: 					+ " threw an UnsupportedOperationException. The recommender was not finished with training.");
68: 			throw e;
69: 		} catch (Exception e) {
70: 			LOG.warn("Executing " + recommender.getClass().getName()
71: 					+ " threw an unexpected error. Using fallback recommender. Reason:\n" + e.getMessage());
72: 			return fallbackrecommender.recommendProducts(userid, currentItems);
73: 		}
74: 	}
75: 	public static synchronized RecommenderSelector getInstance() {
76: 		if (instance == null) {
77: 			 instance = new RecommenderSelector();
78: 		}
79: 		return instance;
80: 	}
81: 	@Override
82: 	public void train(List<OrderItem> orderItems, List<Order> orders) {
83: 		recommender.train(orderItems, orders);
84: 		fallbackrecommender.train(orderItems, orders);
85: 	}
86: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.rest;
 2: import javax.ws.rs.GET;

 8: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.Order;

10: @Path("train")
11: @Produces({ "text/plain", "application/json" })
12: public class TrainEndpoint {
13: 	@GET
14: 	public Response train() {
15: 		try {
16: 			long start = System.currentTimeMillis();
17: 			long number = TrainingSynchronizer.getInstance().retrieveDataAndRetrain();
18: 			long time = System.currentTimeMillis() - start;
19: 			if (number != -1) {
20: 				return Response.ok("The (re)train was succesfully done. It took " + time + "ms and " + number
21: 						+ " of Orderitems were retrieved from the database.").build();
22: 			}
23: 		} catch (Exception e) {
24: 			e.printStackTrace();
25: 		}
26: 		return Response.status(Response.Status.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR.getStatusCode())
27: 				.entity("The (re)trainprocess failed.").build();
28: 	}
29: 	@GET
30: 	@Path("timestamp")
31: 	public Response getTimeStamp() {
32: 		if (TrainingSynchronizer.getInstance().getMaxTime() == TrainingSynchronizer.DEFAULT_MAX_TIME_VALUE) {
33: 			return Response.status(Response.Status.PRECONDITION_FAILED.getStatusCode())
34: 					.entity("The collection of the current maxTime was not possible.").build();
35: 		}
36: 		return Response.ok(TrainingSynchronizer.getInstance().getMaxTime()).build();
37: 	}
38: 	@GET
39: 	@Path("isready")
40: 	public Response isReady() {
41: 		if (TrainingSynchronizer.getInstance().isReady()) {
42: 			return Response.ok(true).build();
43: 		} else {
44: 			return Response.serverError().entity(false).build();
45: 		}
46: 	}
47: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.servlet;
 2: import javax.naming.InitialContext;
 3: import javax.naming.NamingException;
 4: import javax.servlet.ServletContextEvent;
 5: import javax.servlet.ServletContextListener;
 6: import javax.servlet.annotation.WebListener;

 8: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;

10: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.RegistryClient;
11: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.Service;

13: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.tracing.Tracing;
14: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.RESTClient;
15: @WebListener
16: public class RecommenderStartup implements ServletContextListener {
17: 	private static final int REST_READ_TIMOUT = 1750;
18: 	private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RecommenderStartup.class);
19: 	public RecommenderStartup() {
20: 	}
21: 	public void contextDestroyed(ServletContextEvent event) {
22: 		RegistryClient.getClient().unregister(event.getServletContext().getContextPath());
23: 	}
24: 	public void contextInitialized(ServletContextEvent event) {
25: 		GlobalTracer.register(Tracing.init(Service.RECOMMENDER.getServiceName()));
26: 		RESTClient.setGlobalReadTimeout(REST_READ_TIMOUT);
27: 		ServiceLoadBalancer.preInitializeServiceLoadBalancers(Service.PERSISTENCE);
28: 		RegistryClient.getClient().runAfterServiceIsAvailable(Service.PERSISTENCE, () -> {
29: 			TrainingSynchronizer.getInstance().retrieveDataAndRetrain();
30: 			RegistryClient.getClient().register(event.getServletContext().getContextPath());
31: 		}, Service.RECOMMENDER);
32: 		try {
33: 			long looptime = (Long) new InitialContext().lookup("java:comp/env/recommenderLoopTime");
34: 			if (looptime > 0) {
35: 				new RetrainDaemon(looptime).start();
36: 				LOG.info("Periodic retraining every " + looptime + " milliseconds");
37: 			} else {
38: 				LOG.info("Recommender loop time not set. Disabling periodic retraining.");
39: 			}
40: 		} catch (NamingException e) {
41: 			LOG.info("Recommender loop time not set. Disabling periodic retraining.");
42: 		}
43: 	}
44: }

File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.recommender/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/recommender/servlet/RetrainDaemon.java

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.servlet;
 2: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.RegistryClient;
 3: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.Service;
 4: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.StartupCallback;
 5: public class RetrainDaemon extends Thread {
 6: 	private long looptime;
 7: 	public RetrainDaemon(long looptime) {
 8: 		super();
 9: 		setDaemon(true);
10: 		this.looptime = looptime;
11: 	}
12: 	@Override
13: 	public void run() {
14: 		super.run();
15: 		while (true) {
16: 			try {
17: 				Thread.sleep(looptime);
18: 			} catch (InterruptedException e) {
19: 				e.printStackTrace();
20: 			}
21: 			RegistryClient.getClient().runAfterServiceIsAvailable(Service.PERSISTENCE, new StartupCallback() {
22: 				@Override
23: 				public void callback() {
24: 					TrainingSynchronizer.getInstance().retrieveDataAndRetrain();
25: 				}
26: 			}, Service.RECOMMENDER);
27: 		}
28: 	}
29: }

File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.recommender/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/recommender/servlet/TrainingSynchronizer.java
================
  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.servlet;
  2: import java.time.Instant;
  3: import java.time.LocalDateTime;
  4: import java.time.ZoneId;
  5: import java.time.ZonedDateTime;
  6: import java.time.format.DateTimeFormatter;
  7: import java.time.temporal.TemporalAccessor;
  8: import java.util.ArrayList;
  9: import java.util.Arrays;
 10: import java.util.Iterator;
 11: import java.util.List;
 12: import javax.ws.rs.core.MediaType;
 13: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response;
 14: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 15: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 16: import tools.descartes.teastore.recommender.algorithm.RecommenderSelector;
 17: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.Service;
 18: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers.LoadBalancerTimeoutException;
 19: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers.ServiceLoadBalancer;
 20: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.rest.LoadBalancedCRUDOperations;
 21: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.NotFoundException;
 22: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.Order;
 23: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.OrderItem;
 24: public final class TrainingSynchronizer {
 25: 	public static final long DEFAULT_MAX_TIME_VALUE = Long.MIN_VALUE;
 26: 	private static final int PERSISTENCE_CREATION_MAX_WAIT_TIME = 120000;
 27: 	private static final List<Integer> PERSISTENCE_CREATION_WAIT_TIME = Arrays.asList(1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 30000,
 28: 			60000);
 29: 	private static TrainingSynchronizer instance;
 30: 	private boolean isReady = false;
 31: 	public boolean isReady() {
 32: 		return isReady;
 33: 	}
 34: 	public void setReady(boolean isReady) {
 35: 		this.isReady = isReady;
 36: 	}
 37: 	private TrainingSynchronizer() {
 38: 	}
 39: 	public static synchronized TrainingSynchronizer getInstance() {
 40: 		if (instance == null) {
 41: 			instance = new TrainingSynchronizer();
 42: 		}
 43: 		return instance;
 44: 	}
 45: 	private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TrainingSynchronizer.class);
 46: 	private long maxTime = DEFAULT_MAX_TIME_VALUE;
 47: 	public long getMaxTime() {
 48: 		return maxTime;
 49: 	}
 50: 	public void setMaxTime(String maxTime) {
 51: 		setMaxTime(toMillis(maxTime));
 52: 	}
 53: 	public void setMaxTime(long maxTime) {
 54: 		this.maxTime = maxTime;
 55: 	}
 56: 	private void waitForPersistence() {
 57: 		Iterator<Integer> waitTimes = PERSISTENCE_CREATION_WAIT_TIME.iterator();
 58: 		while (true) {
 59: 			Response result = null;
 60: 			try {
 61: 				result = ServiceLoadBalancer.loadBalanceRESTOperation(Service.PERSISTENCE, "generatedb", String.class,
 62: 						client -> client.getService().path(client.getApplicationURI()).path(client.getEndpointURI())
 63: 								.path("finished").request().get());
 64: 								if (result != null && Boolean.parseBoolean(result.readEntity(String.class))) {
 65: 									break;
 66: 				}
 67: 			} catch (NullPointerException | NotFoundException | LoadBalancerTimeoutException e) {
 68: 			} finally {
 69: 				if (result != null) {
 70: 					result.close();
 71: 				}
 72: 			}
 73: 			try {
 74: 				int nextWaitTime;
 75: 				if (waitTimes.hasNext()) {
 76: 					nextWaitTime = waitTimes.next();
 77: 				} else {
 78: 					nextWaitTime = PERSISTENCE_CREATION_MAX_WAIT_TIME;
 79: 				}
 80: 				LOG.info("Persistence not reachable. Waiting for {}ms.", nextWaitTime);
 81: 				Thread.sleep(nextWaitTime);
 82: 			} catch (InterruptedException interrupted) {
 83: 				LOG.warn("Thread interrupted while waiting for persistence to be available.", interrupted);
 84: 			}
 85: 		}
 86: 	}
 87: 	public long retrieveDataAndRetrain() {
 88: 		setReady(false);
 89: 		LOG.trace("Retrieving data objects from database...");
 90: 		waitForPersistence();
 91: 		List<OrderItem> items = null;
 92: 		List<Order> orders = null;
 93: 		try {
 94: 			items = LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntities(Service.PERSISTENCE, "orderitems", OrderItem.class, -1, -1);
 95: 			long noItems = items.size();
 96: 			LOG.trace("Retrieved " + noItems + " orderItems, starting retrieving of orders now.");
 97: 		} catch (NotFoundException | LoadBalancerTimeoutException e) {
 98: 			setReady(true);
 99: 			LOG.error("Database retrieving failed.");
100: 			return -1;
101: 		}
102: 		try {
103: 			orders = LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntities(Service.PERSISTENCE, "orders", Order.class, -1, -1);
104: 			long noOrders = orders.size();
105: 			LOG.trace("Retrieved " + noOrders + " orders, starting training now.");
106: 		} catch (NotFoundException | LoadBalancerTimeoutException e) {
107: 			setReady(true);
108: 			LOG.error("Database retrieving failed.");
109: 			return -1;
110: 		}
111: 		filterLists(items, orders);
112: 		RecommenderSelector.getInstance().train(items, orders);
113: 		LOG.trace("Finished training, ready for recommendation.");
114: 		setReady(true);
115: 		return items.size() + orders.size();
116: 	}
117: 	private void filterLists(List<OrderItem> orderItems, List<Order> orders) {
118: 		List<Response> maxTimeResponses = ServiceLoadBalancer.multicastRESTOperation(Service.RECOMMENDER,
119: 				"train/timestamp", Response.class,
120: 				client -> client.getService().path(client.getApplicationURI()).path(client.getEndpointURI())
121: 						.request(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN).accept(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN).get());
122: 		for (Response response : maxTimeResponses) {
123: 			if (response == null) {
124: 				LOG.warn("One service response was null and is therefore not available for time-check.");
125: 			} else if (response.getStatus() == Response.Status.OK.getStatusCode()) {
126: 				long milliTS = response.readEntity(Long.class);
127: 				if (maxTime != TrainingSynchronizer.DEFAULT_MAX_TIME_VALUE && maxTime != milliTS) {
128: 					LOG.warn("Services disagree about timestamp: " + maxTime + " vs " + milliTS
129: 							+ ". Therfore using the minimum.");
130: 				}
131: 				maxTime = Math.min(maxTime, milliTS);
132: 			} else {
133: 				response.bufferEntity();
134: 				LOG.warn("Service " + response + "was not available for time-check.");
135: 			}
136: 		}
137: 		if (maxTime == Long.MIN_VALUE) {
138: 			for (Order or : orders) {
139: 				maxTime = Math.max(maxTime, toMillis(or.getTime()));
140: 			}
141: 		}
142: 		filterForMaxtimeStamp(orderItems, orders);
143: 	}
144: 	private void filterForMaxtimeStamp(List<OrderItem> orderItems, List<Order> orders) {
145: 		List<Order> remove = new ArrayList<>();
146: 		for (Order or : orders) {
147: 			if (toMillis(or.getTime()) > maxTime) {
148: 				remove.add(or);
149: 			}
150: 		}
151: 		orders.removeAll(remove);
152: 		List<OrderItem> removeItems = new ArrayList<>();
153: 		for (OrderItem orderItem : orderItems) {
154: 			boolean contained = false;
155: 			for (Order or : orders) {
156: 				if (or.getId() == orderItem.getOrderId()) {
157: 					contained = true;
158: 				}
159: 			}
160: 			if (!contained) {
161: 				removeItems.add(orderItem);
162: 			}
163: 		}
164: 		orderItems.removeAll(removeItems);
165: 	}
166: 	private long toMillis(String date) {
167: 		TemporalAccessor temporalAccessor = DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE_TIME.parse(date);
168: 		LocalDateTime localDateTime = LocalDateTime.from(temporalAccessor);
169: 		ZonedDateTime zonedDateTime = ZonedDateTime.of(localDateTime, ZoneId.systemDefault());
170: 		Instant instant = Instant.from(zonedDateTime);
171: 		return instant.toEpochMilli();
172: 	}
173: }

File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.registry/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/registry/rest/HeartbeatInfo.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registry.rest;
 2: public class HeartbeatInfo {
 3: 	private long lastHeartbeat;
 4: 	public HeartbeatInfo() {
 5: 		this.lastHeartbeat = System.currentTimeMillis();
 6: 	}
 7: 	public void newHeartbeat() {
 8: 		this.lastHeartbeat = System.currentTimeMillis();
 9: 	}
10: 	public boolean isAlive() {
11: 		return System.currentTimeMillis() - lastHeartbeat < 10000;
12: 	}
13: }

================
File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.registry/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/registry/rest/Registry.java
================
  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registry.rest;
  2: import java.util.Collections;
  3: import java.util.HashMap;
  4: import java.util.Iterator;
  5: import java.util.LinkedList;
  6: import java.util.List;
  7: import java.util.Map;
  8: import java.util.concurrent.locks.Lock;
  9: import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReadWriteLock;
 10: import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
 11: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 12: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 13: public final class Registry {
 14:   private static Registry registry = new Registry();
 15:   private Map<String, List<String>> serviceLocationMap = new HashMap<String, List<String>>();
 16:   private Map<String, HeartbeatInfo> heartbeatMap = Collections
 17:       .synchronizedMap(new HashMap<String, HeartbeatInfo>());
 18:   private ReadWriteLock readWriteLock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
 19:   private Lock readLock = readWriteLock.readLock();
 20:   private Lock writeLock = readWriteLock.writeLock();
 21:   private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(Registry.class);
 22:   private Registry() {
 23:   }
 24:   public static Registry getRegistryInstance() {
 25:     return registry;
 26:   }
 27:   public List<String> getLocations(String name) {
 28:     List<String> locations;
 29:     readLock.lock();
 30:     try {
 31:       locations = serviceLocationMap.get(name);
 32:     } finally {
 33:       readLock.unlock();
 34:     }
 35:     writeLock.lock();
 36:     try {
 37:       if (locations == null) {
 38:         locations = new LinkedList<String>();
 39:         serviceLocationMap.put(name, locations);
 40:       }
 41:     } finally {
 42:       writeLock.unlock();
 43:     }
 44:     return locations;
 45:   }
 46:   private void updateHeartbeatMap(String name, String location) {
 47:     HeartbeatInfo info = heartbeatMap.get(name + location);
 48:     if (info == null) {
 49:       heartbeatMap.put(name + location, new HeartbeatInfo());
 50:     } else {
 51:       info.newHeartbeat();
 52:     }
 53:   }
 54:   public boolean unregister(String name, String location) {
 55:     writeLock.lock();
 56:     try {
 57:       List<String> locations = serviceLocationMap.get(name);
 58:       if (locations == null) {
 59:         return false;
 60:       }
 61:       boolean removed = locations.remove(location);
 62:       if (locations.size() == 0) {
 63:         serviceLocationMap.remove(name);
 64:       }
 65:       if (removed) {
 66:         LOG.info("Unregistered " + name + "@" + location);
 67:       }
 68:       return removed;
 69:     } finally {
 70:       writeLock.unlock();
 71:     }
 72:   }
 73:   public boolean register(String name, String location) {
 74:     updateHeartbeatMap(name, location);
 75:     writeLock.lock();
 76:     try {
 77:       List<String> locations = getLocations(name);
 78:       if (locations.contains(location)) {
 79:         return false;
 80:       }
 81:       serviceLocationMap.get(name).add(location);
 82:       LOG.info("Registered " + name + "@" + location);
 83:       return true;
 84:     } finally {
 85:       writeLock.unlock();
 86:     }
 87:   }
 88:   public void heartBeatCleanup() {
 89:     writeLock.lock();
 90:     try {
 91:       serviceLocationMap.entrySet().stream().forEach(entry -> {
 92:         for (Iterator<String> iter = entry.getValue().iterator(); iter.hasNext();) {
 93:           String location = iter.next();
 94:           if (!heartbeatMap.get(entry.getKey() + location).isAlive()) {
 95:             iter.remove();
 96:             LOG.warn(
 97:                 "Removed " + entry.getKey() + "@" + location + " since it failed the heartbeat!");
 98:           }
 99:         }
100:       });
101:     } finally {
102:       writeLock.unlock();
103:     }
104:   }
105: }

File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.registry/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/registry/rest/RegistryREST.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registry.rest;
 2: import java.util.List;
 3: import javax.ws.rs.DELETE;
 4: import javax.ws.rs.GET;
 5: import javax.ws.rs.PUT;
 6: import javax.ws.rs.Path;
 7: import javax.ws.rs.PathParam;
 8: import javax.ws.rs.Produces;
 9: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response;
10: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response.Status;
11: @Path("services")
12: @Produces({ "application/json" })
13: public class RegistryREST {
14: 	@PUT
15: 	@Path("{name}/{location}")
16: 	public Response register(@PathParam("name") final String name, @PathParam("location") final String location) {
17: 		boolean success = Registry.getRegistryInstance().register(name, location);
18: 		if (success) {
19: 			return Response.status(Status.CREATED).build();
20: 		}
21: 		return Response.ok().build();
22: 	}
23: 	@DELETE
24: 	@Path("{name}/{location}")
25: 	public Response unregister(@PathParam("name") final String name, @PathParam("location") final String location) {
26: 		boolean success = Registry.getRegistryInstance().unregister(name, location);
27: 		if (success) {
28: 			return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).build();
29: 		}
30: 		return Response.status(Response.Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
31: 	}
32: 	@GET
33: 	@Path("{name}")
34: 	public Response getInstances(@PathParam("name") final String name) {
35: 		List<String> locations = Registry.getRegistryInstance().getLocations(name);
36: 		return Response.status(Response.Status.OK).entity(locations).build();
37: 	}
38: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registry.rest;
 2: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
 3: import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
 4: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
 5: import javax.servlet.ServletContextEvent;
 6: import javax.servlet.ServletContextListener;
 7: import javax.servlet.annotation.WebListener;
 8: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 9: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
10: @WebListener
11: public class RegistryStartup implements ServletContextListener {
12:   private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RegistryStartup.class);
13:   private static final int HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS = 2500;
14:   private static ScheduledExecutorService heartbeatScheduler;
15:   public RegistryStartup() {
16:   }
17:   public void contextDestroyed(ServletContextEvent arg0) {
18:     heartbeatScheduler.shutdownNow();
19:     LOG.info("Shutdown registry");
20:   }
21:   public void contextInitialized(ServletContextEvent arg0) {
22:     heartbeatScheduler = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
23:     heartbeatScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(new Runnable() {
24:       @Override
25:       public void run() {
26:         Registry.getRegistryInstance().heartBeatCleanup();
27:       }
28:     }, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS, HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
29:     LOG.info("Registry online");
30:   }
31: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.webui.servlet;
 2: import java.io.IOException;
 3: import java.util.Arrays;
 4: import java.util.HashMap;
 5: import javax.servlet.ServletException;
 6: import javax.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
 7: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
 8: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 9: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
10: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers.LoadBalancerTimeoutException;
11: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.rest.LoadBalancedImageOperations;
12: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.rest.LoadBalancedStoreOperations;
13: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.ImageSizePreset;
14: @WebServlet("/about")
15: public class AboutUsServlet extends AbstractUIServlet {
16:   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
17:   public AboutUsServlet() {
18:     super();
19:   }
20:   @Override
21:   protected void handleGETRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
22:       throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
23:     checkforCookie(request, response);
24:     HashMap<String, String> portraits = LoadBalancedImageOperations
25:         .getWebImages(Arrays.asList("andreBauer", "johannesGrohmann", "joakimKistowski",
26:             "simonEismann", "norbertSchmitt", "samuelKounev"), ImageSizePreset.PORTRAIT.getSize());
27:     request.setAttribute("portraitAndre", portraits.get("andreBauer"));
28:     request.setAttribute("portraitJohannes", portraits.get("johannesGrohmann"));
29:     request.setAttribute("portraitJoakim", portraits.get("joakimKistowski"));
30:     request.setAttribute("portraitSimon", portraits.get("simonEismann"));
31:     request.setAttribute("portraitNorbert", portraits.get("norbertSchmitt"));
32:     request.setAttribute("portraitKounev", portraits.get("samuelKounev"));
33:     request.setAttribute("descartesLogo",
34:         LoadBalancedImageOperations.getWebImage("descartesLogo", ImageSizePreset.LOGO.getSize()));
35:     request.setAttribute("storeIcon",
36:         LoadBalancedImageOperations.getWebImage("icon", ImageSizePreset.ICON.getSize()));
37:     request.setAttribute("title", "TeaStore About Us");
38:     request.setAttribute("login", LoadBalancedStoreOperations.isLoggedIn(getSessionBlob(request)));
39:     request.getRequestDispatcher("WEB-INF/pages/about.jsp").forward(request, response);
40:   }
41: }

 21: public abstract class AbstractUIServlet extends HttpServlet {
 22: 	private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
 23: 	protected static final String MESSAGECOOKIE = "teastoreMessageCookie";
 24: 	protected static final String ERRORMESSAGECOOKIE = "teastoreErrorMessageCookie";
 25: 	protected static final String SUCESSLOGIN = "You are logged in!";
 26: 	protected static final String SUCESSLOGOUT = "You are logged out!";
 27: 	protected static final String WRONGCREDENTIALS = "You used wrong credentials!";
 28: 	protected static final String PRODUCTCOOKIE = "teastorenumberProductsCookie";
 29: 	protected static final String BLOB = "sessionBlob";
 30: 	protected static final String ORDERCONFIRMED = "Your order is confirmed!";
 31: 	protected static final String CARTUPDATED = "Your cart is updated!";
 32: 	protected static final String ADDPRODUCT = "Product %s is added to cart!";
 33: 	protected static final String REMOVEPRODUCT = "Product %s is removed from cart!";
 34: 	protected SessionBlob getSessionBlob(HttpServletRequest request) {
 35: 		if (request.getCookies() != null) {
 36: 			for (Cookie cook : request.getCookies()) {
 37: 				if (cook.getName().equals(BLOB)) {
 38: 					ObjectMapper o = new ObjectMapper();
 39: 					try {
 40: 						SessionBlob blob = o.readValue(URLDecoder.decode(cook.getValue(), "UTF-8"), SessionBlob.class);
 41: 						if (blob != null) {
 42: 						return blob;
 43: 						}
 44: 					} catch (IOException e) {
 45: 						throw new IllegalStateException("Cookie corrupted!");
 46: 					}
 47: 				}
 48: 			}
 49: 		}
 50: 		return new SessionBlob();
 51: 	}
 52: 	protected void saveSessionBlob(SessionBlob blob, HttpServletResponse response) {
 53: 		ObjectMapper o = new ObjectMapper();
 54: 		try {
 55: 			Cookie cookie = new Cookie(BLOB, URLEncoder.encode(o.writeValueAsString(blob), "UTF-8"));
 56: 			response.addCookie(cookie);
 57: 		} catch (JsonProcessingException | UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
 58: 			throw new IllegalStateException("Could not save blob!");
 59: 		}
 60: 	}
 61: 	protected void destroySessionBlob(SessionBlob blob, HttpServletResponse response) {
 62: 		ObjectMapper o = new ObjectMapper();
 63: 		try {
 64: 			Cookie cookie = new Cookie(BLOB, URLEncoder.encode(o.writeValueAsString(blob), "UTF-8"));
 65: 			cookie.setMaxAge(0);
 66: 			response.addCookie(cookie);
 67: 		} catch (JsonProcessingException | UnsupportedEncodingException e) {
 68: 			throw new IllegalStateException("Could not destroy blob!");
 69: 		}
 70: 	}
 71: 	protected void redirect(String target, HttpServletResponse response, String cookiename, String value)
 72: 			throws IOException {
 73: 		if (!cookiename.equals("")) {
 74: 			Cookie cookie = new Cookie(cookiename, value.replace(" ", "_"));
 75: 			response.addCookie(cookie);
 76: 		}
 77: 		redirect(target, response);
 78: 	}
 79: 	protected void redirect(String target, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
 80: 		if (!target.startsWith("/")) {
 81: 			target = "/" + target;
 82: 		}
 83: 		response.sendRedirect(getServletContext().getContextPath() + target);
 84: 	}
 85: 	protected void checkforCookie(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) {
 86: 		if (request.getCookies() != null) {
 87: 			for (Cookie cook : request.getCookies()) {
 88: 				if (cook.getName().equals(MESSAGECOOKIE)) {
 89: 					request.setAttribute("message", cook.getValue().replaceAll("_", " "));
 90: 					cook.setMaxAge(0);
 91: 					response.addCookie(cook);
 92: 				} else if (cook.getName().equals(PRODUCTCOOKIE)) {
 93: 					request.setAttribute("numberProducts", cook.getValue());
 94: 				} else if (cook.getName().equals(ERRORMESSAGECOOKIE)) {
 95: 					request.setAttribute("errormessage", cook.getValue().replaceAll("_", " "));
 96: 					cook.setMaxAge(0);
 97: 					response.addCookie(cook);
 98: 				}
 99: 			}
100: 		}
101: 	}
102: 	protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
103: 			throws ServletException, IOException {
104: 		try {
105: 			handleGETRequest(request, response);
106: 		} catch (LoadBalancerTimeoutException e) {
107: 			serveTimoutResponse(request, response, e.getTargetService());
108: 		} catch (NotFoundException e) {
109: 			serveNotFoundException(request, response, e);
110: 		} catch (Exception e) {
111: 			serveExceptionResponse(request, response, e);
112: 		}
113: 	}
114: 	protected void doPost(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
115: 			throws ServletException, IOException {
116: 		try {
117: 			handlePOSTRequest(request, response);
118: 		} catch (LoadBalancerTimeoutException e) {
119: 			serveTimoutResponse(request, response, e.getTargetService());
120: 		} catch (NotFoundException e) {
121: 			serveNotFoundException(request, response, e);
122: 		} catch (Exception e) {
123: 			serveExceptionResponse(request, response, e);
124: 		}
125: 	}
126: 	protected void handlePOSTRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
127: 			throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
128: 		handleGETRequest(request, response);
129: 	}
130: 	protected abstract void handleGETRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
131: 			throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException;
132: 	private void serveTimoutResponse(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Service service)
133: 			throws ServletException, IOException {
134: 		response.setStatus(408);
135: 		request.setAttribute("CategoryList", new ArrayList<Category>());
136: 		request.setAttribute("storeIcon", "");
137: 		request.setAttribute("errorImage", "");
138: 		request.setAttribute("title", "TeaStore Timeout");
139: 		request.setAttribute("messagetitle", "408: Timout waiting for Service: " + service.getServiceName());
140: 		request.setAttribute("messageparagraph", "WebUI got a timeout waiting for service \"" + service.getServiceName()
141: 				+ "\" to respond. Note the that service may itself have been waiting for another service.");
142: 		request.setAttribute("login", false);
143: 		request.getRequestDispatcher("WEB-INF/pages/error.jsp").forward(request, response);
144: 	}
145: 	private void serveExceptionResponse(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Exception e)
146: 			throws ServletException, IOException {
147: 		StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
148: 		e.printStackTrace(new PrintWriter(sw));
149: 		String exceptionAsString = sw.toString();
150: 		response.setStatus(500);
151: 		request.setAttribute("CategoryList", new ArrayList<Category>());
152: 		request.setAttribute("storeIcon", "");
153: 		request.setAttribute("errorImage", "");
154: 		request.setAttribute("title", "TeaStore Timeout");
155: 		request.setAttribute("messagetitle", "500: Internal Exception: " + e.getMessage());
156: 		request.setAttribute("messageparagraph", exceptionAsString);
157: 		request.setAttribute("login", false);
158: 		request.getRequestDispatcher("WEB-INF/pages/error.jsp").forward(request, response);
159: 	}
160: 	private void serveNotFoundException(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response, Exception e)
161: 			throws ServletException, IOException {
162: 		StringWriter sw = new StringWriter();
163: 		e.printStackTrace(new PrintWriter(sw));
164: 		String exceptionAsString = sw.toString();
165: 		response.setStatus(404);
166: 		request.setAttribute("CategoryList", new ArrayList<Category>());
167: 		request.setAttribute("storeIcon", "");
168: 		request.setAttribute("errorImage", "");
169: 		request.setAttribute("title", "TeaStore Timeout");
170: 		request.setAttribute("messagetitle", "404: Not Found Exception: " + e.getMessage());
171: 		request.setAttribute("messageparagraph", exceptionAsString);
172: 		request.setAttribute("login", false);
173: 		request.getRequestDispatcher("WEB-INF/pages/error.jsp").forward(request, response);

 15: @WebServlet("/cartAction")
 16: public class CartActionServlet extends AbstractUIServlet {
 17: 	private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
 18: 	private static final DateTimeFormatter DTF = DateTimeFormatter.ofPattern("MM/yyyy");
 19: 	public CartActionServlet() {
 20: 		super();
 21: 	}
 22: 	@Override
 23: 	protected void handleGETRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
 24: 			throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
 25: 		for (Object paramo : request.getParameterMap().keySet()) {
 26: 			String param = (String) paramo;
 27: 			if (param.contains("addToCart")) {
 28: 				long productID = Long.parseLong(request.getParameter("productid"));
 29: 				SessionBlob blob = LoadBalancedStoreOperations.addProductToCart(getSessionBlob(request), productID);
 30: 				saveSessionBlob(blob, response);
 31: 				redirect("/cart", response, MESSAGECOOKIE, String.format(ADDPRODUCT, productID));
 32: 				break;
 33: 			} else if (param.contains("removeProduct")) {
 34: 				long productID = Long.parseLong(param.substring("removeProduct_".length()));
 35: 				SessionBlob blob = LoadBalancedStoreOperations.removeProductFromCart(getSessionBlob(request),
 36: 						productID);
 37: 				saveSessionBlob(blob, response);
 38: 				redirect("/cart", response, MESSAGECOOKIE, String.format(REMOVEPRODUCT, productID));
 39: 				break;
 40: 			} else if (param.contains("updateCartQuantities")) {
 41: 				List<OrderItem> orderItems = getSessionBlob(request).getOrderItems();
 42: 				updateOrder(request, orderItems, response);
 43: 				redirect("/cart", response, MESSAGECOOKIE, CARTUPDATED);
 44: 				break;
 45: 			} else if (param.contains("proceedtoCheckout")) {
 46: 				if (LoadBalancedStoreOperations.isLoggedIn(getSessionBlob(request))) {
 47: 					List<OrderItem> orderItems = getSessionBlob(request).getOrderItems();
 48: 					updateOrder(request, orderItems, response);
 49: 					redirect("/order", response);
 50: 				} else {
 51: 					redirect("/login", response);
 52: 				}
 53: 				break;
 54: 			} else if (param.contains("confirm")) {
 55: 				confirmOrder(request, response);
 56: 				break;
 57: 			}
 58: 		}
 59: 	}
 60: 	private void confirmOrder(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
 61: 		String[] infos = extractOrderInformation(request);
 62: 		if (infos.length == 0) {
 63: 			redirect("/order", response);
 64: 		} else {
 65: 			SessionBlob blob = getSessionBlob(request);
 66: 			long price = 0;
 67: 			for (OrderItem item : blob.getOrderItems()) {
 68: 				price += item.getQuantity() * item.getUnitPriceInCents();
 69: 			}
 70: 			blob = LoadBalancedStoreOperations.placeOrder(getSessionBlob(request), infos[0] + " " + infos[1], infos[2],
 71: 					infos[3], infos[4],
 72: 					YearMonth.parse(infos[6], DTF).atDay(1).format(DateTimeFormatter.ISO_LOCAL_DATE), price, infos[5]);
 73: 			saveSessionBlob(blob, response);
 74: 			redirect("/", response, MESSAGECOOKIE, ORDERCONFIRMED);
 75: 		}
 76: 	}
 77: 	private String[] extractOrderInformation(HttpServletRequest request) {
 78: 		String[] parameters = new String[] { "firstname", "lastname", "address1", "address2", "cardtype", "cardnumber",
 79: 				"expirydate" };
 80: 		String[] infos = new String[parameters.length];
 81: 		for (int i = 0; i < parameters.length; i++) {
 82: 			if (request.getParameter(parameters[i]) == null) {
 83: 				return new String[0];
 84: 			} else {
 85: 				infos[i] = request.getParameter(parameters[i]);
 86: 			}
 87: 		}
 88: 		return infos;
 89: 	}
 90: 	private void updateOrder(HttpServletRequest request, List<OrderItem> orderItems, HttpServletResponse response) {
 91: 		SessionBlob blob = getSessionBlob(request);
 92: 		for (OrderItem orderItem : orderItems) {
 93: 			if (request.getParameter("orderitem_" + orderItem.getProductId()) != null) {
 94: 				blob = LoadBalancedStoreOperations.updateQuantity(blob, orderItem.getProductId(),
 95: 						Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("orderitem_" + orderItem.getProductId())));
 96: 			}
 97: 		}
 98: 		saveSessionBlob(blob, response);
 99: 	}
100: }

27:     super();
28:   }
29:   @Override
30:   protected void handleGETRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
31:       throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
32:     checkforCookie(request, response);
33:     SessionBlob blob = getSessionBlob(request);
34:     List<OrderItem> orderItems = blob.getOrderItems();
35:     ArrayList<Long> ids = new ArrayList<Long>();
36:     for (OrderItem orderItem : orderItems) {
37:       ids.add(orderItem.getProductId());
38:     }
39:     HashMap<Long, Product> products = new HashMap<Long, Product>();
40:     for (Long id : ids) {
41:       Product product = LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntity(Service.PERSISTENCE, "products",
42:           Product.class, id);
43:       products.put(product.getId(), product);
44:     }
45:     request.setAttribute("storeIcon",
46:         LoadBalancedImageOperations.getWebImage("icon", ImageSizePreset.ICON.getSize()));
47:     request.setAttribute("title", "TeaStore Cart");
48:     request.setAttribute("CategoryList", LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntities(Service.PERSISTENCE,
49:         "categories", Category.class, -1, -1));
50:     request.setAttribute("OrderItems", orderItems);
51:     request.setAttribute("Products", products);
52:     request.setAttribute("login", LoadBalancedStoreOperations.isLoggedIn(getSessionBlob(request)));
53:     List<Long> productIds = LoadBalancedRecommenderOperations
54:         .getRecommendations(blob.getOrderItems(), blob.getUID());
55:     List<Product> ads = new LinkedList<Product>();
56:     for (Long productId : productIds) {
57:       ads.add(LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntity(Service.PERSISTENCE, "products", Product.class,
58:           productId));
59:     }
60:     if (ads.size() > 3) {
61:       ads.subList(3, ads.size()).clear();
62:     }
63:     request.setAttribute("Advertisment", ads);
64:     request.setAttribute("productImages", LoadBalancedImageOperations.getProductPreviewImages(ads));
65:     request.getRequestDispatcher("WEB-INF/pages/cart.jsp").forward(request, response);
66:   }
67: }

  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.webui.servlet;
  2: import java.io.IOException;
  3: import java.util.ArrayList;
  4: import java.util.Arrays;

 10: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
 11: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.Service;
 12: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers.LoadBalancerTimeoutException;
 13: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers.ServiceLoadBalancer;

 21: import tools.descartes.teastore.entities.Product;
 22: @WebServlet("/category")
 23: public class CategoryServlet extends AbstractUIServlet {
 24:   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
 25:   private static final int INITIAL_PRODUCT_DISPLAY_COUNT = 20;
 26:   private static final List<Integer> PRODUCT_DISPLAY_COUNT_OPTIONS = Arrays.asList(5, 10, 20, 30,
 27:       50);
 28:   public CategoryServlet() {
 29:     super();
 30:   }
 31:   @Override
 32:   protected void handleGETRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
 33:       throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
 34:     if (request.getParameter("category") != null) {
 35:       checkforCookie(request, response);
 36:       long categoryID = Long.parseLong(request.getParameter("category"));
 37:       Category category = LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntity(Service.PERSISTENCE, "categories",
 38:           Category.class, categoryID);
 39:       int products = Integer.parseInt(ServiceLoadBalancer.loadBalanceRESTOperation(
 40:           Service.PERSISTENCE, "products", Product.class,
 41:           client -> ResponseWrapper.wrap(HttpWrapper
 42:               .wrap(client.getEndpointTarget().path("count").path(String.valueOf(categoryID)))
 43:               .get()).readEntity(String.class)));
 44:       int numberProducts = INITIAL_PRODUCT_DISPLAY_COUNT;
 45:       if (request.getAttribute("numberProducts") != null) {
 46:         numberProducts = Integer.parseInt(request.getAttribute("numberProducts").toString());
 47:       }
 48:       int page = 1;
 49:       if (request.getParameter("page") != null) {
 50:         int pagenumber = Integer.parseInt(request.getParameter("page"));
 51:         int maxpages = (int) Math.ceil(((double) products) / numberProducts);
 52:         if (pagenumber <= maxpages) {
 53:           page = pagenumber;
 54:         }
 55:       }
 56:       ArrayList<String> navigation = createNavigation(products, page, numberProducts);
 57:       List<Product> productlist = LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntities(Service.PERSISTENCE,
 58:           "products", Product.class, "category", categoryID, (page - 1) * numberProducts,
 59:           numberProducts);
 60:       request.setAttribute("productImages",
 61:           LoadBalancedImageOperations.getProductPreviewImages(productlist));
 62:       request.setAttribute("storeIcon",
 63:           LoadBalancedImageOperations.getWebImage("icon", ImageSizePreset.ICON.getSize()));
 64:       request.setAttribute("CategoryList", LoadBalancedCRUDOperations
 65:           .getEntities(Service.PERSISTENCE, "categories", Category.class, -1, -1));
 66:       request.setAttribute("title", "TeaStore Categorie " + category.getName());
 67:       request.setAttribute("Productslist", productlist);
 68:       request.setAttribute("category", category.getName());
 69:       request.setAttribute("login",
 70:           LoadBalancedStoreOperations.isLoggedIn(getSessionBlob(request)));
 71:       request.setAttribute("categoryID", categoryID);
 72:       request.setAttribute("currentnumber", numberProducts);
 73:       request.setAttribute("pagination", navigation);
 74:       request.setAttribute("pagenumber", page);
 75:       request.setAttribute("productdisplaycountoptions", PRODUCT_DISPLAY_COUNT_OPTIONS);
 76:       request.getRequestDispatcher("WEB-INF/pages/category.jsp").forward(request, response);
 77:     } else {
 78:       redirect("/", response);
 79:     }
 80:   }
 81:   @Override
 82:   protected void handlePOSTRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
 83:       throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
 84:     if (request.getParameter("number") != null && request.getParameter("page") != null
 85:         && request.getParameter("category") != null) {
 86:       redirect(
 87:           "/category?category=" + request.getParameter("category") + "&page="
 88:               + request.getParameter("page"),
 89:           response, PRODUCTCOOKIE, request.getParameter("number"));
 90:     } else {
 91:       handleGETRequest(request, response);
 92:     }
 93:   }
 94:   private ArrayList<String> createNavigation(int products, int page, int numberProducts) {
 95:     ArrayList<String> navigation = new ArrayList<String>();
 96:     int numberpagination = 5;
 97:     int maxpages = (int) Math.ceil(((double) products) / numberProducts);
 98:     if (maxpages < page) {
 99:       return navigation;
100:     }
101:     if (page == 1) {
102:       if (maxpages == 1) {
103:         navigation.add("1");
104:         return navigation;
105:       }
106:       int min = Math.min(maxpages, numberpagination + 1);
107:       for (int i = 1; i <= min; i++) {
108:         navigation.add(String.valueOf(i));
109:       }
110:     } else {
111:       navigation.add("previous");
112:       if (page == maxpages) {
113:         int max = Math.max(maxpages - numberpagination, 1);
114:         for (int i = max; i <= maxpages; i++) {
115:           navigation.add(String.valueOf(i));
116:         }
117:         return navigation;
118:       } else {
119:         int lowerbound = (int) Math.ceil(((double) numberpagination - 1.0) / 2.0);
120:         int upperbound = (int) Math.floor(((double) numberpagination - 1.0) / 2.0);
121:         int up = Math.min(page + upperbound, maxpages);
122:         int down = Math.max(page - lowerbound, 1);
123:         for (int i = down; i <= up; i++) {
124:           navigation.add(String.valueOf(i));
125:         }
126:       }
127:     }
128:     navigation.add("next");
129:     return navigation;
130:   }
131: }

 2: import java.io.IOException;

 4: import javax.servlet.ServletException;
 5: import javax.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
 6: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
 7: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 8: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
 9: import javax.ws.rs.core.MediaType;
10: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response;
11: import org.slf4j.Logger;
12: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
13: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.Service;
14: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers.LoadBalancerTimeoutException;
15: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers.ServiceLoadBalancer;
16: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.rest.LoadBalancedImageOperations;
17: @WebServlet("/dataBaseAction")
18: public class DataBaseActionServlet extends AbstractUIServlet {
19: 	private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
20: 	private static final String[] PARAMETERS = new String[] { "categories", "products", "users", "orders" };
21: 	private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(DataBaseActionServlet.class);
22: 	public DataBaseActionServlet() {
23: 		super();
24: 	}
25: 	@Override
26: 	protected void handleGETRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
27: 			throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
28: 		if (request.getParameter("confirm") != null) {
29: 			String[] infos = extractOrderInformation(request);
30: 			if (infos.length == 0) {
31: 				redirect("/database", response);
32: 			} else {
33: 				destroySessionBlob(getSessionBlob(request), response);
34: 				Response resp = ServiceLoadBalancer.loadBalanceRESTOperation(Service.PERSISTENCE, "generatedb",
35: 						String.class,
36: 						client -> client.getService().path(client.getApplicationURI()).path(client.getEndpointURI())
37: 								.queryParam(PARAMETERS[0], infos[0]).queryParam(PARAMETERS[1], infos[1])
38: 								.queryParam(PARAMETERS[2], infos[2]).queryParam(PARAMETERS[3], infos[3])
39: 								.request(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN).get());
40: 				resp.bufferEntity();
41: 				if (resp.getStatus() == 200) {
42: 					LOG.info("DB is re-generating.");
43: 				}
44: 				List<Integer> status = LoadBalancedImageOperations.regenerateImages();
45: 				status.stream().filter(r -> r != 200).forEach(
46: 						r -> LOG.warn("An image provider service responded with " + r + " when regenerating images."));
47: 				List<Response> recResp = ServiceLoadBalancer.multicastRESTOperation(Service.RECOMMENDER, "train",
48: 						String.class,
49: 						client -> client.getEndpointTarget().path("async").request(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN).get());
50: 				recResp.stream().filter(r -> r.getStatus() != 200).forEach(
51: 						r -> LOG.warn("A recommender service responded with " + r.getStatus() + " when retraining."));
52: 				recResp.stream().forEach(r -> r.bufferEntity());
53: 				redirect("/status", response);
54: 			}
55: 		} else {
56: 			redirect("/", response);
57: 		}
58: 	}
59: 	private String[] extractOrderInformation(HttpServletRequest request) {
60: 		String[] infos = new String[PARAMETERS.length];
61: 		for (int i = 0; i < PARAMETERS.length; i++) {
62: 			if (request.getParameter(PARAMETERS[i]) == null) {
63: 				return new String[0];
64: 			} else {
65: 				infos[i] = request.getParameter(PARAMETERS[i]);
66: 			}
67: 		}
68: 		return infos;
69: 	}
70: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.webui.servlet;
