11: @WebServlet("/loginAction")
12: public class LoginActionServlet extends AbstractUIServlet {
13: 	private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
14: 	public LoginActionServlet() {
15: 		super();
16: 	}
17: 	@Override
18: 	protected void handleGETRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
19: 			throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
20: 		redirect("/", response);
21: 	}
22: 	@Override
23: 	protected void handlePOSTRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
24: 			throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
25: 		boolean login = false;
26: 		if (request.getParameter("username") != null && request.getParameter("password") != null) {
27: 			SessionBlob blob = LoadBalancedStoreOperations.login(getSessionBlob(request),
28: 					request.getParameter("username"), request.getParameter("password"));
29: 			login = (blob != null && blob.getSID() != null);
30: 			if (login) {
31: 				saveSessionBlob(blob, response);
32: 				if (request.getParameter("referer") != null
33: 						&& request.getParameter("referer").contains("tools.descartes.teastore.webui/cart")) {
34: 					redirect("/cart", response, MESSAGECOOKIE, SUCESSLOGIN);
35: 				} else {
36: 					redirect("/", response, MESSAGECOOKIE, SUCESSLOGIN);
37: 				}
38: 			} else {
39: 				redirect("/login", response, ERRORMESSAGECOOKIE, WRONGCREDENTIALS);
40: 			}
41: 		} else if (request.getParameter("logout") != null) {
42: 			SessionBlob blob = LoadBalancedStoreOperations.logout(getSessionBlob(request));
43: 			saveSessionBlob(blob, response);
44: 			destroySessionBlob(blob, response);
45: 			redirect("/", response, MESSAGECOOKIE, SUCESSLOGOUT);
46: 		} else {
47: 			handleGETRequest(request, response);
48: 		}
49: 	}
50: }

22: @WebServlet("/product")
23: public class ProductServlet extends AbstractUIServlet {
24:   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
25:   public ProductServlet() {
26:     super();
27:   }
28:   @Override
29:   protected void handleGETRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
30:       throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
31:     checkforCookie(request, response);
32:     if (request.getParameter("id") != null) {
33:       Long id = Long.valueOf(request.getParameter("id"));
34:       request.setAttribute("CategoryList", LoadBalancedCRUDOperations
35:           .getEntities(Service.PERSISTENCE, "categories", Category.class, -1, -1));
36:       request.setAttribute("title", "TeaStore Product");
37:       SessionBlob blob = getSessionBlob(request);
38:       request.setAttribute("login", LoadBalancedStoreOperations.isLoggedIn(blob));
39:       Product p = LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntity(Service.PERSISTENCE, "products",
40:           Product.class, id);
41:       request.setAttribute("product", p);
42:       List<OrderItem> items = new LinkedList<>();
43:       OrderItem oi = new OrderItem();
44:       oi.setProductId(id);
45:       oi.setQuantity(1);
46:       items.add(oi);
47:       items.addAll(getSessionBlob(request).getOrderItems());
48:       List<Long> productIds = LoadBalancedRecommenderOperations.getRecommendations(items,
49:           getSessionBlob(request).getUID());
50:       List<Product> ads = new LinkedList<Product>();
51:       for (Long productId : productIds) {
52:         ads.add(LoadBalancedCRUDOperations.getEntity(Service.PERSISTENCE, "products", Product.class,
53:             productId));
54:       }
55:       if (ads.size() > 3) {
56:         ads.subList(3, ads.size()).clear();
57:       }
58:       request.setAttribute("Advertisment", ads);
59:       request.setAttribute("productImages", LoadBalancedImageOperations.getProductImages(ads,
60:           ImageSizePreset.RECOMMENDATION.getSize()));
61:       request.setAttribute("productImage", LoadBalancedImageOperations.getProductImage(p));
62:       request.setAttribute("storeIcon",
63:           LoadBalancedImageOperations.getWebImage("icon", ImageSizePreset.ICON.getSize()));
64:       request.setAttribute("helper", ELHelperUtils.UTILS);
65:       request.getRequestDispatcher("WEB-INF/pages/product.jsp").forward(request, response);
66:     } else {
67:       redirect("/", response);
68:     }
69:   }
70: }

16: @WebServlet("/status")
17: public class StatusServlet extends AbstractUIServlet {
18:   private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
19:   public StatusServlet() {
20:     super();
21:   }
22:   @Override
23:   protected void handleGETRequest(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response)
24:       throws ServletException, IOException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
25:     checkforCookie(request, response);
26:     String iconImage = null;
27:     try {
28:       iconImage = LoadBalancedImageOperations.getWebImage("icon", ImageSizePreset.ICON.getSize());
29:     } catch (NullPointerException e) {
30:     }
31:     request.setAttribute("storeIcon", iconImage);
32:     request.setAttribute("title", "TeaStore Status");
33:     boolean noregistry = false;
34:     try {
35:       request.setAttribute("webuiservers",
36:           RegistryClient.getClient().getServersForService(Service.WEBUI));
37:       request.setAttribute("authenticationservers",
38:           RegistryClient.getClient().getServersForService(Service.AUTH));
39:       request.setAttribute("persistenceservers",
40:           RegistryClient.getClient().getServersForService(Service.PERSISTENCE));
41:       request.setAttribute("imageservers",
42:           RegistryClient.getClient().getServersForService(Service.IMAGE));
43:       request.setAttribute("recommenderservers",
44:           RegistryClient.getClient().getServersForService(Service.RECOMMENDER));
45:       request.setAttribute("dbfinished", isDatabaseFinished());
46:       request.setAttribute("imagefinished", isImageFinished());
47:       request.setAttribute("recommenderfinished", isRecommenderFinished());
48:     } catch (NullPointerException e) {
49:       noregistry = true;
50:     }
51:     request.setAttribute("noregistry", noregistry);
52:     request.getRequestDispatcher("WEB-INF/pages/status.jsp").forward(request, response);
53:   }
54:   private boolean isDatabaseFinished() {
55:     String finished = ServiceLoadBalancer.loadBalanceRESTOperation(Service.PERSISTENCE,
56:         "generatedb", String.class, client -> client.getEndpointTarget().path("finished")
57:             .request(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN).get().readEntity(String.class));
58:     if (finished != null) {
59:       return Boolean.parseBoolean(finished);
60:     }
61:     return false;
62:   }
63:   private boolean isImageFinished() {
64:     List<String> finishedMessages = ServiceLoadBalancer.multicastRESTOperation(Service.IMAGE,
65:         "image", String.class, client -> client.getEndpointTarget().path("finished")
66:             .request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).get().readEntity(String.class));
67:     if (finishedMessages != null && !finishedMessages.isEmpty()) {
68:       boolean finished = true;
69:       for (String finishedMessage : finishedMessages) {
70:         finished = finished && Boolean.parseBoolean(finishedMessage);
71:       }
72:       return finished;
73:     }
74:     return false;
75:   }
76:   private boolean isRecommenderFinished() {
77:     List<String> finishedMessages = ServiceLoadBalancer.multicastRESTOperation(Service.RECOMMENDER,
78:         "train", String.class, client -> client.getEndpointTarget().path("isready")
79:             .request(MediaType.TEXT_PLAIN).get().readEntity(String.class));
80:     if (finishedMessages != null && !finishedMessages.isEmpty()) {
81:       return finishedMessages.stream().map(b -> Boolean.parseBoolean(b)).reduce(Boolean.TRUE,
82:           (a, b) -> a && b);
83:     }
84:     return false;
85:   }
86: }

22:     }
23: }

 912:     var self = obj instanceof this.constructor ?

 956:   Tooltip.prototype.show = function () {

 989:                     placement == 'top'    && pos.top    - actualHeight < viewportDim.top    ? 'bottom' :

1012:   Tooltip.prototype.applyPlacement = function (offset, placement) {
1013:     var $tip   = this.tip()

File: services/tools.descartes.teastore.webui/src/main/webapp/resizingscript.js
================
 1: $(document).ready(resizing());
 2: $(window).resize(function() {
 3: 	resizing();
 4: });
 5: function resizing() {
 6: 	var viewportwidth;
 7: 	var viewportheight;
 8: 	if (typeof window.innerWidth != 'undefined') {
 9: 		viewportwidth = window.innerWidth;
10: 		viewportheight = window.innerHeight;
11: 	}
12: 	else if (typeof document.documentElement != 'undefined'
13: 			&& typeof document.documentElement.clientWidth != 'undefined'
14: 			&& document.documentElement.clientWidth != 0) {
15: 		viewportwidth = document.documentElement.clientWidth,
16: 				viewportheight = document.documentElement.clientHeight
17: 	}
18: 	else {
19: 				viewportwidth = document.getElementsByTagName('body')[0].clientWidth,
20: 				viewportheight = document.getElementsByTagName('body')[0].clientHeight
21: 	}
22: 	$("#main").css(
23: 			"min-height",
24: 			(viewportheight - $("#headnav").outerHeight(true) - $("#footnav")
25: 					.outerHeight(true))
26: 					+ "px");
27: 	if ($('#navbarbutton').is(':visible')) {
28: 		hiding();
29: 	} else {
30: 		showing();
31: 	}
32: }
33: function hiding() {
34: 	$('.sidebar').hide();
35: 	$('.category-item').each(function() {
36: 		$(this).appendTo('ul.headnavbarlist');
37: 	});
38: }
39: function showing() {
40: 	$('.sidebar').show();
41: 	$('.category-item').each(function() {
42: 		$(this).appendTo('ul.nav-sidebar');
43: 	});
44: }

 1: FROM tomcat:8.5-jre8

 4: # Delete all example webapps from base container
 5: RUN rm -r /usr/local/tomcat/webapps/examples
 6: RUN rm -r /usr/local/tomcat/webapps/docs
 7: RUN rm -r /usr/local/tomcat/webapps/host-manager
 8: RUN rm -r /usr/local/tomcat/webapps/manager
 9:

11: RUN rm /usr/local/tomcat/lib/tomcat-websocket.jar
12: 
13: # Copy config, database connector library and script for environment variables into container
14: COPY baseContext.xml /usr/local/tomcat/conf/context.xml
15: COPY mysql-connector-java-5.1.44-bin.jar /usr/local/tomcat/lib/mysql-connector-java-5.1.44-bin.jar
16: COPY target/jars/dockermemoryconfigurator* /usr/local/tomcat/bin/dockermemoryconfigurator.jar
17: RUN rm /usr/local/tomcat/conf/server.xml
18: COPY server.xml /usr/local/tomcat/conf/
19: 
20: # Copy script to replace placeholders in context.xml with the environment variables
21: COPY start.sh /usr/local/tomcat/bin/start.sh
22: RUN chmod +x /usr/local/tomcat/bin/start.sh
23: 
24: # Service configuration. SERVICE_PORT is the host port, mapped to the exposed docker port. HOST_NAME
25: # is the IP address or hostname of the host running the docker container
26: ENV SERVICE_PORT 8080
27: ENV HOST_NAME unset
28: ENV USE_POD_IP false
29: ENV REGISTRY_HOST 127.0.0.1
30: ENV REGISTRY_PORT 8080
31: ENV DB_HOST 127.0.0.1
32: ENV DB_PORT 3306
33: ENV RECOMMENDER_RETRAIN_LOOP_TIME 0
34: ENV RECOMMENDER_ALGORITHM SlopeOne
35: ENV PROXY_NAME unset
36: ENV PROXY_PORT unset
37: ENV TOMCAT_HEAP_MEM_PERCENTAGE 50
38: ENV LOG_TO_FILE false
39: ENV RABBITMQ_HOST unset
40: 
41: # Setting secure random number generation to urandom. This increases the startup speed.
42: # Environment variable no longer needed. Replaced by sed in start.sh
43: # ENV JAVA_OPTS $JAVA_OPTS -Dsecurerandom.source=file 837:/dev/urandom
44: 
45: RUN mkdir -p /kieker/logs
46: 
47: COPY kieker.monitoring.properties 							/kieker/config/kieker.monitoring.properties
48: COPY aop.xml 												/usr/local/tomcat/lib/aop.xml

50:

================
File: utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.dockerbase/start.sh
================
 1: sed -i "s/<Environment name=\"servicePort\" value=.*/<Environment name=\"servicePort\" value=\"${SERVICE_PORT}\"/g" /usr/local/tomcat/conf/context.xml
 2: if [ "$HOST_NAME" != "unset" ]
 3: then
 4: 	sed -i "s|<Environment name=\"hostName\" value=.*|<Environment name=\"hostName\" value=\"${HOST_NAME}\" type=\"java.lang.String\" override=\"false\"/>|g" /usr/local/tomcat/conf/context.xml
 5: else
 6: 	sed -i "/Environment name=\"hostName\"/d" /usr/local/tomcat/conf/context.xml
 7: fi
 8: sed -i "s|<Environment name=\"useHostIP\" value=.*|<Environment name=\"useHostIP\" value=\"${USE_POD_IP}\"|g" /usr/local/tomcat/conf/context.xml

================
File: utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.dockermemoryconfigurator/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/dockermemoryconfigurator/Configurator.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.dockermemoryconfigurator;
 2: import java.io.BufferedReader;
 3: import java.io.File;
 4: import java.io.FileReader;
 5: import java.io.IOException;
 6: import java.io.PrintWriter;
 7: import java.util.Scanner;
 8: public final class Configurator {
 9:   private static final long DEFAULT_PERCENTAGE = 80;
10:   private Configurator() {
11:   }
12:   public static void main(String[] args) {
13:     long percentage = readPercentage(args);
14:     long totalkb = readTotalMemoryInKB();
15:     long cgroupkb = readCGroupMemoryInKB();
16:     System.out.println("Total Host Memory = " + totalkb + " KiB");
17:     System.out.println("Container CGroup Limit = " + cgroupkb + " KiB");
18:     if (cgroupkb != 0 && totalkb != 0 && cgroupkb < totalkb) {
19:       long heapkb = (cgroupkb * percentage) / 100L;
20:       System.out.println("Setting heap space to " + heapkb + " KiB");
21:       writeSetEnvFile(heapkb);
22:     }
23:   }
24:   private static long readPercentage(String[] args) {
25:     long percentage = DEFAULT_PERCENTAGE;
26:     if (args.length > 0) {
27:       String arg0 = args[0].trim();
28:       if (!arg0.isEmpty()) {
29:         try {
30:           percentage = Long.parseLong(arg0);
31:         } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
32:           percentage = DEFAULT_PERCENTAGE;
33:         }
34:       }
35:     }
36:     return percentage;
37:   }
38:   private static long readTotalMemoryInKB() {
39:     File meminfo = new File("/proc/meminfo");
40:     if (!meminfo.exists()) {
41:       return 0;
42:     }
43:     try (Scanner scan = new Scanner(meminfo)) {
44:       while (scan.hasNextLine()) {
45:         String line = scan.nextLine().trim();
46:         if (line.startsWith("MemTotal:")) {
47:           String[] tokens = line.split(" ");
48:           String kbs = tokens[tokens.length - 2].trim();
49:           try {
50:             return Long.parseLong(kbs);
51:           } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
52:             return 0;
53:           }
54:         }
55:       }
56:     } catch (IOException e) {
57:       return 0;
58:     }
59:     return 0;
60:   }
61:   private static long readCGroupMemoryInKB() {
62:     File cgroupbytes = new File("/sys/fs/cgroup/memory/memory.limit_in_bytes");
63:     if (!cgroupbytes.exists()) {
64:       return 0;
65:     }
66:     try (BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new FileReader(cgroupbytes))) {
67:       try {
68:         double bytes = Double.parseDouble(br.readLine().trim());
69:         return (long) (bytes / 1024.0);
70:       } catch (NumberFormatException e) {
71:         return 0;
72:       }
73:     } catch (IOException e) {
74:       return 0;
75:     }
76:   }
77:   private static void writeSetEnvFile(long heapkb) {
78:     try {
79:       new File("/usr/local/tomcat/bin/setenv.sh").createNewFile();
80:       PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter("/usr/local/tomcat/bin/setenv.sh");
81:       out.println("export CATALINA_OPTS=\"$CATALINA_OPTS -Xmx" + heapkb + "k\"");
82:       out.close();
83:     } catch (IOException e) {
84:       throw new IllegalStateException("Could not create setenv.sh file");
85:     }
86:   }
87: }

File: utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/kieker/rabbitmq/FileWriterDaemon.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq;
 2: import java.io.File;
 3: import org.apache.log4j.Level;
 4: import org.apache.log4j.Logger;
 5: import kieker.common.configuration.Configuration;
 6: import kieker.common.record.IMonitoringRecord;
 7: import kieker.monitoring.writer.filesystem.AsciiFileWriter;
 8: public class FileWriterDaemon implements Runnable {
 9: 	@Override
10: 	public void run() {
11: 		Logger logger = Logger.getLogger("FileWriterDaemon");
12: 		logger.setLevel(Level.INFO);
13: 		new File("apache-tomcat-8.5.24/webapps/logs").mkdir();
14: 		new File("apache-tomcat-8.5.24/webapps/logs").mkdirs();
15: 		Configuration configuration = new Configuration();
16: 		configuration.setProperty(AsciiFileWriter.CONFIG_PATH, "apache-tomcat-8.5.24/webapps/logs");
17: 		configuration.setProperty(AsciiFileWriter.CONFIG_MAXENTRIESINFILE, "-1");
18: 		configuration.setProperty(AsciiFileWriter.CONFIG_MAXLOGSIZE, "-1");
19: 		configuration.setProperty(AsciiFileWriter.CONFIG_MAXLOGFILES, "-1");
20: 		configuration.setProperty(AsciiFileWriter.CONFIG_FLUSH, "true");
21: 		configuration.setProperty(AsciiFileWriter.CONFIG_FLUSH_MAPFILE, "true");
22: 		AsciiFileWriter writer = new AsciiFileWriter(configuration);
23: 		while (true) {
24: 			for (IMonitoringRecord record : MemoryLogStorage.getRecords()) {
25: 				writer.writeMonitoringRecord(record);
26: 			}
27: 			MemoryLogStorage.clearMemoryStorage();
28: 			try {
29: 				Thread.sleep(5000);
30: 			} catch (InterruptedException e) {
31: 				break;
32: 			}
33: 		}
34: 	}
35: }

File: utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/kieker/rabbitmq/LogConsumer.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq;
 2: import kieker.analysis.IProjectContext;
 3: import kieker.analysis.plugin.annotation.InputPort;
 4: import kieker.analysis.plugin.filter.AbstractFilterPlugin;
 5: import kieker.common.configuration.Configuration;
 6: import kieker.common.record.IMonitoringRecord;
 7: import kieker.common.record.system.CPUUtilizationRecord;
 8: public class LogConsumer extends AbstractFilterPlugin {
 9: 	public static final String INPUT_PORT_NAME = "newMonitoringRecord";
10: 	public LogConsumer(final Configuration configuration, final IProjectContext projectContext) {
11: 		super(configuration, projectContext);
12: 	}
13: 	@InputPort(name = LogConsumer.INPUT_PORT_NAME, eventTypes = { IMonitoringRecord.class })
14: 	public void newMonitoringRecord(final Object record) {
15: 		if (record instanceof IMonitoringRecord) {
16: 			if (record instanceof CPUUtilizationRecord) {
17: 				CPUUtilizationRecord cpu = (CPUUtilizationRecord) record;
18: 				System.out.println(cpu.getHostname() + cpu.getTotalUtilization());
19: 			}
20: 			IMonitoringRecord monitoringRecord = (IMonitoringRecord) record;
21: 			MemoryLogStorage.storeRecord(monitoringRecord);
22: 		} else {
23: 			throw new IllegalStateException("Unknown monitoring result type");
24: 		}
25: 	}
26: 	@Override
27: 	public Configuration getCurrentConfiguration() {
28: 		return new Configuration();
29: 	}
30: }

File: utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/kieker/rabbitmq/LogReaderDaemon.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq;
 2: import kieker.analysis.AnalysisController;
 3: import kieker.analysis.IAnalysisController;
 4: import kieker.analysis.plugin.reader.amqp.AmqpReader;
 5: import kieker.analysis.plugin.reader.amqp.ChunkingAmqpReader;
 6: import kieker.analysis.plugin.reader.newio.RawDataReaderPlugin;
 7: import kieker.common.configuration.Configuration;
 8: public class LogReaderDaemon implements Runnable {
 9:   private static final String URI = "amqp://admin:nimda@127.0.0.1";
10:   private static final String QUEUENAME = "kieker";
11:   @Override
12:   public void run() {
13:     final IAnalysisController analysisInstance = new AnalysisController();
14:     try {
15:       Configuration configuration = new Configuration();
16:       configuration.setProperty(RawDataReaderPlugin.CONFIG_PROPERTY_READER,
17:           "kieker.analysis.plugin.reader.amqp.ChunkingAmqpReader");
18:       configuration.setProperty(RawDataReaderPlugin.CONFIG_PROPERTY_DESERIALIZER,
19:           "kieker.analysis.plugin.reader.newio.deserializer.BinaryDeserializer");
20:       configuration.setProperty(ChunkingAmqpReader.CONFIG_PROPERTY_URI, URI);
21:       configuration.setProperty(ChunkingAmqpReader.CONFIG_PROPERTY_HEARTBEAT, 0);
22:       configuration.setProperty(ChunkingAmqpReader.CONFIG_PROPERTY_QUEUENAME, QUEUENAME);
23:       RawDataReaderPlugin reader = new RawDataReaderPlugin(configuration, analysisInstance);
24:       final LogConsumer consumer = new LogConsumer(new Configuration(), analysisInstance);
25:       analysisInstance.connect(reader, AmqpReader.OUTPUT_PORT_NAME_RECORDS, consumer,
26:           LogConsumer.INPUT_PORT_NAME);
27:       analysisInstance.run();
28:     } catch (Exception e) {
29:       System.out.println("AMQP Reader was interupted, probably due to reset");
30:     } finally {
31:       analysisInstance.terminate();
32:     }
33:   }
34: }

File: utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/kieker/rabbitmq/LogReaderStartup.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq;
 2: import java.util.concurrent.Executors;
 3: import java.util.concurrent.ScheduledExecutorService;
 4: import java.util.concurrent.TimeUnit;
 5: import javax.servlet.ServletContextEvent;
 6: import javax.servlet.ServletContextListener;
 7: import javax.servlet.annotation.WebListener;
 8: import org.apache.log4j.BasicConfigurator;
 9: @WebListener
10: public class LogReaderStartup implements ServletContextListener {
11:   private static ScheduledExecutorService logReaderStarter;
12:   private static ScheduledExecutorService fileWriterStarter;
13:   public LogReaderStartup() {
14:   }
15:   public void contextDestroyed(ServletContextEvent event) {
16:     stopFileWriter();
17:     logReaderStarter.shutdownNow();
18:     try {
19:       logReaderStarter.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
20:     } catch (InterruptedException e) {
21:       e.printStackTrace();
22:     }
23:   }
24:   public static void stopFileWriter() {
25:     fileWriterStarter.shutdownNow();
26:     try {
27:       fileWriterStarter.awaitTermination(10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
28:     } catch (InterruptedException e) {
29:       e.printStackTrace();
30:     }
31:   }
32:   public void contextInitialized(ServletContextEvent event) {
33:     startFileWriter();
34:     logReaderStarter = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
35:     BasicConfigurator.configure();
36:     logReaderStarter.schedule(new LogReaderDaemon(), 10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
37:   }
38:   public static void startFileWriter() {
39:     fileWriterStarter = Executors.newSingleThreadScheduledExecutor();
40:     fileWriterStarter.schedule(new FileWriterDaemon(), 10, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
41:   }
42: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq;
 2: import java.util.Queue;
 3: import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentLinkedQueue;
 4: import kieker.common.record.IMonitoringRecord;
 5: public final class MemoryLogStorage {
 6: 	private static Queue<IMonitoringRecord> records = new ConcurrentLinkedQueue<IMonitoringRecord>();
 7:   private MemoryLogStorage() {
 8:   }
 9: 	public static void storeRecord(IMonitoringRecord record) {
10: 		records.add(record);
11: 	}
12: 	public static Queue<IMonitoringRecord> getRecords() {
13: 		return records;
14: 	}
15: 	public static void clearMemoryStorage() {
16: 		records.clear();
17: 	}
18: }

File: utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/kieker/rabbitmq/Reset.java
================
 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.kieker.rabbitmq;
 2: import java.io.File;
 3: import java.io.IOException;
 4: import javax.servlet.annotation.WebServlet;
 5: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServlet;
 6: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 7: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
 8: @WebServlet("/reset")
 9: public class Reset extends HttpServlet {
10: 	private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
11: 	@Override
12: 	protected void doGet(HttpServletRequest request, HttpServletResponse response) throws IOException {
13: 		LogReaderStartup.stopFileWriter();
14: 		MemoryLogStorage.clearMemoryStorage();
15: 		deleteFolder(new File("apache-tomcat-8.5.24/webapps/logs"), "kieker");
16: 		LogReaderStartup.startFileWriter();
17: 	}
18: 	private void deleteFolder(File folder, String prefix) {
19: 		File[] files = folder.listFiles();
20: 		if (files != null) {
21: 			for (File f : files) {
22: 				if (f.getPath().contains(prefix)) {
23: 					if (f.isDirectory()) {
24: 						deleteFolder(f);
25: 					} else {
26: 						f.delete();
27: 					}
28: 				}
29: 			}
30: 		}
31: 	}
32: 	private void deleteFolder(File folder) {
33: 		File[] files = folder.listFiles();
34: 		if (files != null) {
35: 			for (File f : files) {
36: 				if (f.isDirectory()) {
37: 					deleteFolder(f);
38: 				} else {
39: 					f.delete();
40: 				}
41: 			}
42: 		}
43: 		folder.delete();
44: 	}
45: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers;
 2: import java.util.Collection;
 3: import java.util.Set;
 4: import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
 5: import com.netflix.loadbalancer.Server;
 6: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.Service;
 7: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.RESTClient;
 8: public class EndpointClientCollection<T> {
 9:     private ConcurrentHashMap<Server, RESTClient<T>> clients = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
10:     private final Class<T> entityClass;
11: 	private final Service targetService;
12: 	private final String endpointURI;
13: 	EndpointClientCollection(Service targetService, String endpointURI, final Class<T> entityClass) {
14: 		this.endpointURI = endpointURI;
15: 		this.targetService = targetService;
16: 		this.entityClass = entityClass;
17: 	}
18: 	void updateServers(Collection<Server> newServers) {
19: 		Set<Server> oldServers = clients.keySet();
20: 		if (oldServers.size() == newServers.size() && newServers.containsAll(oldServers)) {
21: 			return;
22: 		}
23: 		updateClients(newServers);
24: 	}
25: 	public String getEndpointURI() {
26: 		return endpointURI;
27: 	}
28: 	private void updateClients(Collection<Server> newServers) {
29:     	for (Server s : clients.keySet()) {
30:     		if (!newServers.contains(s)) {
31:     			clients.remove(s);
32:     		}
33:     	}
34:     	for (Server s : newServers) {
35:     		clients.putIfAbsent(s, new RESTClient<T>(s.getHost() + ":"
36:     					+ s.getPort() + "/" + targetService.getServiceName(),
37: 					RESTClient.DEFAULT_REST_APPLICATION, endpointURI, entityClass));
38:     	}
39:     }
40: 	RESTClient<T> getRESTClient(Server server) {
41: 		return clients.get(server);
42: 	}
43: }

  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers;
  2: import java.util.ArrayList;
  3: import java.util.HashSet;
  4: import java.util.List;
  5: import java.util.Set;
  6: import java.util.concurrent.ConcurrentHashMap;
  7: import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReadWriteLock;
  8: import java.util.concurrent.locks.ReentrantReadWriteLock;
  9: import java.util.function.Function;
 10: import java.util.stream.Collectors;
 11: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response.Status;
 12: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 13: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 14: import com.netflix.client.DefaultLoadBalancerRetryHandler;
 15: import com.netflix.client.RetryHandler;
 16: import com.netflix.loadbalancer.BaseLoadBalancer;
 17: import com.netflix.loadbalancer.LoadBalancerBuilder;
 18: import com.netflix.loadbalancer.Server;
 19: import com.netflix.loadbalancer.reactive.LoadBalancerCommand;
 20: import rx.Observable;
 21: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.RegistryClient;
 22: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.Service;
 23: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.NotFoundException;
 24: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.RESTClient;
 25: public final class ServiceLoadBalancer {
 26: 	private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ServiceLoadBalancer.class);
 27: 	private static ConcurrentHashMap<String, ServiceLoadBalancer> serviceMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 28: 	private ConcurrentHashMap<String, EndpointClientCollection<?>> endpointMap = new ConcurrentHashMap<>();
 29: 	private final Service targetService;
 30: 	private Set<Server> serviceServers = new HashSet<Server>();
 31: 	private BaseLoadBalancer loadBalancer;
 32:     private final RetryHandler retryHandler = new DefaultLoadBalancerRetryHandler(0, 2, true);
 33:     private ReadWriteLock loadBalancerModificationLock = new ReentrantReadWriteLock();
 34:     private ServiceLoadBalancer(final Service targetService) {
 35:     	this.targetService = targetService;
 36:     }
 37:     public static void preInitializeServiceLoadBalancers(Service... targetServices) {
 38:     	for (Service service : targetServices) {
 39:     		getServiceLoadBalancer(service);
 40:     		LOG.info("Pre-initializing client-side load balancer for target: "
 41: 			 + getServiceLoadBalancer(service).targetService.getServiceName());
 42:     	}
 43:     }
 44: 	private static ServiceLoadBalancer getServiceLoadBalancer(Service targetService) {
 45: 		ServiceLoadBalancer serviceBalancer = serviceMap.get(targetService.getServiceName());
 46:     	if (serviceBalancer == null
 47:     			|| serviceBalancer.serviceServers == null
 48:     			|| serviceBalancer.serviceServers.isEmpty()) {
 49:     		serviceMap.putIfAbsent(targetService.getServiceName(), new ServiceLoadBalancer(targetService));
 50:     		updateLoadBalancersForServiceUsingRegistry(targetService);
 51:     	}
 52:     	return serviceMap.get(targetService.getServiceName());
 53:     }
 54: 	static ServiceLoadBalancer getServiceLoadBalancer(Service targetService, List<Server> knownServers) {
 55: 		ServiceLoadBalancer serviceBalancer = ServiceLoadBalancer.serviceMap.get(targetService.getServiceName());
 56:     	if (serviceBalancer == null
 57:     			|| serviceBalancer.serviceServers == null
 58:     			|| serviceBalancer.serviceServers.isEmpty()) {
 59:     		serviceMap.putIfAbsent(targetService.getServiceName(), new ServiceLoadBalancer(targetService));
 60:     		updateLoadBalancersForService(targetService, knownServers);
 61:     	}
 62:     	return serviceMap.get(targetService.getServiceName());
 63:     }
 64: 	@SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
 65: 	private <T> EndpointClientCollection<T> getEndpointClientCollection(String endpointURI, Class<T> entityClass) {
 66: 		EndpointClientCollection<?> endpointCollection = endpointMap.get(endpointURI);
 67:     	if (endpointCollection == null) {
 68:     		endpointMap.putIfAbsent(endpointURI,
 69:     				new EndpointClientCollection<T>(targetService, endpointURI, entityClass));
 70:     		endpointMap.get(endpointURI).updateServers(serviceServers);
 71:     	}
 72:     	endpointCollection = endpointMap.get(endpointURI);
 73:     	return (EndpointClientCollection<T>) endpointCollection;
 74: 	}
 75: 	static void updateLoadBalancersForKnownServicesUsingRegistry() {
 76: 		serviceMap.values().forEach(balancer -> updateLoadBalancersForServiceUsingRegistry(balancer.targetService));
 77:     }
 78:     private static void updateLoadBalancersForServiceUsingRegistry(Service targetService) {
 79:     	List<Server> servers = RegistryClient.getClient().getServersForService(targetService);
 80:     	updateLoadBalancersForService(targetService, servers);
 81:     }
 82:     static void updateLoadBalancersForService(Service targetService, List<Server> newServers) {
 83:     	ServiceLoadBalancer serviceBalancer = serviceMap.get(targetService.getServiceName());
 84:     	if (serviceBalancer == null) {
 85:     		return;
 86:     	}
 87:     	serviceBalancer.updateLoadBalancer(newServers);
 88:     }
 89:     private void updateLoadBalancer(List<Server> newServers) {
 90:     	if (serviceServers == null) {
 91:     		serviceServers = new HashSet<Server>();
 92:     	}
 93:     	if (newServers == null) {
 94:     		newServers = new ArrayList<Server>();
 95:     	}
 96:     	if ((serviceServers.isEmpty() && newServers.isEmpty())
 97:     		|| (newServers.size() == serviceServers.size() && serviceServers.containsAll(newServers))) {
 98:     		return;
 99:     	}
100:     	serviceServers = new HashSet<Server>(newServers);
101:     	loadBalancerModificationLock.writeLock().lock();
102:     	try {
103: 	    	if (loadBalancer != null) {
104: 	    		loadBalancer.shutdown();
105: 	    	}
106: 	    	loadBalancer = LoadBalancerBuilder.newBuilder().buildFixedServerListLoadBalancer(newServers);
107: 	    	for (EndpointClientCollection<?> lb : endpointMap.values()) {
108: 	    		lb.updateServers(newServers);
109: 	    	}
110:     	} finally {
111:     		loadBalancerModificationLock.writeLock().unlock();
112:     	}
113:     }
114:     public static <T, R> R loadBalanceRESTOperation(Service targetService,
115:     		String endpointURI, Class<T> entityClass,
116:     		Function<RESTClient<T>, R> operation) throws NotFoundException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
117:     	return getServiceLoadBalancer(targetService).loadBalanceRESTOperation(endpointURI, entityClass, operation);
118: 	}
119:     private <T, R> R loadBalanceRESTOperation(String endpointURI,
120:     		Class<T> entityClass, Function<RESTClient<T>, R> operation)
121:     				throws NotFoundException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
122:     	R r = null;
123:     	loadBalancerModificationLock.readLock().lock();
124:     	try {
125:     		if (loadBalancer == null) {
126:         		LOG.warn("Load Balancer was not initialized for service: " + targetService.getServiceName()
127:         			+ ". Is Registry up?");
128:         		updateLoadBalancersForServiceUsingRegistry(targetService);
129:         	}
130:         	if (loadBalancer == null || loadBalancer.getAllServers().isEmpty()) {
131:         		LOG.warn("No Server registered for Service: " + targetService.getServiceName());
132:         	} else {
133:         		ServiceLoadBalancerResult<R> slbr = LoadBalancerCommand.<ServiceLoadBalancerResult<R>>builder()
134:                         .withLoadBalancer(loadBalancer)
135:                         .withRetryHandler(retryHandler)
136:                         .build()
137:                         .submit(server -> Observable.just(
138:                         		ServiceLoadBalancerResult.fromRESTOperation(
139:                         				(RESTClient<T>) getEndpointClientCollection(endpointURI, entityClass)
140:                 				.getRESTClient(server), operation)
141:                         		))
142: 						.onErrorReturn((Throwable e) -> {
143: 							e.printStackTrace();
144: 							return null;
145: 						}).toBlocking().first();
146:         		if (slbr == null) {
147:         			throw new NullPointerException("ServiceLoadBalancerResult was null!");
148:         		}
149:         		if (slbr.getStatusCode() == Status.REQUEST_TIMEOUT.getStatusCode()) {
150:         			throw new LoadBalancerTimeoutException("Timout at endpoint: "
151:         					+ endpointURI + ", with target service: " + targetService.getServiceName(),
152:         					targetService);
153:         		} else if (slbr.getStatusCode() == Status.NOT_FOUND.getStatusCode() || slbr.getEntity() == null) {
154:         			throw new NotFoundException();
155:         		}
156:         		r = slbr.getEntity();
157:         	}
158:     	} finally {
159:     		loadBalancerModificationLock.readLock().unlock();
160:     	}
161: 		return r;
162: 	}
163:     public static <T, R> List<R> multicastRESTOperation(Service targetService,
164:     		String endpointURI, Class<T> entityClass,
165:     		Function<RESTClient<T>, R> operation) {
166:     	return getServiceLoadBalancer(targetService).multicastRESTOperation(endpointURI, entityClass, operation, null);
167:     }
168:     public static <T, R> List<R> multicastRESTToOtherServiceInstances(String endpointURI, Class<T> entityClass,
169:     		Function<RESTClient<T>, R> operation) {
170:     	return getServiceLoadBalancer(RegistryClient.getClient().getMyService())
171:     			.multicastRESTOperation(endpointURI, entityClass, operation,
172:     					RegistryClient.getClient().getMyServiceInstanceServer());
173:     }
174:     private <T, R> List<R> multicastRESTOperation(String endpointURI, Class<T> entityClass,
175:     		Function<RESTClient<T>, R> operation, Server exception) {
176:     	List<R> responses = new ArrayList<>();
177:     	List<Server> servers = null;
178:     	loadBalancerModificationLock.readLock().lock();
179:     	try {
180: 	    	if (loadBalancer != null) {
181: 	    		servers = new ArrayList<>(loadBalancer.getAllServers());
182: 	    	}
183: 	    	if (servers != null) {
184: 	    		if (exception != null) {
185: 	        		servers.remove(exception);
186: 	        	}
187: 	        	responses = servers.parallelStream().map(
188: 	        		server -> {
189: 	        			try {
190: 	        				return operation.apply((RESTClient<T>) getEndpointClientCollection(endpointURI, entityClass)
191: 	                				.getRESTClient(server));
192: 	        			} catch (Exception e) {
193: 	        				return null;
194: 	        			}
195: 	        		}).collect(Collectors.toList());
196: 	    	}
197:     	} finally {
198:     		loadBalancerModificationLock.readLock().unlock();
199:     	}
200:     	return responses;
201:     }
202: }

File: utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/registryclient/loadbalancers/ServiceLoadBalancerResult.java

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.loadbalancers;
 2: import java.util.function.Function;
 3: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.NotFoundException;
 4: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.RESTClient;
 5: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util.TimeoutException;
 6: final class ServiceLoadBalancerResult<R> {
 7: 	private int statusCode = 200;
 8: 	private R entity = null;
 9: 	private ServiceLoadBalancerResult() {
10: 	}
11: 	static <T, R> ServiceLoadBalancerResult<R> fromRESTOperation(
12: 			RESTClient<T> client, Function<RESTClient<T>, R> operation)
13: 			throws NotFoundException, TimeoutException {
14: 		ServiceLoadBalancerResult<R> result = new ServiceLoadBalancerResult<>();
15: 		try {
16: 			result.setEntity(operation.apply(client));
17: 		} catch (NotFoundException e) {
18: 			result.setStatusCode(NotFoundException.ERROR_CODE);
19: 		} catch (TimeoutException e) {
20: 			result.setStatusCode(TimeoutException.ERROR_CODE);
21: 		}
22: 		return result;
23: 	}
24: 	public int getStatusCode() {
25: 		return statusCode;
26: 	}
27: 	private void setStatusCode(int statusCode) {
28: 		this.statusCode = statusCode;
29: 	}
30: 	public R getEntity() {
31: 		return entity;
32: 	}
33: 	private void setEntity(R entity) {
34: 		this.entity = entity;
35: 	}
36: }

 40:   protected RegistryClient() {

 42:     String useHostIP = "false";
 43:     try {
 44:       useHostIP = (String) new InitialContext().lookup("java:comp/env/useHostIP");
 45:     } catch (NamingException e) {
 46:       LOG.warn("useHostIP not set. Not using host ip as hostname.");
 47:     }
 48:     try {
 49:       if (useHostIP.equalsIgnoreCase("true")) {
 50:         hostName = InetAddress.getLocalHost().getHostAddress();
 51:       } else {
 52:         hostName = (String) new InitialContext().lookup("java:comp/env/hostName");
 53:       }
 54:     } catch (NamingException e) {
 55:       LOG.warn("hostName not set. Using default OS-provided hostname.");
 56:     } catch (UnknownHostException e) {
 57:       LOG.error("could not resolve host IP. Using default OS-provided hostname: " + e.getMessage());
 58:     }
 59:     try {
 60:       port = Integer.parseInt((String) new InitialContext().lookup("java:comp/env/servicePort"));
 61:     } catch (NamingException | NumberFormatException e) {
 62:       LOG.warn("Could not read servicePort! Using port 8080 as fallback.");
 63:       port = 8080;
 64:     }
 65:     try {
 66:       registryRESTURL = (String) new InitialContext().lookup("java:comp/env/registryURL");
 67:     } catch (NamingException e) {
 68:       LOG.warn("registryURL not set. Falling back to default registry URL (localhost, port " + port
 69:           + ").");
 70:       registryRESTURL = "http://localhost:" + port
 71:           + "/tools.descartes.teastore.registry/rest/services/";
 72:     }
 73:   }
 74:   public static RegistryClient getClient() {
 75:     return client;
 76:   }
 77:   public void unregister(String contextPath) {
 78:     Service service = getService(contextPath);
 79:     Server host = getServer();
 80:     LOG.info("Shutting down " + service.getServiceName() + "@" + host);
 81:     heartbeatScheduler.shutdownNow();
 82:     loadBalancerUpdateScheduler.shutdownNow();
 83:     availabilityScheduler.shutdownNow();
 84:     try {
 85:       loadBalancerUpdateScheduler.awaitTermination(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 86:       heartbeatScheduler.awaitTermination(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 87:       availabilityScheduler.awaitTermination(20, TimeUnit.SECONDS);
 88:       RegistryClient.client.unregisterOnce(service, host);
 89:     } catch (ProcessingException e) {
 90:       LOG.warn("Could not unregister " + service.getServiceName() + " when it was shutting "
 91:           + "down, since it could not reach the registry. This can be caused by shutting "
 92:           + "down the registry before other services, but is in it self not a problem.");
 93:     } catch (InterruptedException e) {
 94:       e.printStackTrace();
 95:     }
 96:   }
 97:   public void register(String contextPath) {
 98:     Service service = getService(contextPath);
 99:     Server host = getServer();
100:     heartbeatScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(new RegistryClientHeartbeatDaemon(service, host), 0,
101:         HEARTBEAT_INTERVAL_MS, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
102:     loadBalancerUpdateScheduler.scheduleAtFixedRate(new LoadBalancerUpdaterDaemon(), 1000,
103:         LOAD_BALANCER_REFRESH_INTERVAL_MS, TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS);
104:   }
105:   public void runAfterServiceIsAvailable(Service requestedService, StartupCallback callback,
106:       Service myService) {
107:     availabilityScheduler.schedule(new StartupCallbackTask(requestedService, callback, myService),
108:         0, TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);
109:     availabilityScheduler.shutdown();
110:   }
111:   public List<Server> getServersForService(Service targetService) {
112:     List<String> list = null;
113:     List<Server> serverList = new ArrayList<Server>();
114:     try {
115:       Response response = getRESTClient(5000).target(registryRESTURL)
116:           .path("/" + targetService.getServiceName() + "/").request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON)
117:           .get();
118:       list = response.readEntity(new GenericType<List<String>>() {
119:       });
120:     } catch (ProcessingException e) {
121:       return null;
122:     }
123:     if (list != null) {
124:       for (String string : list) {
125:         serverList.add(new Server(string));
126:       }
127:     }
128:     return serverList;
129:   }
130:   public Server getMyServiceInstanceServer() {
131:     return myServiceInstanceServer;
132:   }
133:   public Service getMyService() {
134:     return myService;
135:   }
136:   protected boolean registerOnce(Service service, Server server) {
137:     myService = service;
138:     myServiceInstanceServer = server;
139:     try {
140:       Response response = getRESTClient(5000).target(registryRESTURL).path(service.getServiceName())
141:           .path(server.toString()).request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).put(Entity.text(""));
142:       return (response.getStatus() == Response.Status.OK.getStatusCode());
143:     } catch (ProcessingException e) {
144:       return false;
145:     }
146:   }
147:   /**
148:    * Unregister a server for a service in the registry.
149:    *
150:    * @param service
151:    *          The service for which to unregister.
152:    * @param server
153:    *          The server address to remove.
154:    * @return True, if unregistration succeeded.
155:    */
156:   private boolean unregisterOnce(Service service, Server server) {
157:     try {
158:       Response response = getRESTClient(1000).target(registryRESTURL).path(service.getServiceName())
159:           .path(server.toString()).request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).delete();
160:       return (response.getStatus() == Response.Status.OK.getStatusCode());
161:     } catch (ProcessingException e) {
162:       return false;
163:     }
164:   }
165:   private Client getRESTClient(int timeout) {
166:     ClientConfig configuration = new ClientConfig();
167:     configuration.property(ClientProperties.CONNECT_TIMEOUT, timeout);
168:     configuration.property(ClientProperties.READ_TIMEOUT, timeout);
169:     return ClientBuilder.newClient(configuration);
170:   }
171:   private Service getService(String serviceName) {
172:     serviceName = cleanupServiceName(serviceName);
173:     for (Service service : Service.values()) {
174:       if (service.getServiceName().equals(serviceName)) {
175:         return service;
176:       }
177:     }
178:     throw new IllegalStateException(
179:         "The service " + serviceName + " is not registered in the Services enum");
180:   }
181:   private Server getServer() {
182:     return new Server(getHostName(), getPort());
183:   }
184:   private String getHostName() {
185:     if (hostName != null && !hostName.isEmpty()) {
186:       return hostName;
187:     }
188:     try {
189:       return InetAddress.getLocalHost().getCanonicalHostName();
190:     } catch (UnknownHostException e) {
191:       throw new IllegalStateException("could not load hostname from OS.");
192:     }
193:   };
194:   private int getPort() {
195:     if (port != null) {
196:       return port;
197:     } else {
198:       throw new IllegalStateException("Could not read servicePort!");
199:     }
200:   }
201:   protected String cleanupServiceName(String serviceName) {
202:     return serviceName.replace("/", "");
203:   }
204:   protected ScheduledExecutorService getHeartbeatScheduler() {
205:     return heartbeatScheduler;
206:   }
207:   protected ScheduledExecutorService getLoadBalancerUpdateScheduler() {
208:     return loadBalancerUpdateScheduler;
209:   }
210: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.rest;
 2: import javax.ws.rs.client.Invocation.Builder;
 3: import javax.ws.rs.core.MediaType;
 4: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 5: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 6: import kieker.monitoring.core.controller.IMonitoringController;
 7: import kieker.monitoring.core.controller.MonitoringController;
 8: import kieker.monitoring.core.registry.ControlFlowRegistry;
 9: import kieker.monitoring.core.registry.SessionRegistry;
10: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.tracing.Tracing;
11: import javax.ws.rs.client.WebTarget;
12: public final class HttpWrapper {
13:   private static final IMonitoringController CTRLINST = MonitoringController.getInstance();
14:   private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(HttpWrapper.class);
15:   private static final ControlFlowRegistry CF_REGISTRY = ControlFlowRegistry.INSTANCE;
16:   private static final SessionRegistry SESSION_REGISTRY = SessionRegistry.INSTANCE;
17:   private static final String HEADER_FIELD = "KiekerTracingInfo";
18:   private HttpWrapper() {
19:   }
20:   public static Builder wrap(WebTarget target) {
21:     Builder builder = target.request(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON).accept(MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON);
22:     Tracing.inject(builder);
23:     if (CTRLINST.isMonitoringEnabled()) {
24:       final String sessionId = SESSION_REGISTRY.recallThreadLocalSessionId();
25:       final int eoi;
26:       final int ess;
27:       final int nextESS;
28:       long traceId = CF_REGISTRY.recallThreadLocalTraceId();
29:       if (traceId == -1) {
30:         traceId = CF_REGISTRY.getAndStoreUniqueThreadLocalTraceId();
31:         CF_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalEOI(0);
32:         CF_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalESS(1);
33:         eoi = 0;
34:         ess = 0;
35:         nextESS = 1;
36:       } else {
37:         eoi = CF_REGISTRY.recallThreadLocalEOI();
38:         ess = CF_REGISTRY.recallThreadLocalESS();
39:         nextESS = ess;
40:         if ((eoi == -1) || (ess == -1)) {
41:           LOG.error("eoi and/or ess have invalid values:" + " eoi == " + eoi + " ess == " + ess);
42:         }
43:       }
44:       return builder.header(HEADER_FIELD,
45:           Long.toString(traceId) + "," + sessionId + "," + Integer.toString(eoi) + "," + Integer.toString(nextESS));
46:     }
47:     return builder;
48:   }
49: }

 20:   public static <T> long sendEntityForCreation(RESTClient<T> client, T entity)
 21:       throws NotFoundException, TimeoutException {
 22:     Response response = ResponseWrapper.wrap(HttpWrapper.wrap(client.getEndpointTarget())
 23:         .post(Entity.entity(entity, MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON), Response.class));
 24:     long id = -1L;
 25:     if (response != null && response.getStatus() == 201) {
 26:       id = 0L;
 27:       try {
 28:         id = response.readEntity(Long.class);
 29:       } catch (ProcessingException e) {
 30:         LOG.warn("Response did not conform to expected message type. Expected a Long ID.");
 31:       }
 32:     } else if (response != null) {
 33:       response.bufferEntity();
 34:     }
 35:     if (response != null && response.getStatus() == Status.NOT_FOUND.getStatusCode()) {
 36:       throw new NotFoundException();
 37:     } else if (response != null && response.getStatus() == Status.REQUEST_TIMEOUT.getStatusCode()) {
 38:       throw new TimeoutException();
 39:     }
 40:     return id;
 41:   }

 45:         .wrap(HttpWrapper.wrap(client.getEndpointTarget().path(String.valueOf(id)))
 46:             .put(Entity.entity(entity, MediaType.APPLICATION_JSON), Response.class));
 47:     if (response != null) {
 48:       response.bufferEntity();
 49:     }
 50:     if (response != null && response.getStatus() == Status.NOT_FOUND.getStatusCode()) {
 51:       throw new NotFoundException();

 53:       throw new TimeoutException();

 56:       return true;
 57:     }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.rest;
 2: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response;
 3: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 4: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 5: import kieker.common.record.controlflow.OperationExecutionRecord;
 6: import kieker.monitoring.core.controller.IMonitoringController;
 7: import kieker.monitoring.core.controller.MonitoringController;
 8: import kieker.monitoring.core.registry.ControlFlowRegistry;
 9: import kieker.monitoring.core.registry.SessionRegistry;
10: public final class ResponseWrapper {
11:   private static final IMonitoringController CTRLINST = MonitoringController.getInstance();
12:   private static final ControlFlowRegistry CF_REGISTRY = ControlFlowRegistry.INSTANCE;
13:   private static final SessionRegistry SESSION_REGISTRY = SessionRegistry.INSTANCE;
14:   private static final String HEADER_FIELD = "KiekerTracingInfo";
15:   private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ResponseWrapper.class);
16:   private static final String SESSION_ID_ASYNC_TRACE = "NOSESSION-ASYNCIN";
17:   private ResponseWrapper() {
18:   }
19:   public static Response wrap(Response response) {
20:     if (CTRLINST.isMonitoringEnabled()) {
21:       long traceId = -1L;
22:       int eoi;
23:       int ess;
24:       String sessionId;
25:       final String operationExecutionHeader = response.getHeaderString(HEADER_FIELD);
26:       if ((operationExecutionHeader == null) || (operationExecutionHeader.equals(""))) {
27:         LOG.warn("Response without tracking id was found");
28:       } else {
29:         final String[] headerArray = operationExecutionHeader.split(",");
30:         sessionId = headerArray[1];
31:         if ("null".equals(sessionId)) {
32:           sessionId = OperationExecutionRecord.NO_SESSION_ID;
33:         }
34:         final String eoiStr = headerArray[2];
35:         eoi = -1;
36:         try {
37:           eoi = Integer.parseInt(eoiStr);
38:         } catch (final NumberFormatException exc) {
39:           LOG.warn("Invalid eoi", exc);
40:         }
41:         final String essStr = headerArray[3];
42:         ess = -1;
43:         try {
44:           ess = Integer.parseInt(essStr);
45:         } catch (final NumberFormatException exc) {
46:           LOG.warn("Invalid ess", exc);
47:         }
48:         final String traceIdStr = headerArray[0];
49:         if (traceIdStr != null) {
50:           try {
51:             traceId = Long.parseLong(traceIdStr);
52:           } catch (final NumberFormatException exc) {
53:             LOG.warn("Invalid trace id", exc);
54:           }
55:         } else {
56:           traceId = CF_REGISTRY.getUniqueTraceId();
57:           sessionId = SESSION_ID_ASYNC_TRACE;
58:           eoi = 0;
59:           ess = 0;
60:         }
61:         CF_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalTraceId(traceId);
62:         CF_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalEOI(eoi);
63:         CF_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalESS(ess);
64:         SESSION_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalSessionId(sessionId);
65:       }
66:     }
67:     return response;
68:   }
69: }

15: 	public static void throwCommonExceptions(Response responseWithStatus)
16: 			throws NotFoundException, LoadBalancerTimeoutException {
17: 		if (responseWithStatus.getStatus() == Status.NOT_FOUND.getStatusCode()) {
18: 			throw new NotFoundException();
19: 		} else if (responseWithStatus.getStatus() == Status.REQUEST_TIMEOUT.getStatusCode()) {
20: 			throw new LoadBalancerTimeoutException("Timout waiting for Store.", Service.AUTH);
21: 		}
22: 	}
23: 	public static <T> T readEntityOrNull(Response r, Class<T> entityClass) {
24: 		if (r != null) {
25: 			if (r.getStatus() == 200) {
26: 				return r.readEntity(entityClass);
27: 			} else {
28: 				r.bufferEntity();
29: 			}
30: 		}
31: 		return null;
32: 	}
33: 	public static <T> T readThrowAndOrClose(Response responseWithStatus, Class<T> entityClass) {
34: 		T entity = null;
35: 		entity = readEntityOrNull(responseWithStatus, entityClass);
36: 		throwCommonExceptions(responseWithStatus);
37: 		return entity;
38: 	}
39: 	public static List<Order> readListThrowAndOrCloseOrder(Response r) {
40: 		List<Order> entity = null;
41: 		if (r != null) {
42: 			if (r.getStatus() == 200) {
43: 				entity = r.readEntity(new GenericType<List<Order>>() { });
44: 			} else {
45: 				r.bufferEntity();
46: 			}
47: 		}
48: 		if (r == null || entity == null) {
49: 			entity = new ArrayList<Order>();
50: 		}
51: 		throwCommonExceptions(r);
52: 		return entity;
53: 	}
54: 	public static List<Product> readListThrowAndOrCloseProduct(Response r) {

58: 				entity = r.readEntity(new GenericType<List<Product>>() { });
59: 			} else {
60: 				r.bufferEntity();
61: 			}
62: 		}

File: utilities/tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient/src/main/java/tools/descartes/teastore/registryclient/rest/TrackingFilter.java

  1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.rest;
  2: import java.io.IOException;
  3: import java.io.PrintWriter;
  4: import javax.servlet.Filter;
  5: import javax.servlet.FilterChain;
  6: import javax.servlet.FilterConfig;
  7: import javax.servlet.ServletException;
  8: import javax.servlet.ServletRequest;
  9: import javax.servlet.ServletResponse;
 10: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 11: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse;
 12: import io.opentracing.Scope;
 13: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 14: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 15: import kieker.common.record.controlflow.OperationExecutionRecord;
 16: import kieker.monitoring.core.controller.IMonitoringController;
 17: import kieker.monitoring.core.controller.MonitoringController;
 18: import kieker.monitoring.core.registry.ControlFlowRegistry;
 19: import kieker.monitoring.core.registry.SessionRegistry;
 20: import tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.tracing.Tracing;
 21: public class TrackingFilter implements Filter {
 22:   private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(TrackingFilter.class);
 23:   private static final IMonitoringController CTRLINST = MonitoringController.getInstance();
 24:   private static final String SESSION_ID_ASYNC_TRACE = "NOSESSION-ASYNCIN";
 25:   private static final ControlFlowRegistry CF_REGISTRY = ControlFlowRegistry.INSTANCE;
 26:   private static final SessionRegistry SESSION_REGISTRY = SessionRegistry.INSTANCE;
 27:   private static final String HEADER_FIELD = "KiekerTracingInfo";
 28:   public void init(FilterConfig filterConfig) throws ServletException {
 29:   }
 30:   public void doFilter(ServletRequest request, ServletResponse response, FilterChain chain)
 31:       throws IOException, ServletException {
 32:     try (Scope scope = Tracing.extractCurrentSpan((HttpServletRequest) request)) {
 33:       if (!CTRLINST.isMonitoringEnabled()) {
 34:         chain.doFilter(request, response);
 35:         return;
 36:       }
 37:       if (request instanceof HttpServletRequest && response instanceof HttpServletResponse) {
 38:         String url = ((HttpServletRequest) request).getRequestURL().toString();
 39:         if (url.contains("webui")) {
 40:           chain.doFilter(request, response);
 41:           return;
 42:         }
 43:         HttpServletRequest req = (HttpServletRequest) request;
 44:         String sessionId = SESSION_REGISTRY.recallThreadLocalSessionId();
 45:         long traceId = -1L;
 46:         int eoi;
 47:         int ess;
 48:         final String operationExecutionHeader = req.getHeader(HEADER_FIELD);
 49:         if ((operationExecutionHeader == null) || (operationExecutionHeader.equals(""))) {
 50:           LOG.debug("No monitoring data found in the incoming request header");
 51:           traceId = CF_REGISTRY.getAndStoreUniqueThreadLocalTraceId();
 52:           CF_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalEOI(0);
 53:           CF_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalESS(1);
 54:           eoi = 0;
 55:           ess = 0;
 56:         } else {
 57:           if (LOG.isDebugEnabled()) {
 58:             LOG.debug("Received request: " + req.getMethod() + "with header = " + operationExecutionHeader);
 59:           }
 60:           final String[] headerArray = operationExecutionHeader.split(",");
 61:           sessionId = headerArray[1];
 62:           if ("null".equals(sessionId)) {
 63:             sessionId = OperationExecutionRecord.NO_SESSION_ID;
 64:           }
 65:           final String eoiStr = headerArray[2];
 66:           eoi = -1;
 67:           try {
 68:             eoi = Integer.parseInt(eoiStr);
 69:           } catch (final NumberFormatException exc) {
 70:             LOG.warn("Invalid eoi", exc);
 71:           }
 72:           final String essStr = headerArray[3];
 73:           ess = -1;
 74:           try {
 75:             ess = Integer.parseInt(essStr);
 76:           } catch (final NumberFormatException exc) {
 77:             LOG.warn("Invalid ess", exc);
 78:           }
 79:           final String traceIdStr = headerArray[0];
 80:           if (traceIdStr != null) {
 81:             try {
 82:               traceId = Long.parseLong(traceIdStr);
 83:             } catch (final NumberFormatException exc) {
 84:               LOG.warn("Invalid trace id", exc);
 85:             }
 86:           } else {
 87:             traceId = CF_REGISTRY.getUniqueTraceId();
 88:             sessionId = SESSION_ID_ASYNC_TRACE;
 89:             eoi = 0;
 90:             ess = 0;
 91:           }
 92:           CF_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalTraceId(traceId);
 93:           CF_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalEOI(eoi);
 94:           CF_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalESS(ess);
 95:           SESSION_REGISTRY.storeThreadLocalSessionId(sessionId);
 96:         }
 97:       } else {
 98:         LOG.error("Something went wrong");
 99:       }
100:       CharResponseWrapper wrappedResponse = new CharResponseWrapper((HttpServletResponse) response);
101:       PrintWriter out = response.getWriter();
102:       chain.doFilter(request, wrappedResponse);
103:       String sessionId = SESSION_REGISTRY.recallThreadLocalSessionId();
104:       long traceId = CF_REGISTRY.recallThreadLocalTraceId();
105:       int eoi = CF_REGISTRY.recallThreadLocalEOI();
106:       wrappedResponse.addHeader(HEADER_FIELD,
107:           traceId + "," + sessionId + "," + (eoi) + "," + Integer.toString(CF_REGISTRY.recallThreadLocalESS()));
108:       out.write(wrappedResponse.toString());
109:     }
110:   }
111:   public void destroy() {
112:     CF_REGISTRY.unsetThreadLocalTraceId();
113:     CF_REGISTRY.unsetThreadLocalEOI();
114:     CF_REGISTRY.unsetThreadLocalESS();
115:   }
116: }

 6: 	WEBUI("tools.descartes.teastore.webui"),

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient;
 2: import java.util.List;
 3: import org.slf4j.Logger;
 4: import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
 5: import com.netflix.loadbalancer.Server;
 6: public class StartupCallbackTask implements Runnable {
 7: 	private static final Logger LOG = LoggerFactory.getLogger(RegistryClient.class);
 8: 	private Service requestedService;
 9: 	private StartupCallback callback;
10: 	private Service myService;
11: 	public StartupCallbackTask(Service requestedService, StartupCallback callback, Service myService) {
12: 		this.requestedService = requestedService;
13: 		this.callback = callback;
14: 		this.myService = myService;
15: 	}
16: 	@Override
17: 	public void run() {
18: 		try {
19: 	    	List<Server> servers;
20: 	    	boolean msgLogged = false;
21: 	    	do {
22: 	    		servers = RegistryClient.getClient().getServersForService(requestedService);
23: 	    		if (servers == null || servers.isEmpty()) {
24: 	    			try {
25: 	    				if (!msgLogged) {
26: 		    				if (servers == null) {
27: 		    					LOG.info("Registry not online. " + myService + " is waiting for it to come online");
28: 		    				} else {
29: 		    					LOG.info(requestedService.getServiceName() + " not online. "
30: 		    							+ myService + " is waiting for it to come online");
31: 		    				}
32: 		    				msgLogged = true;
33: 	    				}
34: 						Thread.sleep(1000);
35: 					} catch (InterruptedException e) {
36: 						e.printStackTrace();
37: 					}
38: 	    		}
39: 	    	} while (servers == null || servers.isEmpty());
40: 	    	callback.callback();
41: 		} catch (Exception e) {
42: 			e.printStackTrace();
43: 			throw(e);
44: 		}
45: 	}
46: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.tracing;
 2: import java.util.Collections;
 3: import java.util.HashMap;
 4: import java.util.Iterator;
 5: import java.util.Map;
 6: import javax.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
 7: import javax.ws.rs.client.Invocation;
 8: import javax.ws.rs.core.HttpHeaders;
 9: import io.jaegertracing.internal.JaegerTracer;
10: import io.jaegertracing.internal.propagation.B3TextMapCodec;
11: import io.jaegertracing.internal.samplers.ConstSampler;
12: import io.opentracing.Scope;
13: import io.opentracing.Span;
14: import io.opentracing.SpanContext;
15: import io.opentracing.Tracer;
16: import io.opentracing.propagation.Format;
17: import io.opentracing.propagation.TextMap;
18: import io.opentracing.propagation.TextMapExtractAdapter;
19: import io.opentracing.tag.Tags;
20: import io.opentracing.util.GlobalTracer;
21: public final class Tracing {
22:   private Tracing() {
23:   }
24:   public static Tracer init(String service) {
25:     return new JaegerTracer.Builder(service).withSampler(new ConstSampler(true)).withZipkinSharedRpcSpan()
26:         .registerInjector(Format.Builtin.HTTP_HEADERS, new B3TextMapCodec.Builder().build())
27:         .registerExtractor(Format.Builtin.HTTP_HEADERS, new B3TextMapCodec.Builder().build()).build();
28:   }
29:   public static void inject(Invocation.Builder requestBuilder) {
30:     Span activeSpan = GlobalTracer.get().activeSpan();
31:     if (activeSpan != null) {
32:       GlobalTracer.get().inject(activeSpan.context(), Format.Builtin.HTTP_HEADERS,
33:           Tracing.requestBuilderCarrier(requestBuilder));
34:     }
35:   }
36:   public static Scope extractCurrentSpan(HttpServletRequest request) {
37:     Map<String, String> headers = new HashMap<>();
38:     for (String headerName : Collections.list(request.getHeaderNames())) {
39:       headers.put(headerName, request.getHeader(headerName));
40:     }
41:     return buildSpanFromHeaders(headers);
42:   }
43:   public static Scope extractCurrentSpan(HttpHeaders httpHeaders) {
44:     Map<String, String> headers = new HashMap<>();
45:     for (String headerName : httpHeaders.getRequestHeaders().keySet()) {
46:       headers.put(headerName, httpHeaders.getRequestHeader(headerName).get(0));
47:     }
48:     return buildSpanFromHeaders(headers);
49:   }
50:   private static Scope buildSpanFromHeaders(Map<String, String> headers) {
51:     Tracer.SpanBuilder spanBuilder = GlobalTracer.get().buildSpan("op");
52:     try {
53:       SpanContext parentSpanCtx = GlobalTracer.get().extract(Format.Builtin.HTTP_HEADERS,
54:           new TextMapExtractAdapter(headers));
55:       if (parentSpanCtx != null) {
56:         spanBuilder = spanBuilder.asChildOf(parentSpanCtx);
57:       }
58:     } catch (IllegalArgumentException e) {
59:       e.printStackTrace();
60:     }
61:     return spanBuilder.withTag(Tags.SPAN_KIND.getKey(), Tags.SPAN_KIND_CLIENT).startActive(true);
62:   }
63:   public static TextMap requestBuilderCarrier(final Invocation.Builder builder) {
64:     return new TextMap() {
65:       @Override
66:       public Iterator<Map.Entry<String, String>> iterator() {
67:         throw new UnsupportedOperationException("carrier is write-only");
68:       }
69:       @Override
70:       public void put(String key, String value) {
71:         builder.header(key, value);
72:       }
73:     };
74:   }
75: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util;
 2: import java.util.List;
 3: import javax.ws.rs.Consumes;
 4: import javax.ws.rs.DELETE;
 5: import javax.ws.rs.GET;
 6: import javax.ws.rs.POST;
 7: import javax.ws.rs.PUT;
 8: import javax.ws.rs.Path;
 9: import javax.ws.rs.PathParam;
10: import javax.ws.rs.Produces;
11: import javax.ws.rs.QueryParam;
12: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response;
13: import javax.ws.rs.core.Response.Status;
14: import javax.ws.rs.core.UriBuilder;
15: @Path("abstract")
16: @Produces({ "application/json" })
17: @Consumes({ "application/json" })
18: public abstract class AbstractCRUDEndpoint<T> {
19: 	@POST
20: 	public Response create(final T entity) {
21: 		long id = createEntity(entity);
22: 		return Response.created(UriBuilder.fromResource(AbstractCRUDEndpoint.class).
23: 				path(String.valueOf(id)).build()).entity(id).build();
24: 	}
25: 	protected abstract long createEntity(final T entity);
26: 	@GET
27: 	@Path("/{id:[0-9][0-9]*}")
28: 	public Response findById(@PathParam("id") final Long id) {
29: 		if (id == null) {
30: 			return Response.status(Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
31: 		}
32: 		T entity = findEntityById(id);
33: 		if (entity == null) {
34: 			return Response.status(Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
35: 		}
36: 		return Response.ok(entity).build();
37: 	}
38: 	protected abstract T findEntityById(final long id);
39: 	@GET
40: 	public List<T> listAll(@QueryParam("start") final Integer startPosition,
41: 			@QueryParam("max") final Integer maxResult) {
42: 		final List<T> entities = listAllEntities(parseIntQueryParam(startPosition), parseIntQueryParam(maxResult));
43: 		return entities;
44: 	}
45: 	protected abstract List<T> listAllEntities(final int startIndex, final int maxResultCount);
46: 	@PUT
47: 	@Path("/{id:[0-9][0-9]*}")
48: 	public Response update(@PathParam("id") Long id, final T entity) {
49: 		boolean updated = false;
50: 		if (id != null && entity != null) {
51: 			updated = updateEntity(id, entity);
52: 		}
53: 		if (updated) {
54: 			return Response.ok().build();
55: 		} else {
56: 			return Response.status(Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
57: 		}
58: 	}
59: 	protected abstract boolean updateEntity(long id, final T entity);
60: 	@DELETE
61: 	@Path("/{id:[0-9][0-9]*}")
62: 	public Response deleteById(@PathParam("id") final Long id) {
63: 		boolean deleted = deleteEntity(id);
64: 		if (deleted) {
65: 			return Response.ok().build();
66: 		} else {
67: 			return Response.status(Status.NOT_FOUND).build();
68: 		}
69: 	}
70: 	protected abstract boolean deleteEntity(long id);
71: 	protected int parseIntQueryParam(Integer queryArg) {
72: 		if (queryArg != null) {
73: 			return queryArg;
74: 		}
75: 		return -1;
76: 	}
77: }

 1: package tools.descartes.teastore.registryclient.util;
 2: import java.lang.reflect.ParameterizedType;
 3: import java.lang.reflect.Type;
 4: import java.util.List;
 5: import javax.ws.rs.client.Client;
 6: import javax.ws.rs.client.ClientBuilder;
 7: import javax.ws.rs.client.WebTarget;
 8: import javax.ws.rs.core.GenericType;
 9: import javax.ws.rs.core.UriBuilder;
10: import org.glassfish.jersey.client.ClientConfig;
11: import org.glassfish.jersey.client.ClientProperties;
12: import org.glassfish.jersey.grizzly.connector.GrizzlyConnectorProvider;
13: public class RESTClient<T> {
14: 	private static final int DEFAULT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT = 400;
15: 	private static final int DEFAULT_READ_TIMEOUT = 3000;
16: 	public static final String DEFAULT_REST_APPLICATION = "rest";
17: 	private static int readTimeout = DEFAULT_READ_TIMEOUT;
18: 	private static int connectTimeout = DEFAULT_CONNECT_TIMEOUT;
19: 	private String applicationURI;
20: 	private String endpointURI;
21: 	private Client client;
22: 	private WebTarget service;
23: 	private Class<T> entityClass;
24: 	private ParameterizedType parameterizedGenericType;
25: 	private GenericType<List<T>> genericListType;
26: 	public RESTClient(String hostURL, String application, String endpoint, final Class<T> entityClass) {
27: 		if (!hostURL.endsWith("/")) {
28: 			hostURL += "/";
29: 		}
30: 		if (!hostURL.contains("://")) {
31: 			hostURL = "http://" + hostURL;
32: 		}
33: 		ClientConfig config = new ClientConfig();
34: 		config.property(ClientProperties.CONNECT_TIMEOUT, connectTimeout);
35: 		config.property(ClientProperties.READ_TIMEOUT, readTimeout);
36: 		config.connectorProvider(new GrizzlyConnectorProvider());
37: 		client = ClientBuilder.newClient(config);
38: 		service = client.target(UriBuilder.fromUri(hostURL).build());
39: 		applicationURI = application;
40: 		endpointURI = endpoint;
41: 		this.entityClass = entityClass;
42: 		parameterizedGenericType = new ParameterizedType() {
43: 		        public Type[] getActualTypeArguments() {
44: 		            return new Type[] { entityClass };
45: 		        }
46: 		        public Type getRawType() {
47: 		            return List.class;
48: 		        }
49: 		        public Type getOwnerType() {
50: 		            return List.class;
51: 		        }
52: 		    };
53: 		    genericListType = new GenericType<List<T>>(parameterizedGenericType) { };
54: 	}
55: 	public static void setGlobalReadTimeout(int readTimeout) {
56: 		RESTClient.readTimeout = readTimeout;
57: 	}
58: 	public static void setGlobalConnectTimeout(int connectTimeout) {
59: 		RESTClient.connectTimeout = connectTimeout;
60: 	}
61: 	public GenericType<List<T>> getGenericListType() {
62: 		return genericListType;
63: 	}
64: 	public Class<T> getEntityClass() {
65: 		return entityClass;
66: 	}
67: 	public WebTarget getService() {
68: 		return service;
69: 	}
70: 	public WebTarget getEndpointTarget() {
71: 		return service.path(applicationURI).path(endpointURI);
72: 	}
73: 	public String getEndpointURI() {
74: 		return endpointURI;
75: 	}
76: 	public String getApplicationURI() {
77: 		return applicationURI;
78: 	}
79: }
